results.score_rationale: Platform fundamentals pass (HTTPS + 301s, self-canonicals, SSR, real 404s, current Shopify robots.txt, valid sitemaps), but the index is structurally doubled twice (575 /ro-hu/ duplicates + 58 B2B cross-domain duplicates), six utility/empty collections and a thank-you page are indexable and in the sitemap, the 354-article blog sits behind a 59-page prev/next-only archive, and every page ships a mis-ordered 157-189 KB head with a zoom-locked viewport. Category scores: crawlability 55, indexability 35, security 80, URL structure 65, mobile 70, JS rendering 95, structured data 40, CWV not measured, IndexNow not implemented.
what_works: HTTPS enforced; http->https and www->non-www 301; primesupplements1.myshopify.com 301s to the primary domain
HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, CSP frame-ancestors 'none' on every 200 response; HTTP/2 via Cloudflare
Self-referencing canonicals on all 24 parsed pages; ?sort_by and ?filter.* canonicalise to the bare collection; ?page=N self-canonical with rel prev/next and '- Pagina N' title suffix
/search?q= served with X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
robots.txt is Shopify's current 2026 default: blocks sort_by, multi-filter, +tag combos, cart/checkout/account; sitemap declared (corrects the context file)
Unknown URLs return real HTTP 404 (title '404 negasit', no-store)
Sitemap index well-formed; 185 product entries with lastmod + image; 354 articles with lastmod over 90 distinct dates
Server-side rendering: product raw HTML has 1,039 visible words, article 2,367, collection grid 24 product cards; no SPA; no pushState/replaceState back-button hijack
html lang=ro; hreflang triplet (x-default/ro/ro-HU) consistent with return links
Googlebot and other bots excluded from Shopify's web-pixel loader; theme assets light (theme.css 27 KB, theme.js 35 KB, vendor.min.js 21 KB) as ES modules; theme fonts and theme.css preloaded
Largest HTML (617 KB) well under Googlebot's 2 MB cap; title and canonical within the first 1.5 KB
limitations: Core Web Vitals not measurable (PSI quota exhausted, no CrUX, no Chromium); CWV statements are static risk signals only
/collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1 returned Cloudflare 429 twice this session; evidence taken from the earlier capture scratchpad/tech/live/vendors.body
$R/theme/layout__theme.liquid was absent; the live layout was read via one read-only Admin GraphQL query (themes.files, theme 179784286583); nothing was modified
B2B store robots.txt/password state taken from the context file, not re-fetched
Google's rendered DOM not compared with raw HTML (render_page.py blocked by sandbox proxy)
Crawl depth derived from pagination settings and page counts, not from a crawler run
Pandectes banner intrusiveness not assessed

findings.title: The /ro-hu/ 'Ungaria' market publishes a full second copy of the site (575 duplicate URLs, self-canonical, identical Romanian content and RON prices)
findings.evidence: all-urls.txt: 1,151 URLs = 576 primary + 575 /ro-hu/ exact mirror (185 products, 23 collections, 354 articles, 11 pages). Sitemap index lists the six content sitemaps twice. Live GET /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure -> 200, canonical https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure, og:url /ro-hu/, html lang=ro, 41 RON mentions, 72 internal links all under /ro-hu/. homepage-ro-hu.html identical to home.html (2,950 words) except 175 /ro-hu/ links; its canonical is https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu (no slash) while served at /ro-hu/. hreflang ro-HU -> /ro-hu/ on every page. Admin: hu locale unpublished, market currency null.
findings.affected_scope: 575 of 1,151 sitemap URLs plus all paginated/parameter variants (every indexable URL)
findings.recommendation: Preferred: Settings -> Markets -> Ungaria -> Domains and languages -> remove the /ro-hu subfolder web presence or deactivate the market until a translated hu locale is published (removes /ro-hu/ sitemaps, ro-HU hreflang and the duplicates at source). Fallback if the market must stay: in layout/theme.liquid compute canonical_href = canonical_url | replace_first: 'primesupplements.ro/ro-hu', 'primesupplements.ro' (normalise bare root to trailing slash) when localization.country.iso_code == 'HU', and emit <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> for HU.
findings.falsifiability: curl -s https://primesupplements.ro/sitemap.xml | grep -c ro-hu must be 0 and /ro-hu/... must not return a self-canonical 200; if GSC still shows /ro-hu/ URLs Indexed after 4 weeks, the fix failed
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Pages: 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' and 'Alternate page with proper canonical tag' counts; crawl requests dropping ~40-50%

findings.title: The B2B store b2b.primesupplements.ro is an indexable cross-domain duplicate of the product catalogue (58 same-handle product URLs)
findings.evidence: b2b-products-sitemap.xml lists 58 <loc> with the same handles as the main store (/products/baton-proteic-capsuni, /products/creatina-creapure...). b2b-product.html: canonical https://b2b.primesupplements.ro/products/creatina-creapure (self), no meta robots, no hreflang, 0 links to primesupplements.ro, title 'Creatina (Creapure) 500g/100 serv - PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL / 46260823'. b2b.html 940 KB, title 'PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL / 46260823'. Context: B2B robots.txt Shopify default, no password.
findings.affected_scope: 58 product pages (core supplements range) + B2B home/collections
findings.recommendation: (a) Enable the storefront password on the B2B store (Online Store -> Preferences -> Restrict access), which 302s every URL to /password and withdraws the sitemap; or (b) add <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> to its layout/theme.liquid plus templates/robots.txt.liquid with Disallow: /, and rename the store from 'PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL / 46260823' to 'Prime Supplements B2B'. Do not use cross-domain canonicals to the retail store.
findings.falsifiability: curl -sI https://b2b.primesupplements.ro/products/creatina-creapure returns 302 to /password or contains noindex; if site:b2b.primesupplements.ro still returns product pages after 6 weeks, the fix failed
findings.leading_indicator: site:b2b.primesupplements.ro result count trending to 0; main-store GSC no longer listing b2b URLs as Google-selected canonical

findings.title: Five utility collections (all, cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, 11-tva, frontpage) are indexable and in the sitemap, three of them full-catalogue duplicates of each other; the theme has no robots-meta logic at all
findings.evidence: sitemaps/child3.xml lists /collections/all, cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, 11-tva, frontpage (+ /ro-hu/ twins in child9.xml). parsed/pages_collection-all.json: title 'All Products', H1 'All Products', canonical self, no meta robots, pagination '1 / 8' (products_per_page 24). Admin: all / cele-mai-vandute / lansate-recent each contain all 185 active products in a different order; 11-tva is an internal VAT grouping (15 products, title '11% TVA'); frontpage holds 1 product; 8/23 collections have no SEO title/description, all have empty descriptions. Live layout/theme.liquid contains no <meta name="robots"> logic (only <link rel="canonical" href="{{ canonical_url }}">).
findings.affected_scope: 5 collections x up to 8 paginated pages x 2 markets = up to ~80 listing URLs re-listing the same 185 products
findings.recommendation: No-code: Settings -> Custom data -> Collections -> definition namespace seo, key hidden, type Integer; set 1 on all, cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, 11-tva, frontpage, reduceri (Shopify injects noindex and removes the URL from the sitemap). Belt-and-braces: add to layout/theme.liquid after the canonical a {%- liquid -%} block that sets seo_noindex when request.page_type == 'collection' and (utility handle list contains collection.handle, or collection.handle == 'vendors'/'types', or current_tags.size > 0, or collection.products_count == 0), when request.page_type == 'blog' and current_tags.size > 0, when page.handle == 'thank-you', and when request.page_type == 'search'; then output <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">. Keep /collections/all as the user hub (noindex, follow) and make category collections the indexable listings.
findings.falsifiability: curl -s https://primesupplements.ro/collections/all | grep -c noindex = 1 and the sitemap no longer lists it; if GSC still shows /collections/cele-mai-vandute Indexed after a recrawl, the fix did not apply
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Excluded by noindex tag' rising by the number of utility URLs; impressions moving from /collections/all?page=N to category collections

findings.title: Blog archive is 59 pages deep with prev/next-only pagination (6 articles per page): most of the 354 articles are 20-59 clicks from any hub
findings.evidence: blog-index.html pagination__current '1 / 59', 11 distinct article links, only href="/blogs/news?page=2" as pagination links; snippets/pagination.liquid renders only paginate.previous/next (no paginate.parts); sections/main-blog.liquid articles_per_page min 5 / max 24 / default 6; 354 articles -> ceil(354/6) = 59 pages. 346/355 articles untagged (5 tags), no tag hubs; homepage links only to the blog index. rel=next present but unused by Google since 2019. Collections share the same snippet (/collections/all 8 pages, /collections/haine-mnx 4).
findings.affected_scope: ~340 of 354 articles (everything beyond page 2) + paginated collections
findings.recommendation: 1) Theme editor -> Blog -> Articles per page = 24 (15 pages). 2) Add numbered links in snippets/pagination.liquid using {%- for part in paginate.parts -%} (link when part.is_link, aria-current span for the current page). 3) Tag the articles into 8-12 topic tags and link /blogs/news/tagged/<tag> hubs from the blog index and a related-articles block in sections/main-article.liquid; add 3-5 related-article links on product pages. 4) Add an HTML sitemap page (/pages/harta-site) linked from sections/footer.liquid.
findings.falsifiability: A crawl depth report shows max click depth from / <= 5 for all /blogs/news/* URLs; URLs still at depth > 10 mean failure
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Crawled - currently not indexed' and 'Discovered - currently not indexed' counts for /blogs/news/ URLs; crawl frequency of deep articles

findings.title: Empty 'Reduceri' collection is a 200, indexable, in both sitemaps (soft-404 candidate)
findings.evidence: parsed/pages_collection-reduceri.json: title 'Reduceri', H1 'Reduceri', canonical self, 400 words of header/footer boilerplate, 0 product cards; listed in sitemaps child3.xml and child9.xml; work/hu-reduceri.html confirms the /ro-hu/ twin. Admin: 0 products, no SEO title/description. 144 of 185 products carry compare-at prices.
findings.affected_scope: 2 URLs, linked from navigation on every page
findings.recommendation: Turn it into an automated collection (condition 'Compare at price > 0' -> 144 discounted products) with a 150-word description and SEO title 'Reduceri suplimente | Prime Supplements', or set seo.hidden = 1 until it has products; the collection.products_count == 0 branch of the TECHNICAL-03 block covers it automatically.
findings.falsifiability: GSC URL inspection shows Indexed with products or Excluded by noindex; 'Soft 404' means neither fix applied
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Pages 'Soft 404' count

findings.title: /pages/thank-you is indexable and in the sitemap (English title, no H1, no meta description)
findings.evidence: Live GET /pages/thank-you -> 200, <title>Thank you</title>, canonical self, no meta robots, no meta description, no <h1>, 459 visible words (page-specific text is a B2B registration confirmation), 220 KB; listed in sitemaps child2.xml and child8.xml.
findings.recommendation: Set metafield seo.hidden = 1 on the page (sitemap removal + noindex) and/or rely on the page.handle == 'thank-you' branch of the TECHNICAL-03 Liquid block; retitle 'Multumim - inregistrare B2B'.
findings.falsifiability: Sitemap no longer contains /pages/thank-you; page source contains noindex
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Excluded by noindex' includes the URL

findings.title: Shopify's automatic vendor/type pseudo-collections are live, indexable and self-canonical (/collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1, /collections/types?q=)
findings.evidence: tech/live/vendors.body: 200, <title>primesupplements1</title>, H1 'primesupplements1', canonical https://primesupplements.ro/collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1, 24 product cards, no meta description. tech/live/types.body: /collections/types?q= -> 200, title 'Prime Supplements', empty H1 (<split-lines></split-lines>), 24 product cards, canonical self; /collections/types?q=Supliment -> 404 (productType empty on 185/185). robots.txt has no rule for these paths. 0 vendor links in 14 local pages (no vendor block in templates/product.json), but snippets/vendor.liquid would emit url_for_vendor links if enabled; 64 products carry vendor 'primesupplements1'.
findings.affected_scope: 2 known URLs + one per vendor value and any q= value
findings.recommendation: Fix vendor 'primesupplements1' -> 'Prime Supplements' on 64 products and populate productType (ecommerce); noindex via the collection.handle == 'vendors' or 'types' branch of the TECHNICAL-03 block; later add Disallow: /collections/vendors, /*/collections/vendors, /collections/types, /*/collections/types in templates/robots.txt.liquid.
findings.falsifiability: curl -s 'https://primesupplements.ro/collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1' | grep -c noindex = 1
findings.leading_indicator: GSC query report no longer shows the page for 'primesupplements1'

findings.title: Tag-filtered collection and blog URLs are 200, self-canonical and indexable with duplicated titles
findings.evidence: Live GET /collections/all/creatina -> 200, canonical self, title and H1 'All Products' (identical to /collections/all), 3 product cards, no meta description. tech/live/tag.body: /blogs/news/tagged/sanatate -> 200, canonical self, title and H1 'Ultimele articole' (identical to the blog index). 97 distinct product tags x 23 collections = up to 2,231 crawlable tag URLs; robots.txt blocks only '+' combinations. No internal links to tag URLs found (blog-post-card prints tags as text).
findings.affected_scope: Potentially thousands of thin URLs; 1 confirmed per pattern
findings.recommendation: noindex via current_tags.size > 0 branches (collection and blog) in the TECHNICAL-03 block; if blog tag hubs are built (TECHNICAL-04), drop the blog branch and give hubs unique titles using current_tags in sections/main-blog.liquid; normalise the 97 tags (lower-case, singular).
findings.falsifiability: /collections/all/creatina source contains noindex; blog tag hub titles differ from 'Ultimele articole'
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Duplicate without user-selected canonical' / 'Crawled - currently not indexed' for /collections/*/* and /tagged/ URLs

findings.title: <meta charset> is the third element of <head> (byte 1,078, after a synchronous external script and a JSON-LD block), breaking the 1,024-byte rule
findings.evidence: Live layout/theme.liquid head order: {% render 'schema-organization' %}, <script src="{{ 'pandectes-rules.js' | file_url }}"></script>, <meta charset="utf-8">, viewport. Rendered on all 13 main-store pages: first element <script type="application/ld+json"> (~1 KB), pandectes-rules.js at byte 1,022 (synchronous, no defer/async), <meta charset> at byte 1,078; on article-thin-lcarnitine.html the charset is at byte 2,254 because an app injects another script ahead of it. The sync script blocks parsing of title, canonical, viewport and CSS preloads.
findings.recommendation: Reorder layout/theme.liquid: <meta charset>, <meta viewport>, theme-color, <title>, description, canonical, then the Pandectes script (keep synchronous only if blocking mode is required, else defer; it must still precede content_for_header), then {% render 'schema-organization' %} at the end of head.
findings.falsifiability: curl -s https://primesupplements.ro/ | head -c 1024 | grep -c 'meta charset' = 1; Lighthouse charset audit passes
findings.leading_indicator: Lighthouse best-practices 'charset' audit and lower 'Eliminate render-blocking resources' estimate

findings.title: Viewport maximum-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=1.0 disables pinch-zoom on every page
findings.evidence: layout/theme.liquid: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, height=device-height, minimum-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0">; verbatim on all 13 local pages and the live /ro-hu/ product. Fails Lighthouse accessibility meta-viewport audit and WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4.
findings.recommendation: Change to <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> (Impact's default). Not a ranking factor but part of page-experience/accessibility checks.
findings.falsifiability: Page source no longer contains maximum-scale; Lighthouse a11y meta-viewport passes
findings.leading_indicator: Lighthouse accessibility score; mobile bounce rate on product pages

findings.title: Every page ships 221-617 KB of HTML with a 157-189 KB <head>, 131-170 KB of inline JavaScript and 67-72 script tags (20 external)
findings.evidence: Homepage 617 KB (head 167 KB, inline JS 145 KB, inline CSS 43 KB, 69 scripts / 20 external); product pages 337-393 KB (head 166 KB, inline JS 147-152 KB, 71-72 scripts); /collections/all 430 KB (head 188 KB, inline JS 168 KB); /pages/contact 221 KB for 221 words. Largest inline blocks: window.jdgmSettings 30.4 KB, Shopify web-pixel loader 24.6 KB, window.mktr 19.3 KB, window.PandectesSettings 16.3 KB. 12 external scripts from cdn.shopify.com/extensions app embeds (koala-upsell-gift 120 KB, dondy-whatsapp 64 KB br, judgeme loader, pop-convert, affiliate x2, estimator, bloggenauto tracking.js) + GTM, portable-wallets 78 KB br, perf-kit 26 KB br, es-modules-shim 15 KB. Five render-blocking stylesheets incl. 2 Google Fonts CSS and judgeme shopify_v2.css.
findings.affected_scope: All templates; mobile LCP/INP most exposed (no field data)
findings.recommendation: Disable unused app embeds (pop-convert, estimator, bloggenauto tracking.js, affiliate if inactive); load the WhatsApp bubble after first interaction; enable Judge.me async/minimal settings; route Clarity/TikTok/Pinterest/Facebook through GTM with consent-gated triggers; re-measure with PSI when quota allows. Target < 250 KB HTML and < 10 external scripts on product pages.
findings.falsifiability: curl -s https://primesupplements.ro/products/creatina-creapure | wc -c < 260,000 and fewer than 45 <script tags after clean-up
findings.leading_indicator: PSI/CrUX mobile INP and LCP p75 for the product template; GSC Core Web Vitals 'Poor URLs'

findings.title: Fontify app loads Google Fonts Poppins (all 18 styles) + Bebas Neue render-blocking while the theme preloads its own Barlow fonts that are then overridden
findings.evidence: home.html: <!-- BEGIN app block: shopify://apps/fontify/blocks/app-embed/... --> followed by preconnect cdn.nitroapps.co, stylesheet fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue and fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:ital,wght@0,100;...;1,900 (18 variants) plus two duplicate rel=prefetch of the same CSS. layout/theme.liquid preloads settings.heading_font/text_font = Barlow (barlow_n7, barlow_n4 woff2) and css-variables sets --heading-font-family/--text-font-family: Barlow; Fontify overrides with a 'Poppins !important' rule. fonts.googleapis.com HEAD returned 0 bytes in perf/asset-sizes-part2.txt (extra connection).
findings.recommendation: Remove Fontify; set Poppins and Bebas Neue as theme fonts in Theme settings -> Typography (Shopify font library, served from fonts.shopifycdn.com with the existing preloads), loading only weights 400/500/700. If Fontify stays, restrict weights and drop the prefetch duplicates.
findings.falsifiability: grep -c fonts.googleapis.com and grep -c barlow on the homepage both 0 after the change
findings.leading_indicator: Lighthouse 'Ensure text remains visible during webfont load' and render-blocking audits; homepage hero LCP

findings.title: 2,582 blog links point at primesupplements1.myshopify.com, so every product link in the blog is a 301 hop
findings.evidence: catalog-analysis.md: 2,582 in-body links to primesupplements1.myshopify.com in 349 articles (1,602 product, 534 /cart/, 446 collection), each product linked twice (primary + myshopify). Verified: 23 myshopify links in article-2026-citicolina.html. Live https://primesupplements1.myshopify.com/products/creatina-creapure -> 301 to primary (cache-control: private, no-store). The 534 /cart/ links are Disallowed in robots.txt.
findings.affected_scope: 349 of 354 articles; the most-linked products receive half their internal links via redirects
findings.recommendation: Bulk replace https://primesupplements1.myshopify.com/ -> https://primesupplements.ro/ in article bodies (Admin API articleUpdate or BlogGenAuto store-URL setting); convert /cart/<variant>:1 links to product-page links; de-duplicate double product links.
findings.falsifiability: grep -c myshopify.com on any article HTML = 0 after the job
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Links report internal link counts to primary-domain product URLs; Crawl stats redirect share dropping

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod churn: all 185 products and 21/23 collections carry today's identical timestamp
findings.evidence: sitemaps/child1.xml: 185/185 product <lastmod> = 2026-10-12T17:33:42+03:00 (one identical value); child3.xml: 21 of 23 collections 2026-10-12. Articles healthy (354 entries, 90 distinct dates). Shopify derives lastmod from updated_at, so an app/sync is touching every product daily and the signal is worthless to Google.
findings.recommendation: Identify the writer via Admin activity / Admin API events on one product (inventory sync, BSS B2B pricing, Koala); make syncs write only on change. Verify next day's sitemap spreads lastmod values again.
findings.falsifiability: grep -o '<lastmod>[^<]*' sitemap_products_1.xml | sort -u | wc -l > 20 within a week; if it stays 1, a daily writer is still active
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Crawl stats 'By purpose: refresh' share for product URLs

findings.title: Trailing-slash variants return 200 (duplicate URL per page, mitigated by canonical)
findings.evidence: Live GET /products/baton-proteic-capsuni/ -> 200, 345,073 bytes (identical to the non-slash page), canonical and og:url https://primesupplements.ro/products/baton-proteic-capsuni. No internal links with trailing slashes in 14 local pages. Shopify does not 301 trailing slashes and URL redirects have no wildcards.
findings.recommendation: No platform change possible; keep the correct canonical and ensure external/campaign links and the blog never use the slash form; monitor in GSC.
findings.falsifiability: GSC 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical' listing /.../ URLs would mean the canonical is being overridden
findings.leading_indicator: Trailing-slash URLs in GSC 'Alternate page with proper canonical tag'

findings.title: http://www is a two-hop redirect chain
findings.evidence: http://www.primesupplements.ro/ -> 301 https://www.primesupplements.ro/ -> 301 https://primesupplements.ro/ (live-tech/http_www.hdr, www_https.hdr; same on a product URL in tech/live/chain_httpwww.hdr). http://primesupplements.ro/ and https://www are single hops. HSTS has no includeSubDomains/preload.
findings.affected_scope: Any inbound link or typed URL using http://www
findings.recommendation: Platform-managed on Shopify/Cloudflare; ensure every citation, directory, GBP, social profile and ad uses https://primesupplements.ro/ (non-www).
findings.falsifiability: curl -sIL http://www.primesupplements.ro/ | grep -c '^HTTP/' = 3 today; cannot be reduced on Shopify
findings.leading_indicator: Backlink audit share of http://www link targets

findings.title: Three handles contain percent-encoded diacritics and the canonical tag uses a different encoding case than the sitemap/hreflang
findings.evidence: all-urls.txt: /pages/termeni-%C8%99i-condi%C8%9Bii, /blogs/news/bcaa-vs-eaa-diferen%C8%9Be-%C8%99i-beneficii-pentru-culturisti-ghid-complet, /blogs/news/water-out-tinctura-solu%C8%9Bia-naturala-pentru-eliminarea-reten%C8%9Biei-de-apa (upper-case hex). pages/article.html: canonical and og:url use lower-case %c8%9be-%c8%99i while hreflang on the same page uses upper-case %C8%9Be-%C8%99i (three spellings of one URL on one page).
findings.recommendation: Rename handles to ASCII (termeni-si-conditii, bcaa-vs-eaa-diferente-si-beneficii-pentru-culturisti, water-out-tinctura-solutia-naturala-retentie-apa) with 'Create a URL redirect' ticked; keep future handles ASCII-only.
findings.falsifiability: Sitemap no longer contains %C8; old URLs 301
findings.leading_indicator: GSC shows the ASCII URL as canonical

findings.title: URL hygiene: 57 sitemap URLs exceed 100 characters, 42 article handles end in -2...-5 and 134 contain English fragments
findings.evidence: all-urls.txt: 57 primary URLs > 100 chars (longest 124: /blogs/news/creatina-si-volumizarea-musculara-secretele-absorbtiei-creatinei-optimizare-rezultate; one product at 119 chars). 42 article handles end in -2..-5 (e.g. /blogs/news/acetyl-l-carnitine-l-carnitine-1000-80-caps-2). 134 article handles contain English words (-travel-, -workout-, -benefits-, -guide-). Slugs repeating the head term 2-3 times (spirulina-spirulina-...).
findings.recommendation: Handle during blog consolidation: when merging -N duplicates keep the shorter handle and 301 the rest; cap new handles at 5-7 Romanian words. Do not mass-rename ranking URLs for length alone.
findings.falsifiability: Count of sitemap URLs > 100 chars decreasing after consolidation
findings.leading_indicator: Cannibalisation groups in catalog-analysis.md shrinking

findings.title: The empty /search page is indexable while /search?q= is not
findings.evidence: tech/live/search_empty: GET /search -> 200, no x-robots-tag, canonical https://primesupplements.ro/search, title 'Cauta', meta description = homepage description; GET /search?q=creatina -> x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow. /search is linked twice on every page (header).
findings.recommendation: request.page_type == 'search' branch in the TECHNICAL-03 block (noindex, follow).
findings.falsifiability: /search source contains noindex
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Excluded by noindex' includes /search

findings.title: og:image is emitted with http:// on every page
findings.evidence: home.html: <meta property="og:image" content="http://primesupplements.ro/cdn/shop/files/prime-supplements.jpg?v=1747657200&width=2048">; product pages likewise (http://primesupplements.ro/cdn/shop/files/01_BATONPROTEIC_strawberry_front.jpg...), 1 insecure URL per page; og:image:secure_url is https. Source: snippets/social-meta-tags.liquid. CSP upgrade-insecure-requests hides it in browsers but social scrapers fetch the literal http URL.
findings.recommendation: In snippets/social-meta-tags.liquid output https: + {{ image | image_url: width: 1200 }} (protocol-relative) or apply | replace: 'http://', 'https://'.
findings.falsifiability: grep -c 'content="http://' on any page = 0
findings.leading_indicator: Facebook Sharing Debugger shows no image warning

findings.title: Stale resource hints: dns-prefetch productreviews.shopifycdn.com (retired app) and preconnect cdn.nitroapps.co (Fontify) plus duplicate font prefetches
findings.evidence: layout/theme.liquid hard-codes <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://productreviews.shopifycdn.com"> while Judge.me is the review app; cdn.nitroapps.co appears exactly once on the page (the preconnect injected by the Fontify app block) with no asset loaded from it; two rel=prefetch duplicates of the Google Fonts CSS already loaded as stylesheets.
findings.recommendation: Delete the productreviews.shopifycdn.com line from layout/theme.liquid; removing Fontify (TECHNICAL-12) removes the other three.
findings.falsifiability: Hints absent from page source
findings.leading_indicator: None (micro-optimisation)

findings.title: Security headers are platform-limited: HSTS 91 days without preload/includeSubDomains, no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, minimal CSP
findings.evidence: All 200 responses: strict-transport-security: max-age=7889238 (about 91 days, no includeSubDomains/preload); content-security-policy: block-all-mixed-content; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests; (no default-src/script-src); no referrer-policy (only the Cloudflare 429 page sends same-origin); no permissions-policy. x-frame-options: DENY and x-content-type-options: nosniff present.
findings.affected_scope: All responses; Shopify does not expose response headers to merchants
findings.recommendation: No platform action possible; document as accepted (not a ranking input). Optionally add <meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"> in layout/theme.liquid.
findings.falsifiability: n/a (platform)
findings.leading_indicator: None

findings.title: 30 fully out-of-stock products are indexable and in the sitemap; the index also lists two empty child sitemaps

findings.recommendation: Archive products that will not return and 301 their handles to the parent collection; keep seasonal apparel live with a back-in-stock notice and alternatives block; schema specialist to mark availability OutOfStock. Empty child sitemaps need no action.

No rule for /search, /collections/vendors, /collections/types, /collections/<handle>/<tag>, /blogs/news/tagged/, /ro-hu/; no AI-crawler rules or Content-Signal (agentic_fix.py robots proposes Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no; owned by seo-agentic).

Do not disallow /ro-hu/ (Google must see canonical/noindex) or /search (header already handles it).

findings.title: Structured data is present on every template but duplicated and partly invalid (detail owned by the schema specialist)
findings.evidence: JSON-LD block counts: homepage 2, product 3-4, collection 2, article 2 from the theme plus 4 embedded by BlogGenAuto in the article body (6 on article-2026-citicolina.html: duplicated Article/BreadcrumbList/FAQPage/Person). layout/theme.liquid has {%- comment -%}{%- render 'microdata-schema' -%}{%- endcomment -%} (theme's maintained snippet disabled); custom snippets carry the newline-escaping bug (Product JSON invalid on 7/13 sampled, Article 2/2).

results.score_rationale: Product JSON-LD is unparseable on 75/185 products (65 of 85 supplements) because the hand-built snippet uses `escape` instead of `json`; the 110 blocks that parse still fail merchant-listing eligibility (AggregateOffer, "8,50" comma-decimal strings, no price/rating/return/shipping). Articles carry two conflicting Article entities (theme + BlogGenAuto) with myshopify-domain breadcrumbs and placeholder jobTitles; the Organization logo URL returns 404 and the entity has no NAP. Only the Organization/Breadcrumb skeleton and retired-feature FAQ blocks work.
what_works: JSON-LD only (no microdata/RDFa), https @context and absolute primary-domain URLs on every block
Organization node with stable @id, sameAs and logo object emitted in <head> on all 31 sampled pages
BreadcrumbList valid on 16/16 product pages; CollectionPage+ItemList valid on 6/6 collections; Article has mainEntityOfPage, ISO dates, 1200px image
gtin emitted whenever the first variant has a barcode (188/395 variants); images capped at 5 x 1000px
Judge.me already writes native reviews.rating / reviews.rating_count metafields (baton-proteic-capsuni = 4.0 / 4) so ratings can be added server-side
Shopify-maintained microdata-schema.liquid ({{ product | structured_data }}, WebSite, Breadcrumb) is still in the theme, only commented out
Homepage FAQPage questions are visible on the page

findings.title: Product JSON-LD is syntactically invalid on 75/185 products (76% of supplements) because `escape` does not encode newlines
findings.evidence: snippets/schema-product-enhanced.liquid: "description": "{{ product.description | strip_html | truncate: 500 | escape }}". Parse errors on local copies: product.html/baton-proteic-capsuni.html 'Invalid control character at: line 7 column 38 (char 212)', creatina-creapure (char 566), glycerol-max-pump (626), frutilu-cola (372), mnx-hoodie-industrial (216), pure-isolate (676), turmeric (218), unt-de-migdale (554). 9/17 sampled Product blocks unparseable; schema_ecommerce_validate.py on $R/jsonld/product-baton-1.jsonld -> 'Error: invalid JSON'. Replaying the filter chain over $R/shopify/products-p1..4.json: 75/185 products invalid (65 supplements, 10 MNX), 87 with empty description.
findings.affected_scope: 75 product URLs (150 with /ro-hu/), all best-selling supplements; these pages have no Product entity at all
findings.recommendation: Replace with $A/findings/schema-fixes/snippets/schema-product-enhanced.liquid (every value through | json). Minimal patch: "description": {{ product.description | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip | truncate: 5000 | json }}, and | json for name/sku/gtin/category/image URLs. Deploy on an unpublished duplicate theme, test with Rich Results Test on /products/baton-proteic-capsuni and /products/creatina-creapure.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test still reports 'Unparsable structured data' on those URLs, or json.loads on the block still throws
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Enhancements > Product snippets / Merchant listings valid items from 0 to ~185 within 2-4 weeks

findings.title: Parseable Product blocks are still ineligible: AggregateOffer with comma-decimal strings, no per-variant Offer, no price
findings.evidence: Live snippet: offers = AggregateOffer with lowPrice/highPrice via money_without_currency -> "8,50"/"100,00" (baton), "145,00" (MNX blue tee), "100,00"/"180,00" (creapure); no price, no per-variant priceCurrency/availability, no priceValidUntil; availability is product-level. Validator on $R/jsonld/product-mnx-blue-1.jsonld: [High] merchant-listing-offer-type (Offer required, not AggregateOffer), [Medium] recommended-offer-price, missing-return-policy, missing-shipping-details, recommended-product-description. 106/185 products have >1 variant (395 variants). Validator on the fixed render $A/findings/schema-fixes/examples/baton-proteic-capsuni.product.jsonld: ok=true, 0 Critical/High (only not-applicable missing-member-program + Info no-product-group).
findings.recommendation: v2 snippet: one Offer per product.variants with "price": {{ variant.price | divided_by: 100.0 | json }} (8.5, 100.0), priceCurrency from localization.country.currency.iso_code, priceValidUntil next 31 Dec, availability from variant.available, sku, gtin13, itemCondition, url with ?variant=. Emit priceSpecification as a single UnitPriceSpecification object (the validator crashes on arrays; Google's example uses one object).
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test must list Merchant listings eligible with per-variant prices 8.5 RON / 100 RON; if it shows price range only or 'Invalid number', the fix failed
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Merchant listings valid items; Shopping-tab impressions for product queries

findings.title: No aggregateRating/review in the markup although Judge.me stores ratings as native metafields
findings.evidence: aggregateRating absent in all 17 product HTML copies. Judge.me app blocks in templates/product.json (preview_badge, review_widget) render only HTML badges: <div class='jdgm-prev-badge' data-average-rating='4.00' data-number-of-reviews='4'> on baton; sample pages show 4.75/44, 4.77/13, 4.79/17, 5.00/7; data-shop-reviews-count="124". No application/ld+json containing jdgm in the HTML (client-side only). Admin GraphQL on product 14971464450423: reviews.rating = {"scale_min":"1.0","scale_max":"5.0","value":"4.0"} (type rating), reviews.rating_count = 4 (number_integer).
findings.affected_scope: Every product with >=1 Judge.me review (star rich results lost on each)
findings.recommendation: Emit server-side from metafields (in v2 snippet): assign rating = product.metafields.reviews.rating.value; rating_count = product.metafields.reviews.rating_count.value; if present output AggregateRating {ratingValue: rating.rating, bestRating: rating.scale_max, worstRating: rating.scale_min, ratingCount/reviewCount}. Do not also enable Judge.me's rich-snippet JSON-LD toggle (would duplicate the Product entity).
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test on /products/baton-proteic-capsuni shows 'Review snippets: 1 valid item' with 4.0/4
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Enhancements > Review snippets valid items; product-query CTR

findings.title: BlogGenAuto injects a second, conflicting JSON-LD graph into 347/355 article bodies (myshopify breadcrumbs, placeholder jobTitle)
findings.evidence: 344 bodies contain Article+FAQPage+BreadcrumbList+Person, 3 an @graph (Article+FAQ+Breadcrumb); 8 clean. On /blogs/news/citicolina-conexiune-musculara-rutina-antrenament-seara-travel-2026 two Article entities with the same headline: author Person 'Marius Chera , Nutriționist Certificat' (body) vs Organization 'Prime Supplements' (theme); two descriptions; datePublished 2026-04-14T02:20:02.026Z vs 2026-04-14T05:20:02+0300; body breadcrumb last item .../citicolina-conexiune-musculara-rutina-seara-2026 != canonical (32/347 breadcrumbs mismatch). Blog-wide: 265 body blocks contain myshopify.com; breadcrumb items on https://primesupplements1.myshopify.com (532) and https://primesupplements1.com (6) vs primesupplements.ro (188); publisher 'primesupplements1' (3); Person.jobTitle has 5 values incl. literal placeholder 'Professional title based on niche' (26 articles); Person.name 'Marius Chera , Nutriționist Certificat' (333) + variant spelling (2); no @id/sameAs on 344 Persons; author photo author-photo-primesupplements1-myshopify-com.jpg.
findings.recommendation: One Article entity per page, from the theme. Strip in-body <script type="application/ld+json">...</script> via a one-off Admin API articleUpdate pass (same job as the myshopify-link clean-up) and disable schema injection in BlogGenAuto. Keep visible FAQ sections if wanted; only the hidden JSON-LD goes. The theme BlogPosting (SCHEMA-05) then carries the Person author with real jobTitle and LinkedIn sameAs.

findings.title: Theme Article block: same `escape` bug (invalid on >=6 articles), author always Organization, no publisher logo, headline not capped
findings.evidence: snippets/schema-article.liquid: "description": "{{ article.excerpt_or_content | strip_html | truncate: 300 | escape }}" -> invalid JSON on pages/article.html (bcaa-vs-eaa, 'Invalid control character at: line 6 column 19 (char 166)') and article-thin-lcarnitine.html (char 433). Simulation over 355 articles: 6 hand-written articles without excerpt break; 349 with single-line BlogGenAuto excerpts parse (the context's '2 of 2' sample was skewed). author is hard-coded Organization 'Prime Supplements' although article.author contains 'Marius Chera' on 335/354 articles; publisher has no logo; image is a bare string; headline uncapped (3 titles >110 chars, max 134); dates use %z (+0300); no @id, no inLanguage; generic Article not BlogPosting.
findings.recommendation: Replace with $A/findings/schema-fixes/snippets/schema-article.liquid: | json everywhere, BlogPosting, author Person 'Marius Chera' (jobTitle, url /pages/despre-noi, sameAs LinkedIn) when article.author contains 'Marius Chera', Organization only for the 18 'primesupplements1' articles, publisher logo ImageObject, image ImageObject with width/height, headline | truncate: 110, %:z offsets, wordCount, articleSection, keywords. Example that parses: $A/findings/schema-fixes/examples/article-bcaa.example.jsonld.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test on /blogs/news/bcaa-vs-eaa-... reports an Article with author.name 'Marius Chera'; json.loads succeeds
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Articles enhancement report: 0 invalid items

findings.title: No hasMerchantReturnPolicy / shippingDetails, and the two policy pages disagree on the free-shipping threshold
findings.evidence: Validator on every parseable Product: missing-return-policy, missing-shipping-details; nothing on Organization either. Site data: /pages/politica-de-retur '14 zile de la data la care ne-ați comunicat retragerea'; /pages/politica-de-livrare 'Livrare are costul de 20 RON', 'GRATUITĂ pentru comenzile ce depășesc 300 RON', '1-3 zile lucrătoare', Cargus; but /pages/termeni-și-condiții says free over 700 RON and '2 – 4 zile lucratoare'.
findings.recommendation: v2 snippet adds on every Offer: MerchantReturnPolicy {applicableCountry RO, MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow, merchantReturnDays 14, ReturnByMail, returnFees customer responsibility (confirm), merchantReturnLink /pages/politica-de-retur} and OfferShippingDetails {20 RON, DefinedRegion RO, handling 0-1 day, transit 1-3 days}; Organization v2 publishes the return policy site-wide (#return-policy). Align Terms page with delivery page (300 vs 700 RON) first.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test > Merchant listings lists Shipping details and Return policy; a later GSC 'conflicts with Merchant Center' warning would mean wrong numbers
findings.leading_indicator: Merchant-listing annotations visible in Shopping results for 'prime supplements creatina'

findings.title: Product breadcrumb category is 'All Products' (or the internal '11% TVA' collection) on every product

Long term build crumbs from product.type.

Ioan Virgil Ispas nr. 17A, Cisnădie, Sibiu, 555300, RO), contactPoint with phone and Mo-Fr 09-17, availableLanguage ['ro'], founder Person, foundingDate 2022, site-wide MerchantReturnPolicy, logo from Settings > Brand (PNG >=112px) with fallback file; move the render below <meta charset>. findings.title: brand hard-coded for all products (wrong for 100 MNX items), category empty, sku/gtin from one variant, 207/395 variants without barcode
findings.evidence: "brand": 'Prime Supplements' on 185 products incl. 100 MNX apparel. product.vendor unusable as-is: 'primesupplements1' on 64 products, 'Prime Supplements' on 121 (native markup on the B2B store already shows brand 'primesupplements1'). Recommended: (b) now with schema-website replacing the native WebSite part; (a) after fixing vendor/type if no developer is available. Exactly one Product and one Article entity per page.

findings.evidence: $R/pages/b2b-product.html (/products/creatina-creapure on the B2B store) emits native Product JSON-LD with brand 'primesupplements1', @id '/products/creatina-creapure#product', Organization 'PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL / 46260823'; the main store emits the same name/description with brand 'Prime Supplements' and Organization 'Prime Supplements'. 58 B2B product URLs share handles with the main store.
