findings.falsifiability: site:b2b.primesupplements.ro returns 0 results after noindex
findings.leading_indicator: n/a

findings.title: Colour/flavour variants published as separate products prevent ProductGroup markup
findings.evidence: Validator Info no-product-group on every MNX product; 19 near-duplicate title groups / 45 products (MNX colours, Frutilu flavours) published as separate products, so ProductGroup/variesBy/hasVariant cannot be expressed.
findings.recommendation: Merge siblings into variants (catalogue task); then Shopify native structured_data emits ProductGroup automatically, or extend the v2 snippet with ProductGroup + variesBy color.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test shows a ProductGroup with hasVariant on an MNX tee
findings.leading_indicator: n/a

findings.title: Sale prices (compare-at on 144/185 products) not expressed; no priceValidUntil / itemCondition
findings.evidence: Baton variants: compareAtPrice 155.00/12.50 vs price 100.00/8.50 in Admin, strikethrough shown on page, markup has only lowPrice/highPrice. Google supports UnitPriceSpecification priceType StrikethroughPrice; priceValidUntil and itemCondition absent.
findings.affected_scope: 144 products with compare-at prices; all 185 for recommended fields
findings.recommendation: In v2 snippet: priceSpecification {UnitPriceSpecification, priceType StrikethroughPrice, price = compare_at, priceCurrency} when compare_at_price > price; priceValidUntil next 31 Dec; itemCondition NewCondition.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test on baton shows price 100 RON with strikethrough 155 RON
findings.leading_indicator: 'Price drop' badge in Shopping/organic product results

findings.title: Missing schema tied to existing content: ProfilePage for the author, ContactPage, VideoObject
findings.evidence: 335 articles are signed by Marius Chera and /pages/despre-noi carries his bio (NPC PRO coach, company data) with no Person/ProfilePage markup; /pages/contact has NAP in HTML but only the generic Organization block; product pages embed a YouTube gallery app block (youtube_gallery_carousel_widget_block) with no VideoObject.
findings.recommendation: ProfilePage + Person (@id ...#marius-chera, jobTitle, sameAs LinkedIn, knowsAbout) on /pages/despre-noi, ContactPage on /pages/contact, VideoObject (name, description, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, embedUrl) for product videos. No HowTo; FAQPage only as Info.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test on /pages/despre-noi shows ProfilePage
findings.leading_indicator: Author entity appearance on 'Marius Chera' brand queries

limitations: No Rich Results Test / Search Console / Merchant Center access; eligibility inferred from Google's documented requirements and the plugin validator (which ignores the EU energy-class rule and crashes on priceSpecification arrays).

Liquid could not be executed in the sandbox; the v2 snippets were validated via a hand-rendered example with real catalogue values; the metafields.reviews.rating.value.rating access path follows Shopify docs but was not executed.

Catalog-wide counts (75/185 invalid Product, 6/355 invalid Article, 21 entity-fidelity cases) come from replaying the Liquid filter chain in Python on Admin exports; the 17 product + 4 article live copies agree (9/17 and 2/4 invalid).
Judge.me metafields verified on one product only (baton-proteic-capsuni).
Facebook/Instagram/TikTok sameAs correctness inferred from recon fetch sizes; postal code 555300 and VAT prefix must be confirmed by the owner.
Live requests limited to one HEAD (Organization logo -> 404); all page analysis used the local copies dated 2026-10-12.

results.score_rationale: Structure, validity, size and catalogue coverage are flawless because Shopify generates the files (185/185 products, 354/354 published articles, 11/11 pages, 23/23 collections, robots.txt declares the index, all URLs https and unique). The score is dragged down by what the sitemap tells Google: 575 of 1151 URLs (50.0%) are /ro-hu/ market duplicates of the other half, 370 product entries carry a lastmod equal to the request time (Google must discard it), 10-12 URLs are utility/empty/thank-you pages, the B2B host submits 52 duplicate product handles, and 708 entries are unfiltered machine-generated articles.
what_works: All 13 sitemap files are valid XML (sitemaps.org 0.9 + Google image 1.1), split by content type behind one index; 1151 URLs / 660,023 bytes total, largest child 234,346 bytes (2.3% of the 50k-URL limit).
robots.txt (live, line 116) declares Sitemap: https://primesupplements.ro/sitemap.xml; index served as application/xml; charset=utf-8, HTTP/2 200, cf-cache-status DYNAMIC (always fresh).

Coverage is complete: 185/185 active products, 354/354 published articles (the one unpublished article is correctly absent), 11/11 pages, 23/23 collections; the 33-page-deep blog pagination does not limit discovery.
All <loc> values are https, on the primary host, unique, with no query strings, sort/filter/pagination URLs or trailing-slash variants.
Article and page lastmod values are genuine (354 distinct article values tracking Admin updatedAt; e.g. 22 stamped on the 2026-09-14 bulk-edit day).
The 6 live-checked sitemap URLs all return 200 with no redirect chains; /ro-hu/sitemap.xml is 404 so the root index is the single entry point; no <priority> tags; max 1 image per URL.

findings.title: The /ro-hu/ market subfolder duplicates every URL in the sitemap (575 of 1151)
findings.evidence: Index lists 6 /ro-hu/ children; child7..12.xml hold 185 products + https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu + 11 pages + 23 collections + 1 blog + 354 articles = 575 URLs; set comparison: ro-hu set == main set minus agents.md. Live HEAD /ro-hu → 200, HEAD /ro-hu/products/baton-proteic-capsuni → 200. Both trees self-canonical with the same hreflang triplet (x-default→/, ro→/, ro-HU→/ro-hu) per $R/parsed/home.json, pages_homepage-ro-hu.json, pages/article.html. Admin GraphQL (read-only): Market 'Ungaria' gid://shopify/Market/97830830455 ACTIVE, web presence gid://shopify/MarketWebPresence/73400189303 subfolderSuffix 'hu', defaultLocale ro, alternateLocales []; shopLocales hu published=false. Same Romanian content and RON prices on both trees.
findings.affected_scope: 575 URLs = 50.0% of the sitemap (every product, collection, page, article and the homepage)
findings.recommendation: A (now): Settings → Markets → Ungaria → Domains and languages → remove the /ro-hu subfolder web presence (or deactivate the market); Shopify regenerates sitemap.xml in real time (576 URLs remain) and the ro-HU hreflang disappears; verify live whether /ro-hu/* then 301s or 404s (no wildcard redirects in Shopify; add individual redirects only for /ro-hu/ URLs with GSC clicks). B (only if Hungary is a real target): publish the hu locale with full translations, make it the market default, enable HUF. C (stop-gap, leaves URLs in sitemap): in layout/theme.liquid `{%- if localization.market.handle == 'ungaria' -%}<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"><link rel="canonical" href="{{ canonical_url | replace: 'primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/', 'primesupplements.ro/' | replace: 'primesupplements.ro/ro-hu', 'primesupplements.ro/' }}">{%- else -%}<link rel="canonical" href="{{ canonical_url }}">{%- endif -%}`.
findings.falsifiability: After the change `curl https://primesupplements.ro/sitemap.xml | grep -c ro-hu` returns 0 and children sum to 576 URLs; if /ro-hu/ children remain, the market web presence was not removed.
findings.leading_indicator: Count of <loc> containing /ro-hu/ (575 → 0); GSC 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' / 'Alternate page with proper canonical tag' counts for /ro-hu/ URLs.

findings.title: Product lastmod is the sitemap generation time: identical for all 185 products and different on every fetch
findings.evidence: child1.xml: 185/185 products lastmod 2026-10-12T17:33:42+03:00 (file saved 14:33 UTC); child7.xml (/ro-hu/, fetched 5 s later): 185/185 = 2026-10-12T17:33:47+03:00; live re-fetch at 18:43 local ($S/live/products_live.body): 185/185 = 2026-10-12T18:43:36+03:00. Admin updatedAt differs for all 185 (citrus-bergamot 2026-10-07T07:35:48Z, vitamina-d3-k2 2026-09-16T01:01:57Z; only 41 products updated on 2026-10-12). Same pattern on the B2B store (57/57 = 2026-10-12T17:48:30+03:00) → platform behaviour. Homepage entry inside the products sitemap has no lastmod.
findings.affected_scope: 370 product entries (185 + 185 /ro-hu/); credibility of lastmod for the whole sitemap
findings.recommendation: Not changeable in Admin/theme (Shopify-generated). Treat product lastmod as absent: after real product changes request indexing via GSC URL Inspection and keep genuine on-page freshness signals (updated Product JSON-LD, visible content). A supplementary product sitemap with true dates would need an app that hosts its own XML (Shopify Files is on cdn.shopify.com, another host, acceptable only if declared via Sitemap: in templates/robots.txt.liquid). Do not spend more budget on it.
findings.falsifiability: Fetch sitemap_products_1.xml twice 60 s apart; if lastmod values are identical across fetches and differ between products, the finding no longer holds.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Crawl stats 'By purpose: refresh' share for /products/ URLs after a real catalogue change.

findings.title: Collection lastmod is bulk-stamped (21 of 23 within two seconds)
findings.evidence: child3.xml: 23 entries, 4 distinct lastmod values; 11 = 2026-10-12T14:41:08+03:00, 10 = 2026-10-12T14:41:07+03:00; only alimente-sanatoase (2026-10-08T14:40:42+03:00) and reduceri (2025-06-23T11:36:44+03:00) differ. Cause: automated collections re-stamp when member products change, and products are rewritten in batches (products-all.json updatedAt clusters: 9 at 2026-09-07T14:51, 7 at 2026-10-12T11:09, 6 at 2026-10-12T09:50, 6 at 2026-10-09T11:10).
findings.recommendation: Identify the app that rewrites products daily (Settings → Apps and sales channels → app permissions with write_products; candidates: Koala upsell/gift, Judge.me, affiliate app, BlogGenAuto, inventory/ERP sync) and restrict it; collection lastmod then becomes meaningful. No sitemap-side action exists.
findings.falsifiability: After taming the sync, sitemap_collections_1.xml shows ≥10 distinct lastmod values spread over weeks.
findings.leading_indicator: Distinct lastmod values in sitemap_collections_1.xml (4 → ≥10).

findings.title: Utility and triple-duplicate collections are submitted as indexable landing pages (all, cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, 11-tva, frontpage)
findings.evidence: sitemap_collections_1.xml lists /collections/all, /collections/cele-mai-vandute, /collections/lansate-recent; products-all.json: each contains the identical 185-product set (three URLs, six with /ro-hu/, for one list plus ?page=N series). /collections/11-tva = 15 products (scortisoara-ceylon-bio-200g, emperor-mass_3000g, pure-isolate-2000g, unt-de-arahide/-migdale/-caju, instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv, fiber-blood-orange, 7 crema-de-orez SKUs), internal VAT grouping titled '11% TVA', no SEO title/description. /collections/frontpage = theme 'Home page' collection with 1 product (baton-proteic-capsuni). All 200, self-canonical, no robots meta ($R/parsed/pages_collection-all.json, pages_collection-11tva.json); no description, no image (7 collections lack an image entry: frontpage, cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, reduceri, all, 11-tva, crema-de-orez).
findings.affected_scope: 5 collections = 10 sitemap URLs plus paginated variants; 23 collections total
findings.recommendation: Use Shopify's documented lever, metafield seo.hidden (namespace seo, key hidden, type number_integer, value 1): adds noindex,nofollow AND removes the resource from the sitemap (shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/marketing/optimize-storefront-seo; also hides from storefront search). Create the definition (Settings → Custom data → Collections) and set 1 on 11-tva and frontpage (tax overrides and the homepage section keep working). Keep ONE browse-all page (/collections/all with SEO title 'Toate produsele | Prime Supplements' + 150-250-word description); hide the other two with seo.hidden=1 or make them real (cele-mai-vandute = 12-24 curated best-sellers; lansate-recent = tag 'nou', last 90 days). Owner-run GraphQL: metafieldsSet(metafields:[{ownerId:"gid://shopify/Collection/<id>", namespace:"seo", key:"hidden", type:"number_integer", value:"1"}]).
findings.falsifiability: sitemap_collections_1.xml lists 18-20 URLs and GET /collections/11-tva contains noindex,nofollow; if still listed, the metafield namespace/type is wrong.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical' for /collections/cele-mai-vandute and /collections/lansate-recent; collection URL count in sitemap (23 → 18-20).

findings.title: The empty 'Reduceri' collection is submitted while 144 products actually carry a discount
findings.evidence: child3.xml entry https://primesupplements.ro/collections/reduceri (+ /ro-hu/ twin), lastmod 2025-06-23T11:36:44+03:00 (untouched 16 months), no image; products-all.json: 0 products in reduceri; live HEAD → 200; title 'Reduceri', no SEO title/description, indexable ($R/pages/collection-reduceri.html). 144/185 products have compare_at_any = true. Soft-404 candidate on the strongest commercial keyword ('reduceri suplimente').
findings.affected_scope: 2 URLs; 144 discounted products without a hub page
findings.recommendation: Admin → Products → Collections → Reduceri → Automated, condition 'Compare-at price is greater than 0' (optionally AND inventory > 0); add SEO title 'Reduceri suplimente și haine de sală | Prime Supplements', meta description, intro text, image; link from the main menu. If no sale hub is wanted, set seo.hidden=1 so it leaves the sitemap.
findings.falsifiability: /collections/reduceri renders ≥1 product; GSC no longer lists it under Soft 404 / Crawled - currently not indexed.
findings.leading_indicator: Product count on the collection page (0 → ~100+); GSC impressions for the URL.

findings.title: The B2B thank-you confirmation page is submitted and indexable
findings.evidence: child2.xml entry https://primesupplements.ro/pages/thank-you (lastmod 2025-06-16T09:13:27+03:00) + /ro-hu/ twin; pages.json: handle thank-you, templateSuffix 'thank-you-b2b', body '' (empty); live HEAD → 200; grep -ri noindex $R/theme/ → 0 hits. It is the post-registration target of /pages/inregistrare-b2b (template 'b2b', body 100 chars, also submitted).
findings.recommendation: Online Store → Pages → thank-you → Metafields → seo.hidden = 1 (definition under Settings → Custom data → Pages): page stays published for the B2B redirect, gets noindex,nofollow and leaves sitemap_pages_1.xml. Theme-only fallback (does NOT remove it from the sitemap): in layout/theme.liquid before </head> `{%- if page.handle == 'thank-you' -%}<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">{%- endif -%}`. Keep inregistrare-b2b indexable but give it a real H1/intro and SEO title.
findings.falsifiability: sitemap_pages_1.xml lists 10 URLs and /pages/thank-you serves the noindex meta.
findings.leading_indicator: Pages count in sitemap_pages_1.xml (11 → 10); GSC indexed status of /pages/thank-you.

findings.title: Image entries cover only the featured image (185 of 493 product images) and use deprecated tags
findings.evidence: child1.xml: exactly one <image:image> per product (185; catalogue has 493 product images; 128 products expose fewer images than they have, e.g. baton-proteic-capsuni 2 → 1). Every product image entry has <image:title> and an EMPTY <image:caption></image:caption> (185/185); articles: 354 <image:title>, 335 <image:caption>; Google deprecated these tags in 2022. Collections: 16/23 with an image.
findings.recommendation: Platform-generated, not editable. Lever is on-page: Google discovers gallery images from product HTML, so make them discoverable and described (493/493 product images currently have empty alt). Upload a collection image for the 7 collections without one (Admin → Collections → Image). Deprecated tags: no action.
findings.falsifiability: Google Images impressions for /products/ pages do not grow after alt text is added.
findings.leading_indicator: Collections with <image:image> in sitemap_collections_1.xml (16 → 23); GSC Search type = Image impressions.

findings.title: <changefreq> on all 1151 entries (ignored by Google)
findings.evidence: Every <url> has a changefreq: daily on 418 entries (home, 370 products, 46 collections), weekly on 733 (pages, blogs, articles, agents.md); <priority> absent. Google ignores changefreq and priority.
findings.recommendation: None possible (Shopify output); harmless.
findings.falsifiability: n/a
findings.leading_indicator: n/a

findings.title: Sitemap index carries no <lastmod> per child and an XML comment
findings.evidence: $R/sitemap.xml: 13 <sitemap><loc> entries, 0 <lastmod>; a comment node ('This is the parent sitemap ... can not be edited manually, but is kept up to date in real time'); child locs use ?from=...&to=... (valid, escaped). Google re-fetches all 13 children on every visit (660 KB).
findings.recommendation: None (Shopify output); irrelevant at this size.
findings.falsifiability: n/a
findings.leading_indicator: n/a

findings.title: Two empty metaobject sitemaps are referenced by the index
findings.evidence: child6.xml and child12.xml (sitemap_metaobject_pages_1.xml + /ro-hu/ twin): 172 bytes each, <urlset> with 0 <url>; live HEAD → 200. No metaobject definitions with web-page rendering exist.
findings.recommendation: No defect. Opportunity: metaobject-driven pages (ingredient glossary 'creatina', 'beta-alanina', athlete pages) are added to this sitemap automatically once a definition has storefront access + web pages enabled and templates/metaobject/<definition>.json exists.
findings.falsifiability: n/a
findings.leading_indicator: URL count in sitemap_metaobject_pages_1.xml.

findings.title: The agentic discovery sitemap submits a generic Shopify Markdown file
findings.evidence: child0.xml (sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml): single entry https://primesupplements.ro/agents.md, changefreq weekly, no lastmod, no /ro-hu/ twin. $R/agents.md is Shopify's boilerplate 'Agent Instructions' (identical to /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt); robots.txt line 2 also advertises it. The sitemap asks Google to index a text document with zero site-specific content.
findings.recommendation: Platform-controlled (Shopify agent layer), no Admin switch found, harmless. Real llms.txt content is the agentic specialist's scope.
findings.falsifiability: n/a
findings.leading_indicator: Whether agents.md appears in site:primesupplements.ro results.

findings.title: Three diacritic handles are percent-encoded with a different hex case than their canonical tags
findings.evidence: Sitemap (uppercase hex): /pages/termeni-%C8%99i-condi%C8%9Bii, /blogs/news/bcaa-vs-eaa-diferen%C8%9Be-%C8%99i-beneficii-pentru-culturisti-ghid-complet, /blogs/news/water-out-tinctura-solu%C8%9Bia-naturala-pentru-eliminarea-reten%C8%9Biei-de-apa (×2 with /ro-hu/). On $R/pages/article.html the canonical and og:url use lowercase hex (diferen%c8%9be-%c8%99i) while the hreflang tags on the same page use uppercase: three byte-different spellings across sitemap, canonical and hreflang. articles-all.json flags exactly these 2 handles; pages.json has handle 'termeni-și-condiții'.
findings.recommendation: Rename handles to ASCII with 'Create a URL redirect' ticked: termeni-si-conditii, bcaa-vs-eaa-diferente-si-beneficii-pentru-culturisti-ghid-complet, water-out-tinctura-solutia-naturala-pentru-eliminarea-retentiei-de-apa; update the footer/legal menu link; configure BlogGenAuto to transliterate diacritics in handles.
findings.falsifiability: Live sitemap children contain 0 '%' characters and the old URLs 301.
findings.leading_indicator: Count of %-encoded <loc> entries (6 → 0).

findings.title: 30 products with zero available inventory remain submitted and indexable
findings.evidence: products-all.json available_any = false for 30 of 185 sitemap products: 22 MNX apparel (mnx-extra-t-shirt-industrial-black/-bronze/-navy-blue, mnx-extra-t-shirt-hc-2-0-limited-white/-black/-burgundy/-dark-grey, mnx-extra-t-shirt-basic-grey/-vivid-red/-light-pink, mnx-workout-top-golden-era-deep-purple, mnx-workout-top-hammer-3-0-white/-black/-grey, mnx-ribbed-shorts-hammer-black/-white/-grey/-green-lint, mnx-shorts-golden-era-2-0-black, mnx-extra-t-shirt-embossed-mosaic-blue, mnx-shaker-600-ml, tricou-sala-made-of-iron-bumbac-premium-negru) and 8 supplements/accessories (vitamina-d3-k2, zinc-citrate-80-caps, sapca-prime, baton-proteic-ciocolata-fructe-de-padure, water-out-500-ml, shaker-premium-accesorizat-500-ml, instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv, enzima-nattokinaza-80-caps). instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv is one of the 5 most blog-linked products (23 articles) and sold out.
findings.affected_scope: 30 products (60 entries) = 16% of the product sitemap
findings.recommendation: Restocking soon: keep (sitemap + back-in-stock capture). Discontinued MNX colourways: status Draft/Archived (drops from sitemap, URL 404s) plus URL redirect to the surviving colour or style collection, or the Unlisted product status (noindex + removed from sitemap, still purchasable by link). Restock or mark pre-order the 8 supplement SKUs, starting with instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv.
findings.falsifiability: After clean-up, count of sitemap products with available_any = false < 10.
findings.leading_indicator: Sold-out products in the sitemap (30 → <10); Merchant Center out-of-stock warnings.

findings.title: The B2B store publishes a crawlable sitemap with 52 of the retail store's product handles
findings.evidence: Live GET https://b2b.primesupplements.ro/sitemap.xml → 200 (1,018 bytes, 6 children). $R/pages/b2b-products-sitemap.xml: 57 product URLs + homepage; 52 handles identical to retail (e.g. /products/baton-proteic-capsuni, /products/creatina-creapure) with the same image filenames (01_BATONPROTEIC_strawberry_front.jpg); lastmod 2026-10-12T17:48:30+03:00 on 57/57. b2b robots.txt (live, 3,660 bytes) is Shopify default: User-agent: * / Allow: /, Sitemap declared, no Disallow: /; no noindex, no cross-domain canonical. 5 B2B-only handles: baton-proteic-alune-si-caramel, baton-proteic-ciocolata-caramel, baton-proteic-ciocolata-portocale, baton-proteic-lamaie-fructe-de-padure, liver-protect-500-ml.
findings.affected_scope: 52 retail product URLs duplicated on a second host; 5 products missing from retail
findings.recommendation: (1) Online Store → Preferences → restrict access with password on the B2B store (every URL renders the noindexed password page); or at minimum (2) templates/robots.txt.liquid on the B2B theme with `User-agent: *\nDisallow: /` (no Sitemap line) and `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">` in its layout/theme.liquid; (3) if it must stay public, cross-domain canonical on the 52 shared handles: `<link rel="canonical" href="https://primesupplements.ro/products/{{ product.handle }}">`. Decide whether the 5 B2B-only flavours should be published retail (they join sitemap_products_1.xml automatically).
findings.falsifiability: site:b2b.primesupplements.ro returns 0 results after 4-8 weeks; GSC URL Inspection no longer shows a b2b.* Google-selected canonical for retail products.
findings.leading_indicator: Indexed pages for b2b.primesupplements.ro (site: query); GSC 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical' with a b2b.* canonical.

findings.title: Quality gate: 708 of 1151 entries are unfiltered machine-generated articles
findings.evidence: sitemap_articles_1.xml = 354 URLs (×2 = 708, 61.5% of all entries), all changefreq weekly. articles-all.json: 347/355 bodies contain the BlogGenAI marker, 42 handles end in -2/-3/-4/-5 (regenerated topics), 47 cannibalisation groups covering 164 articles, 279 titles contain 2025/2026, bursts up to 10 articles on 2026-05-15 (127 in 2026-05). The seo-sitemap skill classifies 'AI-generated pages without human review' as penalty-risk at scale. Location-page gates: 0 location pages, no doorway risk.
findings.recommendation: Make the sitemap reflect the blog clean-up: for each of the 47 groups keep the winner and hide or merge the losers (Admin → Blog posts → Visibility: Hidden + URL redirect to the winner); hide the 42 regenerated -2/-3/-4/-5 variants unless they are the better article. Shopify removes hidden articles from sitemap_articles automatically (verified: the one unpublished article is absent). Resubmit sitemap.xml in GSC and watch 'Crawled - currently not indexed' for /blogs/news/.
findings.falsifiability: Article count in sitemap_articles_1.xml stays at 354 after the clean-up → the hidden flag was not applied.
findings.leading_indicator: URL count in sitemap_articles_1.xml (354 → ~250-290); GSC 'Crawled - currently not indexed' for /blogs/news/.

limitations: No Search Console access: submitted/indexed counts, sitemap processing errors, 'Discovered/Crawled - currently not indexed' buckets and Google-selected canonicals could not be read.
HTTP status verified live for 6 sitemap URLs only (bot protection; 11 total live requests, no 429); the other 1,145 URLs were validated against the Shopify Admin exports instead of crawled.
sitemap_discovery.py and the other fetching plugin scripts cannot run in this sandbox (proxy policy, not a site issue); discovery used the local index copy plus curl.
The theme export lacks the page templates (page.thank-you-b2b.json, page.b2b.json), so template-level robots rules could not be inspected (exported layout and sections contain no robots meta).
Shopify's exact behaviour for /ro-hu/ URLs after removing the market web presence (301 vs 404) must be verified live after the change.
$R/sitemaps/all-urls.txt lacks a trailing newline (1150 lines for 1151 URLs); counts come from the XML files.

results.score_rationale: The store's only international configuration (Shopify market "Ungaria" with a /ro-hu web presence, default locale ro, no alternate locales, hu locale unpublished, no HUF) delivers zero localisation while duplicating all 575 indexable URLs with 98.6-99.6% identical Romanian text, showing ex-VAT prices exactly ÷1.21 on the duplicate tree (also inside Product JSON-LD) and contradicting the store's own Romania-only delivery terms. The hreflang markup itself is technically valid (full mesh, x-default, valid ro/ro-HU codes, canonical-aligned), html lang and content-language headers are correct, and the unpublished hu locale does not leak (/hu -> 404), which keeps the score above the floor.
what_works: hreflang set is technically well-formed on every sampled page: self-referencing tag, full return mesh (x-default -> /, ro -> /, ro-HU -> /ro-hu/...), one x-default, valid ISO 639-1/3166-1 codes, all https, hreflang href equals canonical on both trees (recon/parsed/home.json, pages_homepage-ro-hu.json, pages_product.json, live /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure).
Single implementation method (HTML link tags via Shopify content_for_header); no xhtml:link hreflang in any sitemap child (grep -c hreflang = 0 on all 13), so no HTML/sitemap conflict.
<html lang="ro" dir="ltr"> on both trees (theme.liquid line 12 uses request.locale.iso_code) and the content-language header is ro-RO on / and ro-HU on /ro-hu/... (consistent with body language).
Unpublished Hungarian locale does not leak: /hu -> HTTP 404, /ro-hu/sitemap.xml -> 404, no third URL tree.
No IP/Accept-Language redirects or cloaking: / with Accept-Language hu-HU returns the ro-RO page with Shopify.country = "RO"; Pandectes geolocation flags all false.
A Hungary delivery zone with two active Cargus methods exists in the default delivery profile, so a properly launched Hungarian market would not block checkout.
limitations: No GSC / Merchant Center / GA4 access: Google-selected canonicals for /ro-hu/ URLs, impressions by country and price-mismatch issues could not be observed; statements about Google's behaviour rest on documented canonicalisation/hreflang rules plus the measured 98.6-99.6% content identity. The GSC International Targeting report no longer exists (removed 2022).
No WebSearch in this agent's tool list, so live SERP presence of /ro-hu/ URLs (site: queries) was not checked.
Prices on /ro-hu/ verified on the homepage (77 displayed prices, all /1.21) and one product (creatina-creapure); products in the '11% TVA' collection were not sampled and would show /1.11.

Only the /ro-hu homepage and one /ro-hu product page were fetched live (8 of 15 allowed requests, no 429); the other 573 duplicates were assessed from the sitemap and Shopify's deterministic market rendering.
Census figures for Romanian speakers in Hungary (~0.03M) and Hungarian speakers in Romania (~1.0M, 2021) are cited from memory at order-of-magnitude precision to support the strategic argument only.
No test order was placed; checkout behaviour for Hungarian addresses (HUF rate conversion, tax lines) is inferred from Admin API delivery-profile and tax settings.

findings.title: "Ungaria" market web presence publishes a complete second copy of the site under /ro-hu/ (575 duplicate URLs, identical Romanian content, both self-canonical)
findings.evidence: Admin API: market Ungaria gid://shopify/Market/97830830455 enabled, webPresence gid://shopify/MarketWebPresence/73400189303 subfolderSuffix "hu", defaultLocale ro, alternateLocales [], rootUrls https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/, currencySettings null; shopLocales hu published=false; enabledPresentmentCurrencies [RON]. Live sitemap index lists 13 children, 6 under /ro-hu/ (products/pages/collections/blogs/articles/metaobject); child7=186, child8=11, child9=23, child10=1, child11=354 -> 575 /ro-hu URLs of 1151 (49.96%), 185 image:loc entries duplicated. Homepage text 3099 words on both, difflib similarity 0.9856 (diffs only prices + selector label); /products/creatina-creapure vs /ro-hu/... 1651 words both, similarity 0.9955. Duplicate is self-canonical (<link rel=canonical href=https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure>) and fully self-linked (168 /ro-hu/ links, 0 root links on /ro-hu homepage; 75 vs 0 on product). /ro-hu and /ro-hu/ both HTTP 200, content-language ro-HU, 630865 bytes. Files: $R/sitemaps/child*.xml, $R/home.html, $R/pages/homepage-ro-hu.html, $S/intl/sitemap_index.xml, $S/intl/body_rohu_product.html.
findings.affected_scope: All 575 indexable URLs (185 products, 23 collections, 11 pages, 1 blog index, 354 articles, homepage) exist twice; crawl surface 1151 instead of 576 URLs; 185 product images listed twice. Google will cluster each pair, pick the root URL as canonical in most cases and drop the ro-HU alternate; crawl budget doubled on a 630 KB-per-page site behind Cloudflare 429 challenges.
findings.recommendation: Option (a) now: Settings -> Markets -> Ungaria -> Domains and languages -> Manage -> remove the /ro-hu web presence (API equivalent: marketWebPresenceDelete(webPresenceId: "gid://shopify/MarketWebPresence/73400189303"); documented, not executed) or, if Hungary is not a target, Deactivate market (marketUpdate status INACTIVE), which also removes the country selector automatically (footer.liquid line 133 condition). Shopify has no wildcard redirects: generate 575 one-to-one redirects from $R/sitemaps/all-urls.txt (/ro-hu/<path> -> /<path>, /ro-hu -> /) as CSV and import at Online Store -> Navigation -> URL redirects -> Import. Verify: curl -I /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure -> 301; sitemap.xml lists 7 children; no hreflang tags on /. Resubmit sitemap in GSC. Option (b): same without deactivating (country switch via cookie on the same URLs; still fix the tax flip). Option (c): see INTERNATIONAL-10, a separate resourced project.
findings.falsifiability: Wrong if GSC Page indexing shows /ro-hu/ URLs as Indexed with their own impressions (Performance filtered page contains /ro-hu/, country Hungary). Expected after fix: 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' for /ro-hu/ drops to 0 within 4-8 weeks; site:primesupplements.ro/ro-hu returns nothing.
findings.leading_indicator: Sitemap index child count 13 -> 7; Shopify.country never "HU" in page source; HTML crawl requests per day in Crawl stats roughly halve within 2-4 weeks.

findings.title: /ro-hu/ hreflang alternates show different prices for the same products (ex-VAT, exactly /1.21) in the same RON currency, including inside Product JSON-LD with the same @id
findings.evidence: Root /products/creatina-creapure: 'Preț redus 180,00 lei', product JSON "price":18000, JSON-LD lowPrice 100,00 / highPrice 180,00 RON ($R/pages/product-creatina-creapure.html). Alternate /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure: 'Preț redus 148,76 lei', "price":14876, JSON-LD lowPrice 82,64 / highPrice 148,76 RON ($S/intl/body_rohu_product.html). 180/148.76 = 1.2100 = Romanian standard VAT 21%. Homepage cards: "price":20000 vs 16529; all 77 displayed lei prices lower by the same factor (71 x 1.210, 5 x 1.211, 1 x 1.208 rounding) while the ten '300 RON' free-shipping strings and all copy are identical. Root cause: shop.taxesIncluded = true (Admin API) + country-based tax inclusion with no HU tax registration -> HU market strips 21% VAT; currencySettings null so it is a cheaper RON, not HUF. Custom snippet schema-product-enhanced.liquid emits the same "@id": "https://primesupplements.ro/products/creatina-creapure#product" on both URLs with two different AggregateOffer ranges.
findings.affected_scope: All 185 products plus collection/homepage/search cards under /ro-hu/; every price in page text, product JSON and JSON-LD; any Romanian visitor who selects 'Ungaria' in the selector.
findings.recommendation: Removing the web presence (INTERNATIONAL-01) removes the duplicate URLs, but the net-price flip survives for anyone selecting Ungaria while the market stays active. Either deactivate the market, or Settings -> Taxes and duties -> untick 'Include or exclude tax based on your customer's country' (keep 'Include tax in prices' on) so every market sees the same gross RON price, or register a HU/OSS VAT rate under Taxes and duties -> European Union. Re-check: curl -sS -A "<UA>" https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure | grep -o '"price":[0-9]*' | head -1 must return 18000 or the URL must 301.
findings.falsifiability: Wrong if /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure returns "price":18000; confirmed by the captured 14876. After the fix: Merchant Center price-mismatch issues for landing pages containing /ro-hu/ = 0; URL Inspection of a /ro-hu/ product shows 'not on Google' or a redirect.
findings.leading_indicator: No page with Shopify.country === "HU" exists, or product JSON price on /ro-hu/ equals the root price.

findings.title: hreflang set is technically valid but semantically unjustified: ro-HU targets Romanian speakers in Hungary with zero localisation, while the realistic second audience (Hungarian speakers in Romania, hu-RO) is not served
findings.evidence: Every page emits exactly 3 tags, e.g. on /: x-default -> https://primesupplements.ro/, ro -> https://primesupplements.ro/, ro-HU -> https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu ($R/home.html); the /ro-hu copy emits the identical set (full mesh). Codes valid (ro ISO 639-1, HU ISO 3166-1), so Google accepts the hint. The ro-HU page offers identical Romanian text, RON (Shopify.currency active RON on both), Romania-only legal pages, no Hungarian UI (shopLocales.hu.published=false), no HUF (currencySettings null). Per the skill's MT-QA table, alternates identical except header chrome are the strongest 'template-wrapped, untranslated' signal. Romanian speakers in Hungary ~0.03M vs Hungarian speakers in Romania ~1.0M (2021 census, 6%), all inside the store's only delivery territory and VAT regime. /hu -> 404; Accept-Language hu-HU -> Romanian page.
findings.affected_scope: 1151 URLs x 3 hreflang link tags (3453 tags) with no targeting benefit; Hungarian-speaking demand inside Romania has no landing experience.
findings.recommendation: Short term: let the tags disappear with the web presence (INTERNATIONAL-01). Medium term, if a Hungarian-language audience is wanted, add Hungarian as an alternate locale of the Romania market rather than a Hungary market: Settings -> Languages -> publish hu after human-reviewed translation (Translate & Adapt: 185 products, 23 collections, 11 pages, 354 articles, theme strings) -> Settings -> Markets -> Romania -> Domains and languages -> add Hungarian. Shopify then serves /hu/... with hreflang hu-RO, same RON prices, VAT, Cargus shipping and (translated) legal pages. Validate demand first in GA4 (Reports -> User -> Demographics -> Language share of hu) and GSC queries (kreatin, fehérje por). Never publish unreviewed machine translation (scaled content abuse policy).
findings.falsifiability: If ro-HU were justified, GSC Performance filtered Country = Hungary would show meaningful impressions for /ro-hu/ URLs; expected ~0. For hu-RO: GA4 language share hu > ~3% of sessions justifies the investment, < 1% does not.
findings.leading_indicator: hreflang tags per page 3 -> 0 (option a) or hu-RO tags present with translated title/H1 (locale launch).

findings.title: Shipping and legal content contradict the Hungary market: store ships to HU with Hungarian-named, HUF-priced Cargus rates while the delivery policy and Terms say delivery is Romania-only; no Hungarian legal pages
findings.evidence: Admin API: shop.shipsToCountries ["HU","RO"]; delivery profile 'General profile' (gid://shopify/DeliveryProfile/126905287031) zone Hungary (gid://shopify/DeliveryZone/646731989367) with active 'Cargus Gyorsfutár' 3900.0 HUF and 'Cargus Ingyenes szállítás' 0.0 HUF, beside zone Romania 'Livrare Cargus' 20.0 RON / 'Livrare Gratuită Cargus' 0.0 RON. $R/shopify/pages.json politica-de-livrare (163 words): 'Livrarea produselor se face prin curier rapid pe teritoriul României ... Livrare GRATUITĂ pentru comenzile ce depășesc 300 RON. Livrare are costul de 20 RON ... Cargus'; 0 hits for Ungaria/Hungary/HUF. termeni-și-condiții (3952 words): 'Livrarea Produselor se poate efectua doar pe teritoriul României' and 'doar pe teritoriul Romaniei'; jurisdiction 'instanțelor din România'; ANPC. politica-de-retur covers the Romanian 14-day procedure only. Store presents RON only (enabledPresentmentCurrencies [RON]) yet HU rates are stored in HUF (~49 RON at ~80 HUF/RON). /ro-hu/pages/politica-de-livrare serves the same Romania-only text (sitemap child8).
findings.affected_scope: 2 shipping methods, 4 legal pages (x2 URLs), every Hungarian checkout; trust/E-E-A-T contradiction on the URLs Google is told are for Hungary.
findings.recommendation: Decide the market explicitly. Not a target: deactivate the Ungaria market and delete the Hungary zone (Settings -> Shipping and delivery -> General profile -> Hungary -> delete) so shipsToCountries becomes ["RO"] and the policies become true. Target: keep the zone, re-price in RON (or re-enable HUF as market currency), add a Hungary paragraph (threshold, courier, delivery time, withdrawal address) to delivery/return/terms and translate them (INTERNATIONAL-10).
findings.falsifiability: graphql_query { shop { shipsToCountries } } returns ["RO"] (option a) or politica-de-livrare contains a Hungary paragraph (option c). A test checkout with a Hungarian address today showing a shipping line the policy does not describe confirms the contradiction.
findings.leading_indicator: Number of countries in shipsToCountries; presence of 'Ungaria'/'Magyarország' in politica-de-livrare.

findings.title: Country selector rendered three times per page, offers two countries with the same currency ('România (RON Lei)' / 'Ungaria (RON Lei)'), no language option, and silently cuts prices by 17.36%
findings.evidence: home.html: 3 localization forms (ids localization-form-country--sections--24912813293943__header, localization-form-country-end-sections--24912813293943__header, localization-form-country--sections--24912813261175__footer), each with options value="RO" aria-selected and value="HU"; labels 'România (RON Lei)' x4 and 'Ungaria (RON Lei)' x3 (x4 on the /ro-hu copy); identical on the product page. snippets__localization-selector.liquid renders {{ country.name }} ({{ currency.iso_code }} {{ symbol }}) so the two entries differ only by country word; button aria-label 'Schimbă țara sau moneda' promises a currency change that cannot happen. No locale selector (footer.liquid line 137 needs >1 language). country-flags.css loaded 3 times (country-flags--RO x6, --HU x3). Selecting Ungaria POSTs the form, sets Shopify.country HU, lands on /ro-hu/ and drops every price /1.21 with no notice while the '300 RON' free-shipping text stays.
findings.affected_scope: Header (2 instances) + footer on all 1151 URLs; 3 stylesheet requests per page for a selector with no useful effect.
findings.recommendation: Disappears automatically when the market is deactivated. If the market is kept (option b), hide the selector in the theme editor (Header -> 'Show country/region selector' off; Footer -> same) so visitors are not invited to switch to an identical-currency market; never expose a country switch whose only visible effect is a net price.
findings.falsifiability: grep -c 'name="country_code"' home.html = 0 after the change; today 6 option buttons.
findings.leading_indicator: Count of localization-form-country-* ids in the page source (today 3).

findings.title: /ro-hu homepage exists in two 200 URL forms (/ro-hu and /ro-hu/); canonical, hreflang and sitemap use the no-slash form while the market's rootUrls says /ro-hu/
findings.evidence: $S/intl/hdr_ro-hu.txt and hdr_ro-hu_.txt: both HTTP/2 200, content-language ro-HU, identical 630865-byte body. <link rel=canonical href=https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu>, hreflang ro-HU href https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu, og:url https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu, sitemap child7 <loc>https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu</loc> (no slash); Admin API rootUrls[0].url = https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/ (slash); root homepage canonical https://primesupplements.ro/ (slash). Canonical and hreflang agree, so the set is not broken, but the slash variant is a third 200 URL for the same document and is the form Shopify itself advertises.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by removing the web presence. If a subfolder market is kept, try a redirect /ro-hu/ -> /ro-hu in Online Store -> Navigation -> URL redirects; if Shopify rejects it (market roots are reserved), rely on the canonical and ensure no internal link or sitemap entry uses /ro-hu/.
findings.falsifiability: curl -I https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/ returns 301 after the fix; today 200.
findings.leading_indicator: HTTP status of /ro-hu/.

findings.title: Structured data on every /ro-hu/ page declares the root URL as entity URL (@id, url, breadcrumb items) while canonical and og:url declare /ro-hu/
findings.evidence: /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure ($S/intl/body_rohu_product.html): "@id": "https://primesupplements.ro/products/creatina-creapure#product", "url": "https://primesupplements.ro/products/creatina-creapure" (x2), breadcrumb items https://primesupplements.ro and https://primesupplements.ro/collections/all, Organization @id https://primesupplements.ro/#organization; but <link rel=canonical href=https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure> and og:url https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure. The custom snippets (schema-product-enhanced.liquid, schema-breadcrumb-enhanced.liquid) build URLs from shop.url, which ignores the market subfolder, while canonical_url includes it: three different 'this page is' signals on one URL, and one entity id with two offer prices (INTERNATIONAL-02).
findings.affected_scope: All 575 /ro-hu/ URLs with JSON-LD (185 products with Product+Breadcrumb, 354 articles, 23 collections, homepage).
findings.recommendation: Disappears with the web presence. If a subfolder market is ever kept, build schema URLs from request.origin | append: product.url / canonical_url instead of shop.url so the entity URL matches the canonical, and add inLanguage (INTERNATIONAL-09).
findings.falsifiability: On any /ro-hu/ page the Product "url" equals the canonical href; today it does not.
findings.leading_indicator: Count of /ro-hu/ pages whose Product @id points to the root URL.

findings.title: Canonical vs hreflang/sitemap percent-encoding case mismatch on URLs with diacritic handles (canonical lowercase %c8%9b, hreflang and sitemap uppercase %C8%9B)
findings.evidence: $R/pages/article.html: <link rel=canonical href=https://primesupplements.ro/blogs/news/bcaa-vs-eaa-diferen%c8%9be-%c8%99i-beneficii-pentru-culturisti-ghid-complet> vs hreflang x-default/ro/ro-HU hrefs using ...diferen%C8%9Be-%C8%99i.... Sitemap <loc> entries with % are uppercase: child5 2 article URLs (bcaa-vs-eaa-diferen%C8%9Be-..., water-out-tinctura-solu%C8%9Bia-naturala-...), child2 1 page URL /pages/termeni-%C8%99i-condi%C8%9Bii, duplicated in child11 and child8. Google normalises hex case (RFC 3986 2.1) so the cluster is unlikely to break, but the skill's exact-match rule is violated and string-matching tools flag a self-reference mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Rename the three handles to ASCII (bcaa-vs-eaa-diferente-si-beneficii-..., water-out-tinctura-solutia-..., termeni-si-conditii) with 'Create a URL redirect' ticked in Admin; include them in the blog/handle clean-up task.
findings.falsifiability: After renaming, canonical and hreflang hrefs are byte-identical; page/article sitemaps contain no % in <loc>.
findings.leading_indicator: Number of <loc> entries containing % in the page/article sitemaps (today 3).

findings.title: Language metadata gaps: no og:locale, no inLanguage in any JSON-LD, English strings (title tagline, Judge.me heading) on the only Romanian locale
findings.evidence: grep -c og:locale on $R/home.html and $R/pages/homepage-ro-hu.html = 0 (snippets__social-meta-tags.liquid has no locale line); grep inLanguage $R/theme/*.liquid = 0 and no "inLanguage" in home/product/article HTML (Organization, Product, Article, CollectionPage, BreadcrumbList all omit it); <title>Prime Supplements - Hardcore Sports Nutrition</title> and Judge.me 'Let customers speak for us' are English on lang="ro" pages. Positive: <html lang="ro"> and content-language ro-RO / ro-HU are correct.
findings.recommendation: In snippets/social-meta-tags.liquid add <meta property="og:locale" content="{{ request.locale.iso_code }}_{{ localization.country.iso_code }}"> (renders ro_RO); add "inLanguage": "{{ request.locale.iso_code }}" to schema-organization, schema-product-enhanced, schema-article and schema-collection snippets (same files the schema fixes already touch); translate the Judge.me heading in the app settings; give the homepage a Romanian title (on-page finding set).
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test shows inLanguage: ro on a product; Facebook Sharing Debugger shows og:locale ro_RO.
findings.leading_indicator: Presence of og:locale in the homepage head.

findings.title: Hungarian locale exists but is unpublished with no translations, no HUF and no Hungarian legal/shipping content: readiness checklist for a genuine Hungary launch (option c)
findings.evidence: shopLocales -> {locale: hu, published: false}; /hu -> HTTP 404 (title '404 negăsit'); markets.Ungaria.alternateLocales [], currencySettings null; Hungary delivery zone priced in HUF (INTERNATIONAL-04); 0 Hungarian strings (Magyar*) in any captured page. Market-local currency requires Shopify Payments (available to Romanian merchants) or a multi-currency gateway; store presents RON only.
findings.affected_scope: Strategic; nothing is indexable for Hungarian queries today.
findings.recommendation: Only if Hungary is a real commercial target (otherwise option a): (1) demand check (kreatin monohidrát, fehérje por, edzés előtti; competitors gymbeam.hu, builder.hu, myprotein.hu); (2) human-reviewed Hungarian translation of 185 products, 23 collections, 11 pages incl. ÁSZF/terms, delivery, return, privacy with Hungarian consumer-law references, theme locale, Judge.me strings, and a curated subset of the 354 articles (bulk MT = scaled content abuse); (3) Settings -> Languages -> publish hu; Settings -> Markets -> Ungaria -> Domains and languages -> default language Hungarian (subfolder /hu-hu, hreflang hu-HU); (4) Products and pricing -> local currency HUF with rounding; Taxes and duties -> EU -> HU VAT/OSS so HUF prices are gross; (5) re-price the Hungary zone in HUF with a HUF free-shipping threshold stated on the Hungarian delivery page; (6) Hungarian support channel; (7) only then optionally keep ro-HU as an additional language. Better-fit alternative: Hungarian as alternate locale of the Romania market (hu-RO, INTERNATIONAL-03) needing steps (2)-(3) only.
findings.falsifiability: A correct launch shows <html lang="hu"> on /hu-hu/, hreflang hu-HU, Shopify.currency.active HUF, and GSC Performance Country = Hungary impressions rising from the current ~0 baseline.
findings.leading_indicator: shopLocales.hu.published = true with Translate & Adapt showing >= 95% translated resources before the market is re-enabled.

results.category: Content Architecture: semantic clustering, hub-and-spoke, internal links (key: cluster)
results.score_rationale: 355 articles (~530k words) sit on 13 commercial hubs that have zero text, zero hub->spoke links and no taxonomy; the blog is 78 creatine articles for 3 products, 42 literal regenerations (-2..-5 handles), 26 intent x hub groups with 4-11 competing URLs each, and URLs whose keyword is unrelated to the title. Raw material (volume, 1602 product links, a prepared but disabled seo_text section and tag filter in the Impact theme) keeps it above 15.
what_works: 354 published articles, median 1529 words, 348 with tables, 338 citing studies
349/355 articles link to products (1602 links); 243/355 link to a collection in the body (446 links); creatina products receive 142 article links, aminoacizi 102, fibre 92
Dense article graph: 1146 distinct article->article edges, median 3 inbound

templates/collection.json already contains a rich-text section bound to collection.metafields.custom.seo_text (currently disabled: true) and a blog-posts section 'Ghiduri si sfaturi utile' - the theme hooks for hub content and hub->spoke links exist
sections/main-blog.liquid supports tag filtering (show_tags), so editorial hubs per topic can be created with tags alone

Hand-written 2025 articles (bcaa-vs-eaa, ce-este-un-pre-workout-fara-cofeina, water-out-tinctura) target real distinct queries; 'bcaa vs eaa' and 'izolat vs concentrat' SERPs have no Romanian authority page
limitations: SERP overlap is qualitative: WebSearch is US-biased, returned ES/PT/EN pages for Romanian queries and did not honour site:; pairwise shared-URL counts could not be computed - groupings rest on title/handle/product evidence plus 9 qualitative SERP reads; verify keep/301 choices against GSC query->page data before executing
No keyword volumes (no DataForSEO/Keywords Everywhere); 'winnable' judgements rest on SERP composition only
Hub assignment is rule-based (keyword in handle/title, then collection of linked product); 77 articles matched >1 hub and were resolved by handle precedence; ~5% may need manual correction
Could not verify whether collection.metafields.custom.seo_text holds text (needs Admin API read); rendered pages show none and the section is disabled: true
No GSC/GA data: kept URL per intent group chosen by inbound links, recency and handle quality as proxies

findings.title: Every commercial hub is an empty page: 0 words of hub content on 23/23 collections while a prepared seo_text section sits disabled in the template
findings.evidence: $R/pages/collection.html, collection-creatina.html, collection-haine-mnx.html, collection-all.html render no collection description (parsed: 'collection description text: NONE'); Admin: 22/23 descriptions empty, 'Bauturi' = 'Bauturi Sport'; schema-collection.liquid emits "description": "". $R/theme/templates__collection.json section rich_text_e4zxV9 (type rich-text, order position 7) has "content": "{{ collection.metafields.custom.seo_text | metafield_tag }}" and "disabled": true. 530k words of spokes point at pillars with no text.
findings.recommendation:
Set disabled:false on rich_text_e4zxV9 in templates/collection.json (move under 'main' in order); create metafield custom.seo_text (rich text) and write 350-600 words per hub (what/for whom/how to choose/products + 4-8 links to kept spokes with keyword anchors), order: creatina, pudra-proteica, aminoacizi, arzator-de-grasimi, vitamine-si-minerale, prime-health, pre-workout, intra-workout, crema-de-orez, alimente-sanatoase, batoane, bauturi; also fill collection.description with the first paragraph so CollectionPage schema and meta fallback are non-empty. Render guard: {%- assign seo_text = collection.metafields.custom.seo_text | metafield_tag -%}{%- if seo_text != blank -%}

Ghid {{ collection.title }}

{{ seo_text }}
{%- endif -%}
findings.falsifiability: curl -s https://primesupplements.ro/collections/creatina | grep -c 'collection-seo-text' returns 0, or CollectionPage JSON-LD still has "description": ""
findings.leading_indicator: GSC impressions for the 13 collection URLs on non-brand category queries within 4-6 weeks; collection word count > 300

findings.title: Hubs do not link to their spokes: every collection shows the same 3 latest blog posts, so the creatina hub links to oat-cream and L-carnitine articles and to none of its 78 creatina articles
findings.evidence: templates__collection.json section blog_posts_VYj9G8 (type blog-posts, block blog_TeK4Cm with "blog": "news") has no per-collection filter. collection.html, collection-creatina.html, collection-haine-mnx.html, collection-all.html all contain exactly the same 3 article hrefs: /blogs/news/l-carnitine-1000-80-caps-travel-weight-loss-tips, /blogs/news/instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv-mindful-eating-practices-2, /blogs/news/omega-3-crema-de-orez-blueberry-muffin (heading 'Ghiduri si sfaturi utile'); homepage shows the same 3. Hub->spoke links = 0 for 355/355 spokes.
findings.recommendation:
Add metafield custom.guides (list.article_reference, 4-8 kept spokes per hub) and render it in the blog-posts section: {%- assign guides = collection.metafields.custom.guides.value -%}{%- if guides != blank -%}

Ghiduri {{ collection.title | downcase }}

{%- for article in guides limit: 8 -%}{%- render 'blog-post-card', article: article -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- endif -%}. Note blogs.news.articles is capped at the 50 newest in Liquid, so a tag loop alone cannot reach a 355-article blog. Repeat the same links as text anchors inside seo_text.
findings.falsifiability: grep -o '/blogs/news/[^"]*' collection-creatina.html | sort -u lists only creatina articles and differs from collection-haine-mnx.html
findings.leading_indicator: Each kept spoke gains >=1 inbound link from its hub; crawl depth of kept spokes <= 2

findings.title: Creatina cluster: 78 articles (115,757 words) for 3 products cover ~15 intents, each written 3-11 times

results.score_rationale: Internal E-E-A-T model: Experience 4/20, Expertise 7/25, Authoritativeness 5/25, Trustworthiness 13/30 = 29 ("Very low E-E-A-T" band). 347/354 published articles are unreviewed BlogGenAuto output on YMYL topics whose ~1,100 "source" links all point to publisher homepages (NCBI 330/330, Healthline 276/276, Mayo 258/258, WHO 236/236), published under an unverifiable "Nutriționist Certificat" credential with inconsistent bio facts and 26 leaked prompt placeholders; disclaimers exist in 8/355 articles; 102/185 products are under 50 words and 23/23 collections have no copy. Good structure, length, legal pages and Judge.me reviews do not offset the policy exposure.
what_works: Article structure is consistent: median 1,529 words (p25 1,416 / p75 1,620), median 16 H2 + 24 H3, tables in 348/355, FAQ in 344/355; average sentence length 18-21 words.
Bodies are not literal copies: max 5-word-shingle Jaccard between any two articles is 0.083.
High internal-link volume: 5,702 internal links (median 17/article), 114 distinct products linked, 446 collection links.
The six 2025 human-written articles show first-hand product knowledge (e.g. glycerol piece cites a named Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research study).
Core supplement descriptions are substantial: creatina-creapure 600 words, pure-isolate-2000g 653, thermo-core-120-caps 747, max 988; 36/85 supplements list ingredients, 32/85 nutrition values.
Product metadata is not templated: metadata_template.py on 81 pairs gives site_risk low, templated_ratio 0.0 (only 19 brand-suffix flags).

Trust basics exist: Judge.me reviews render (17 on creatina-creapure, 4 on baton-proteic-capsuni), legal pages are real (termeni 3,952 words, confidentialitate 2,132, retur 1,122), NAP on contact page, HTTPS.
content_humanize.py found 0 invisible/watermark characters in all 12 scanned bodies.

findings.title: Blog is scaled, unreviewed generator output on YMYL topics (scaled content abuse exposure)
findings.evidence: 347/355 bodies carry the BlogGenAI HTML comment, injected JSON-LD, 312 <style> blocks, 309 onclick handlers, 347 non-JSON-LD scripts. Velocity: 127 articles in 2026-05 (ISO W20: 46), 10 on 2026-05-15, 7-9/day on 14 other days. Identical template everywhere: 'Key Takeaways' 321, 'Share/Post' 349, 'Top 5 probleme pe care X le rezolvă' 299, in-body price cards 533 (median 2/article), arrow CTAs 1,825 (median 6/article). Unfilled prompt placeholder jobTitle 'Professional title based on niche' in 26 published Person JSON-LD blocks (15 in Sept 2026). 349 bodies open with English 'Published: May 15, 2026'; one published English-title article (fat-burner-x10-pareri-l-carnitine-1000-80-caps) and an unpublished all-English draft; 191 handles contain English prompt fragments; off-topic piece tricou-sala-cele-mai-bune-tricouri-yoga bylined 'Nutriționist Certificat'. No first-hand signals in any sampled 2026 body; content_quality.py (English lexicon) scores them 79-87 on density only.
findings.recommendation: Pause BlogGenAuto scheduling now; triage all 347 generated articles into keep-and-rewrite (~110-130), merge+301 (~190) and delete+301 using the CONTENT-05 cluster map (Shopify URL redirects, bulk CSV); for every kept article do a human editorial pass by the named author, strip generator chrome (price cards, CTAs, 'Top 5', English labels) and add an AI-assistance/review disclosure line; cap cadence at 4-6 reviewed articles/week.
findings.affected_scope: 347 of 354 published articles (98%), ~31% of all 1,151 sitemap URLs
findings.falsifiability: If scaled-content classification were not a risk, GSC would show all 354 articles indexed with impressions; mass 'Crawled – currently not indexed' on /blogs/news/ or a manual action confirms it.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC indexed-page count and impressions for /blogs/news/* 4-8 weeks after triage; share of articles with ≥1 click

findings.title: All 'scientific sources' are homepage links; no real citation exists in the blog
findings.evidence: Body HTML parse of 355 articles: ncbi.nlm.nih.gov linked 330 times, 330/330 to the root URL (0 /pmc/ or /pubmed/); healthline.com 276/276 root; mayoclinic.org 258/258 root; who.int 236/236 root; 0 doi.org/PMID in 355 bodies; EFSA once. 848 paragraphs mention 'studii/cercetări', 315 (37%) with no link at all. Phrasing like 'Conform studiilor publicate de NCBI...' (izolat-proteic-emperor-mass_3000g-protein-for-muscle). Invented stat cards '38% Reducere LDL / 42% Creștere HDL' (colesterol-7-semne-colesterol-marit-ghid); '% Reducere/Scădere/Creștere' cards in 47 articles, 'cu până la N%' in 58, 'N% dintre' in 37, 19 titles with a percentage ('...pe care 85% dintre Sportivi o fac în 2026'). content_verify.py returned claim_count 0 (English-only detector).
findings.recommendation: For each kept article replace homepage links with a numbered 'Surse' list of specific references (PMID/DOI/EFSA opinion; e.g. creatine: Kreider et al. 2017, doi:10.1186/s12970-017-0173-z); delete every unsourced percentage and stat card; editorial rule: no 'studiile arată' without a link to the study.
findings.affected_scope: 347 articles; every article touching a health outcome
findings.falsifiability: Real citations would produce article-level paths; the parse shows 100% root URLs.
findings.leading_indicator: Count of /pmc/, /pubmed/, doi.org, efsa.europa.eu links per YMYL article (target ≥3); unsourced % stat cards (target 0)

findings.title: Health/medical claims without disclaimers, safety information or medical review
findings.evidence: 'nu înlocuiește/nu substituie' disclaimer in 8/355 bodies; 'consultă un medic' 32/355; EU supplement wording 17/355. Topics without safeguards: colesterol 62 articles, tensiune arterială 56, depresie/anxietate 33, diabet 32, sarcină/alăptare 20, copii 20, cancer 5; 'tratează/tratament' 46, 'vindec-' 15, 'previne bolile/cancer/diabet' 25. Examples: colesterol article says bergamot 'acționează similar cu statinele... fără efectele secundare', 'nu provoacă dureri musculare... pentru utilizarea pe termen lung' plus a diagnostic 'Tabel valori colesterol'; hibiscus article claims ACE inhibition; testosterone article claims HPG-axis modulation; 'Sfatul medicului' titles ×2 with no physician named (one authored 'primesupplements1'); creatine piece recommends 20 g/day loading with no renal caveat. Products: warnings on 15/85 supplements, disclaimer 11/85, dosage 28/85; product HTML has 0 hits for 'Avertismente', 'nu înlocuiește', ANSVSA.
findings.recommendation: Add a fixed disclaimer block to sections/main-article.liquid (before schema-article) and to the product description tab in snippets/product-info.liquid (Romanian text provided in the findings file); strip treatment/cure/prevention language and keep only EU-authorised health claims (Reg. 1924/2006 register); add contraindications to every YMYL article; retitle or physician-review the two 'Sfatul medicului' pieces; mandatory custom.warnings and custom.dosage metafields on supplements.
findings.affected_scope: ~200+ articles with condition vocabulary; 85 supplement products
findings.falsifiability: A QRG YMYL 'Lowest' check finds medical advice without qualifications; presence of the disclaimer block is a binary check.
findings.leading_indicator: % of articles/products with disclaimer block (target 100%); count of 'tratează/vindecă/previne boala' phrases (target 0)

findings.evidence: 2,582 links to primesupplements1.myshopify.com in 349 articles (1,602 product, 534 cart, 446 collection), every product link duplicated (primary + myshopify; live page: 27 myshopify occurrences). 534 add-to-cart links like https://primesupplements1.myshopify.com/cart/55180000756087:1 (target=_blank, /cart disallowed in robots.txt). 194 articles end with Powered by BlogGenAuto (live fetch confirmed: no nofollow/sponsored, low-contrast grey) - a widget/template link footprint under Google's link-spam policy. 353 articles use target=_blank on internal links; 309 inline onclick handlers. 'Updated:' always equals 'Published:'; only 29 articles have updatedAt > publishedAt and those are the 2025 pieces whose only change was the bio swap ('Actualizat: 12 martie 2026').

findings.title: Generator-injected markup in bodies: duplicate H1s, in-body JSON-LD duplicating theme schema, invented breadcrumb categories, inline CSS/JS
findings.evidence: 347 bodies embed Article + FAQPage (median 5 Q) + BreadcrumbList + Person JSON-LD alongside the theme's schema-article, giving two Article entities per page (Person vs Organization author). 26 bodies contain an <h1>, 25 identical to the title (two H1s on the page; live apa-de-cocos page shows <h1 class="h0"> plus in-body <h1>); 17 of the 26 were published Sept 2026 (ongoing defect). FAQPage is Info-only (no SERP feature since May 2026).

findings.title: Titles are year-stamped, over-long and clickbait-patterned; 311 teasers are truncated with '...'
findings.evidence: 279/355 titles contain '2026' (stale on 2027-01-01); 245 > 65 chars (median 69, 6 > 100, max 134: 'Cum să Transformi Bioflavonoidele și Ceaiul Verde ... limitations: No Search Console, analytics or SERP data: impact is inferred from content properties, not measured; indexation status of the 354 articles is unknown.

Plugin scorers (content_quality.py, content_verify.py, content_humanize.py) use English lexicons; their numbers are reported but the Romanian-language assessment relies on direct reading and deterministic regex scans. All scores are heuristics, not Google signals.
15 of 355 bodies were read in full or in part; corpus-wide numbers come from scans of all 355, but qualitative judgements are sampled.

Medical accuracy was assessed for plausibility and sourcing only; a clinician should review YMYL pieces before republication. Author credentials (NPC PRO cards, FRCF lecturer, 'Nutriționist Certificat') were not verified against any registry.
One live request was made (apa-de-cocos article); everything else is from the 2026-10-12 local evidence set under the scratchpad recon directory.

results.score_rationale: Delivery mechanics are mostly right (Shopify CDN WebP negotiation confirmed live, srcset/sizes and width/height on theme images, native lazy-loading, fetchpriority=high on the hero) and keep the category off the floor. Image SEO is close to zero: 493/493 product images have no stored alt (storefront falls back to the bare product title so every image of a product shares one alt and sitemap captions are empty), the homepage hero/logo/category tiles and every collection banner have alt="", 40% of product files carry camera/WhatsApp/WordPress names, 327/354 blog images are AI PNGs named with timestamps or the full prompt, and og:image is emitted over http:// on every page.
what_works: Shopify CDN content negotiation confirmed live: 01_BATONPROTEIC_strawberry_front.jpg?width=1200 -> image/webp 51,082 B vs image/jpeg 104,226 B (-51%); Creapure 39,414 vs 88,569 B; hero 2800w 210,712 vs 322,050 B; vary: Accept, cache-control max-age=31557600, Cloudflare HIT.

All theme-rendered (110/127 on home, all cards, gallery, banners) have srcset (up to 18 candidates), layout-aware sizes and width/height attributes; 100/127 homepage images use native loading=lazy; hero has loading=eager fetchpriority=high sizes=100vw plus a art-directed mobile crop (header-mobile.jpg 1200x1600).
Product gallery: first image eager + fetchpriority=high, others lazy; product-card.liquid eagerly loads only the first 3 cards and marks the hover image fetchpriority=low.
Product packshots are 1:1 white-background at 3500-4000 px (82 at 4000x4000, 49 at 3500x3500), apparel 4:5 at 1500x1875: eligible for Google Shopping/Images without re-shooting.
336/355 article featured images and 2167/2210 blog body images have alt; blog cards have width/height/srcset/sizes.
Image sitemap entries exist for all 185 products and 354 articles with <image:title>; custom Product JSON-LD lists every product image at width=1000 when the block parses.
limitations: Lab metrics (LCP/CLS/INP) could not be measured: no PageSpeed/CrUX quota, no browser; byte sizes come from curl -I on the exact renditions the markup selects, not a real waterfall.
The theme's product-gallery.liquid, social-meta-tags.liquid and image-banner section were not in the theme export; their behaviour was audited from rendered HTML only.

Article body-image statistics (width/height, URL size parameter, alt length) are from the first 50 articles (articles-p1.json, 185 images); site-wide counts come from articles-all.json / catalog-analysis.md.
Google Images rankings and Merchant Center diagnostics unavailable (no DataForSEO/GMC access).
15 live requests confirmed CDN behaviour on 6 distinct assets; other sizes are inferred from srcset/sizes markup. The header logo anchor's aria-label could not be verified.

findings.title: 493/493 product images have no stored alt text; storefront fallback makes every image of a product carry the identical bare title
findings.evidence: $R/shopify/products-all.json: 185 products, 493 images, images_without_alt=493 (100%), 185/185 products with all images lacking alt; raw API nodes altText='' on 493/493. Storefront falls back to the product title: product-creatina-creapure.html img #3-#9 all alt="Creatine (Creapure®)" including the nutrition-table image creapure.jpg; homepage img #96-#103 four different images all alt="Cluster Insulin Bomb 1kg/33serv". 41 products have >=4 images sharing one alt (prime-whey-2000g 14, prime-whey-1000g 11, pure-isolate-2000g 8). Flavour never in alt although in file name. Empty stored alt propagates to child1.xml <image:caption></image:caption> 185/185 and to channel feeds.
findings.recommendation: Populate altText per image in Romanian (10-125 chars, flavour + size + view). Templates: pudra proteica "Pure Isolate Bourbon Vanilla, 2 kg (74 serviri) – izolat proteic din zer Prime Supplements, flacon vedere din față"; creatina "Creatină Creapure fără aromă, 500 g (100 serviri) – creatină monohidrat Prime Supplements"; capsule "Vitamina D3 + K2, 80 capsule – supliment pentru oase și imunitate Prime Supplements, flacon"; baton "Baton proteic cu căpșuni, 55 g – Prime Supplements" / box "Cutie 12 batoane proteice cu căpșuni – Prime Supplements"; infographic "Tabel nutrițional și mod de administrare {Produs} {gramaj}"; MNX "Hanorac MNX Industrial, dusty rose – bărbați, vedere din față". Bulk path: Products CSV export -> fill 'Image Alt Text' column per Image Src -> import with overwrite; or Admin GraphQL productUpdateMedia/fileUpdate (<=100 media per call, 5-6 calls); or Matrixify. Avoid auto-alt apps that stamp '{title} – brand' on every image. Theme hardening: product-card.liquid line 87 add alt: product.featured_media.alt | default: product.title.
findings.falsifiability: Fresh products export shows images_without_alt 0/493; curl of /products/creatina-creapure shows two different alts for the two gallery images; child1.xml shows non-empty <image:caption>.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Performance, search type Image: product-query impressions rise within 4-8 weeks; Merchant Center image warnings disappear.

findings.title: Format and compression are handled by the Shopify CDN; uploading AVIF/PNG sources buys nothing (AVIF is never delivered)
findings.evidence: 260/493 product images uploaded as .avif (all MNX apparel), 37 .png (33 supplement packshots e.g. ALLMERCH7.png 3500x3500), 14 .webp, 182 .jpg. Live: XFORCE-HOODIE-23-A.avif?width=1500 with Accept image/avif,image/webp -> content-type image/webp 107,118 B; with Accept image/webp only -> identical. CDN transcodes every source to WebP (JPEG fallback) and never serves AVIF; AVIF uploads add a second lossy encode. Cache headers correct (max-age=31557600, Cloudflare HIT).
findings.recommendation: Upload originals as high-quality JPEG (q85-90, <=3000 px); do not pre-convert to AVIF/WebP; PNG only for transparency. No theme change, no <picture> fallbacks needed.
findings.falsifiability: n/a (informational)
findings.leading_indicator: n/a

findings.title: Google Images / Shopping opportunity: packshots are eligible but the signals that would rank them are missing
findings.evidence: Assets are right (1:1 white-background packshots 3500-4000 px, apparel 4:5 1500x1875) but: Product JSON-LD invalid on supplements with multi-line descriptions (7/13 sampled) so the image array is not read; altText empty -> no sitemap caption, no alt in channel feeds; camera/non-Romanian file names; no figcaption/title; MNX colour variants are separate products so identical photos sit on 19 near-duplicate URL groups (45 products); collection images absent from the sitemap; 57 single-image products.
findings.recommendation: Sequence: IMAGES-01 alt import -> SCHEMA fix (valid Product JSON-LD with full image array and per-variant Offer) -> IMAGES-04 naming for top sellers -> merge MNX colour variants into one product with variant images -> add second image to single-image supplements; then resubmit the product sitemap in GSC and watch the Images search type.
findings.falsifiability: GSC Performance filtered by Search type = Image shows > 0 clicks for non-brand product queries within 8 weeks of the alt + schema fixes.
findings.leading_indicator: Rich Results Test on /products/creatina-creapure shows the Product with all images listed.

results.score_rationale: Platform layer is sound (HTTP/2 + Cloudflare, brotli 7.6:1, Early Hints, TTFB 0.316 s, 1-year CDN caching, modern Impact theme with srcset/sizes, fetchpriority=high hero, lazy loading) but every one of ~1,151 URLs carries ~170 KB of inline head JavaScript (27-65 % of each document), 20 external scripts (~350 KB brotli of app/third-party JS, 8 web pixels), two render-blocking cross-origin Google Fonts stylesheets injected by Fontify on top of preloaded Barlow (triple font stack), a parser-blocking script before <meta charset>, and a 630 KB / ~2,944-element homepage with a duplicated featured-collection section. No lab/field CWV data exists; estimate carries roughly +/-10 points of uncertainty.
what_works: HTTP/2 over Cloudflare with brotli: homepage 630,667 B raw -> 82,466 B on the wire; CDN assets cache-control max-age=31557600 with cf-cache-status HIT
TTFB 0.316 s / total 0.737 s from a US edge (server-timing processing 354 ms, render 223 ms); HTTP 103 Early Hints preload theme.css, bss-custom.css, pandectes-rules.js and both font CSS
Small theme payload: theme.css 27,223 B br, theme.js 34,746 B br, vendor.min.js 21,056 B br (type=module, deferred); only one classic synchronous script on the page

Responsive images: homepage 110/127 img with srcset and width/height, 108 with sizes, 100 lazy; hero slide is eager + fetchpriority=high with a <picture> mobile source; Shopify CDN auto-serves WebP (hero 322 KB JPEG -> 211 KB WebP)
Product gallery LCP image is eager + fetchpriority=high with width/height 4000x4000 and a correct 20-step srcset/sizes chain; thumbnails use 56-192 px widths
Theme fonts (Barlow) self-hosted as woff2 on the Shopify font CDN with font-display: fallback and two preloads

limitations: No lab or field Core Web Vitals: PSI (anonymous quota exhausted), CrUX, GSC and Lighthouse/Chromium were unavailable in the sandbox; no LCP/INP/CLS values, TBT, waterfall or main-thread profile exist. All LCP-element and main-thread statements are static inferences; the score carries roughly +/-10 points of uncertainty and should be re-based on Shopify's Web performance report or GSC CWV data once 28 days of traffic exist.
TTFB measured once from a US edge (IAD) with curl; it indicates server health, not Romanian user experience.
layout/theme.liquid was not in the theme dump ($R/theme/ holds 15 files, no layout file); head-order recommendations are based on rendered HTML and Impact's known structure.

Barlow font-file byte totals were not fetched (live-request budget); Poppins weights actually downloaded by a browser depend on the weights used by the overridden selectors (expected 400/500/600/700), not on the 54 declared faces.
Image transfer sizes measured with a Chrome Accept header (WebP); AVIF may be somewhat smaller for newer browsers.
Product template assessed on one supplement product (baton-proteic-capsuni); MNX apparel pages with 24-39 gallery images share the same head/app stack but have heavier galleries.
Live requests to the store were capped at 15 (2 s apart, no 429 encountered); the recommended request-count and byte targets are design goals, not measured baselines.

results.score_rationale: Technically strong (server-rendered HTML, OAI-SearchBot and Claude-SearchBot verified 200, robots.txt allows every AI crawler) and the blog already has answer-first bullets, question headings, tables and FAQ blocks; but what AI systems would quote is undermined by decorative sources (all 326 ncbi / 276 Healthline / 257 Mayo / 235 WHO links are homepage-only, only 12/355 articles cite a primary study), fabricated freshness (315/348 hard-coded dates disagree with Shopify, Updated==Published in 348/348), a split brand/author entity (schema sameAs handles differ from footer, YouTube missing, four author identities, no author page), and money pages with zero quotable text (22/23 collections empty). Dimension heuristics: Citability 40, Structure 60, Multi-modal 50, Authority 38, Technical 75.
what_works: Server-side rendered content: full product copy present in raw HTML served to OAI-SearchBot and Claude-SearchBot (HTTP 200, text/html), no JS dependency
robots.txt allows all AI crawlers; Googlebot eligibility floor met (indexable, no nosnippet/max-snippet restrictions)
Blog structure already AI-friendly in shape: 350/355 bodies have >=3 question lines, 347 tables, 354 lists, 311 visible FAQ sections, 321 open with a Key Takeaways answer block
Author byline with credential displayed on 335/354 articles; Person JSON-LD with LinkedIn URL embedded in 344

Real YouTube channel @primesupplementsro: 13 of the first 20 YouTube results for 'prime supplements' romania are the brand's own videos (Marius Chera, Prime Podcast), the strongest third-party correlate of AI citations
Homepage FAQPage (5 order/returns questions) is visible on page (5/5 outside <script>)
Shopify agent layer live (UCP discovery, MCP endpoint, Link rel=ucp, rel=buy cart links) for agentic commerce

Only 12/355 bodies contain a primary-study identifier (PubMed/PMID/PMC/doi/'et al.'), while mentions_studies_or_sources=338 and 275 bodies say 'conform Healthline'.
