findings.recommendation: Replace homepage links with the actual primary source per claim (PubMed/PMC with PMID, EFSA/ANSVSA for authorised claims), e.g. Kreider et al. ISSN position stand JISSN 2017;14:18 (PMC5469049) for dosing, Antonio & Ciccone JISSN 2013;10:36 for timing; put the citation inline next to the number; strip unsupported links. Start with the 25 most product-linked creatina/proteina articles, then batch via Admin API articleUpdate from a reviewed source table.
findings.affected_scope: 338/354 published articles; every YMYL health claim on the site
findings.falsifiability: grep for pmc/pubmed URLs in bodies > 0 for every article mentioning 'studii'; sample of 20 AI answers quotes primesupplements.ro with the specific figure
findings.leading_indicator: Share of articles whose outbound links resolve to a document containing the cited claim (target 100% of articles mentioning 'studiu')

findings.title: Freshness signals are fabricated: hard-coded 'Published:' lines disagree with Shopify dates, 'Updated' always equals 'Published', 267/354 articles older than 90 days, two conflicting Article schemas per page
findings.evidence: 348/354 bodies start with literal English 'Published: <date> | Updated: <same date>'; 315 disagree with Shopify publishedAt (219 by -1 day, 52 by -7, 44 by -30); Updated==Published 348/348; Shopify updatedAt differs from publishedAt in only 29 articles; age at 2026-10-12: 87 <=90d, 219 at 91-180d, 48 >180d; 279/355 titles contain 2025/2026, 352 bodies say 'în 2026'. article-2026-citicolina.html has 6 ld+json blocks incl. two Article entities: BlogGenAI (datePublished 2026-04-14T02:20:02.026Z, author Person) and theme snippets__schema-article.liquid (2026-04-14T05:20:02+0300, author Organization 'Prime Supplements').
findings.recommendation: Strip the Published/Updated/By/Share Post text lines from bodies and let the Impact article-banner render article.published_at; emit ONE Article JSON-LD (theme snippet) with author = Person @id of the author page and dateModified = article.updated_at; stop BlogGenAuto injecting JSON-LD; start a quarterly refresh of the 30 most-linked articles with a visible 'Actualizat la' date bound to updated_at; remove year-baiting from evergreen titles.
findings.falsifiability: Visible date equals article.published_at on 0 mismatches; Schema validator shows one Article per URL; >30% of articles have updated_at > published_at + 30 days
findings.leading_indicator: Count of articles with updatedAt within the last 90 days

findings.title: 22 of 23 collection pages have zero descriptive text, so category money pages have nothing an AI system can quote
findings.evidence: /collections/creatina: H1 'Creatina', filter/sort UI, 3 product cards, 'Alte categorii', 'Ghiduri și sfaturi utile'; extracted main text has 0 sentences (parsed word_count 560 is all chrome/footer); CollectionPage JSON-LD description "" (snippets__schema-collection.liquid); all 23 collections empty except 'Bauturi' ('Bauturi Sport'); title 'Creatina monohidrat pentru forță și performanță' and meta 'Alege creatina ideală...' promise a guide the page lacks.
findings.recommendation: Add a 120-180-word answer-first description per collection (collection.description rendered above the grid in sections/main-collection.liquid) with a definitional first sentence, concrete product differences, a comparison table (Produs | Formă | Porții | Preț/porție | Pentru cine) and 3 question H2s answered in 40 words with the study cited. Worked example for /collections/creatina is in geo.md (opens 'Creatina monohidrat este cel mai studiat supliment pentru forță și masă musculară: ... Kreider et al., 2017 ... 3–5 g pe zi', then names the 3 products with prices from the live page and a 'Cum alegi' sentence).
findings.falsifiability: Collection main text > 120 words with an 'X este...' sentence; CollectionPage.description non-empty; AI answers for 'cea mai bună creatină' cite /collections/creatina
findings.leading_indicator: Collections with description >= 100 words (target 23/23)

findings.title: Product pages (Creapure sample) bury the definition 1,100 words down, render the copy twice, use an English H1 and make unauthorised health claims without sources
findings.evidence: product-creatina-creapure.html: H1 'Creatine (Creapure®)' vs title 'Creatina Creapure - Supliment pentru Performanță Fizică'; 10 'Beneficii cheie' bullets rendered twice (content_quality.py repetition_score 40, flag 'repetitive', 1239 tokens/400 unique); claims 'Efecte neuroprotectori ... tratarea bolilor neurodegenerative', 'Echilibrarea nivelului de zahăr din sânge ... sensibilității la insulină' introduced by 'Există dovezi'/'Unele studii sugerează' with no citation; the definitional sentence under H2 'Ce Este Creatina Creapure?' appears ~1,100 words in, after reviews/recommendation widgets; dosage '3-5 grame pe zi' in the penultimate section; no dates/author; 'PRIME Supplements' 4 vs 'Prime Supplements' 16 on the same page.
findings.recommendation: Add a 60-80-word answer block under the price (what it is, producer AlzChem, serving maths, dose, made in EU); replace disease claims with the EFSA-authorised wording (Reg. (EU) 432/2012: creatina crește performanța fizică în eforturi repetate, scurte, de intensitate mare) and cite it; render the description once (accordion or tabs in product-info.liquid); Romanian H1; add a visible dated 'Verificat de Marius Chera, nutriționist sportiv' line linked to the author page.
findings.falsifiability: Product main text has an 'X este...' sentence in the first 80 words; repetition_score < 15; no disease-claim phrases remain on supplement pages
findings.leading_indicator: Supplement product pages with an above-the-fold answer block (target 85/85)

findings.title: Organization entity is split: schema sameAs handles differ from the footer's, YouTube is missing, no legalName/address/phone, and the brand is written 6 ways
findings.evidence: snippets__schema-organization.liquid sameAs: facebook.com/primesupplements.ro, instagram.com/primesupplements.ro, tiktok.com/@primesupplements; footer links in home.html: facebook.com/primesupplementsro, instagram.com/primesupplements_ro/, tiktok.com/@primesupplements.ro, youtube.com/@primesupplementsro (3/3 differ; YouTube channel verified live but absent from sameAs). No legalName (PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL, CUI 46260823), address, telephone, founder, vatID; availableLanguage lists Hungarian though hu locale unpublished; description without diacritics. Name variants: home 'Prime Supplements' 13 / 'PRIME SUPPLEMENTS' 1 / 'PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS' 1 / 'primesupplements1' 19 / 'Prime Health' 3; despre-noi 'PRIME SUPPLEMENTS' 3 + 'PRIME Supplements' 1 + 'Prime Supplements' 9; bodies: 'Prime Supplements' 180 files, 'PRIME SUPPLEMENTS' 4, 'Prime Health' 10; homepage title tagline in English. No Wikidata/Wikipedia entity.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite snippets/schema-organization.liquid as one Organization/OnlineStore entity with legalName, alternateName, founder @id, PostalAddress (Cisnădie, Str. Ioan Virgil Ispas Nr. 17A, Sibiu, RO), telephone +40775286584, email, vatID RO46260823, contactPoint with telephone, availableLanguage ['ro'], and sameAs = the verified footer set incl. https://www.youtube.com/@primesupplementsro (full JSON-LD snippet in geo.md); standardise 'Prime Supplements' in copy/titles/brand; retire 'Prime Health' unless a real sub-brand; apply for a Wikidata item once the author page exists.
findings.affected_scope: Site-wide (Organization block in <head> of all 1,151 URLs)
findings.falsifiability: Schema validator shows one Organization whose sameAs equals footer links; Knowledge Panel/AI Mode answers for 'Prime Supplements' show the Sibiu company
findings.leading_indicator: Brand-name variant count across pages (target: 1 marketing name + 1 legal name)

findings.title: Author entity 'Marius Chera' has four identities, no author page, contradictory credentials and a Person schema with only a LinkedIn URL
findings.evidence: Shopify author strings: 'Marius Chera , Nutriționist Certificat' 325 (rendered verbatim with comma-space), 'primesupplements1' 17, 'Marius Chera' 10, 'Sorin Cristea' 2. No author page in sitemap/pages.json; despre-noi mentions 'Marius' once, home/contact 0, no LinkedIn on despre-noi. Embedded Person JSON-LD (344 articles): jobTitle 'Expert Nutriție Sportivă & Biohacking', url LinkedIn only, no sameAs/knowsAbout/affiliation/hasCredential; bio boilerplate in 345 articles with contradictions ('8' vs '10 NPC PRO Cards', '18 ani' vs '15 ani'); 'Nutriționist Certificat' names no certifying body; theme Article schema says author is the Organization; ro.wikipedia Marius_Chera 404.
findings.recommendation: Create /pages/marius-chera with verifiable credentials, competition record, YouTube/LinkedIn links and Person JSON-LD (@id .../pages/marius-chera#person, sameAs, hasCredential, worksFor Organization @id, knowsAbout); normalise author field to 'Marius Chera' on 352 articles via Admin API and show the credential in the theme byline; replace the 345 boilerplate bios with a 2-line bio linking 'Despre autor'; set Article.author to the Person @id; attribute 'Sorin Cristea'/'primesupplements1' articles explicitly.
findings.affected_scope: 354 articles (YMYL 'Who' test); product pages that could carry expert review
findings.falsifiability: Distinct author values on published articles <= 2 real names; /pages/marius-chera returns 200 with Person schema; Article.author.@id resolves to it
findings.leading_indicator: Articles whose Article.author is a Person with an on-site profile URL (target 354)

findings.title: The first passage of most articles is boilerplate or a price widget, not the answer
findings.evidence: 348 bodies begin 'Published: ... | Updated: ... By: ... Share Post' (English UI strings: 'Share Post' 349, 'Key Takeaways' 321, 'Table of Contents' 37) before any Romanian sentence; 120/355 bodies contain a product card ('În limita stocului disponibil', 'Cumpără Acum', 'Vezi Produsul →') inside the first 200 words; sampled top article's first paragraph is a throat-clearer ('Dilema momentului optim ... a fost subiectul multor dezbateri ...') interrupted by 'Creatine Ready To Go 110.00 lei ⚡ În limita stocului disponibil'.
findings.recommendation: Drop literal date/share lines, rename 'Key Takeaways' to 'Pe scurt' and keep it first, move the first product card below the second H2, rewrite intros to answer the title question in the first 40-60 words. Worked rewrite for 'Dimineața vs Seara: Când să iei creatină' is in geo.md ('Pe scurt: creatina funcționează prin saturarea rezervelor din mușchi, nu prin ora la care o iei; 3–5 g zilnic ... Antonio și Ciccone, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013;10:36 ...').
findings.falsifiability: First 60 words of each body contain no 'Published'/'Share' tokens and at least one declarative sentence with a number; product widgets only after word 300
findings.leading_indicator: Share of articles whose first 200 words contain 'În limita stocului' (target 0)

findings.title: Hidden FAQPage markup on the creatina products: 8 Q&As exist only in JSON-LD, not on the page
findings.evidence: snippets__faq-schema-creatina.liquid emits FAQPage with 8 questions ('Ce este creatina monohidrata?', 'Creatina monohidrata cauzeaza caderea parului?', 'Trebuie sa fac pauze de la creatina monohidrata?' ...) on 3 creatina products; in product-creatina-creapure.html 'caderea parului' occurs 2x inside <script> and 0x outside; 'Trebuie sa fac pauze' 0x outside. Q&As written without diacritics. FAQ rich results retired May 2026, so only the guideline violation (markup for invisible content) remains.
findings.recommendation: Render the 8 Q&As as a visible 'Întrebări frecvente despre creatină' accordion in main-product.liquid (with diacritics, 40-70-word answers citing the ISSN stand, van der Merwe 2009 and Antonio et al. 2021 for hair loss), then keep or drop the FAQPage block; the visible answers become citable passages for queries like 'creatina cade parul'.
findings.falsifiability: Each FAQ question string appears >= 1 time outside <script> on the product page
findings.leading_indicator: Visible FAQ blocks on supplement products

findings.title: Unattributed statistics in the answer blocks ('până la 60%', '99.99%', '82% standardul de aur')
findings.evidence: Key Takeaways bullets: 'îmbunătățește rata de absorbție cu până la 60%' (cand-sa-iei-creatina-dimineata), 'O concentrație de 82% proteine reprezintă standardul de aur ... în 2026' and 'puritate de doar 60-70%' (proteina-cum-alegi-pudra-proteica-calitate), 'puritate de 99.99%' / 'Variabilă (adesea <98%)' table (creatine-kinase-...), 'Da (250% VNR)'; none has an adjacent source; the 60% looks like a garbled Green et al. 1996 result with no link.
findings.recommendation: For every number in a 'Pe scurt' block add the source (author, year, journal) or make it qualitative; replace invented thresholds with the product's own label data ('Prime Whey: 82 g proteină/100 g, conform etichetei').
findings.affected_scope: 321 articles with Key Takeaways (pattern-wide); 4 of 5 sampled
findings.falsifiability: Random sample of 20 Key Takeaways numbers each traceable to a linked document
findings.leading_indicator: % of numeric claims with an adjacent citation (target > 90%)

findings.title: Auto-generated clinical FAQ questions push a supplement shop into medical territory AI systems will not cite it for
findings.evidence: FAQ lines in creatine-kinase-creatina-creapure-bioavailability-why-absorption.txt: 'Cât de ridicate sunt nivelurile de CK în distrofia musculară?', 'Ce analize indică pierderea masei musculare?', 'Care sunt nivelurile normale de CK pentru femei în funcție de vârstă?'; mixed-language 'Este creatina 100% safe?' (best-creatine-monohydrate-dozaj-optim...); the creatine-kinase topic is a lab test, answered without medical authorship.
findings.recommendation: Prune FAQ items answering diagnostic/lab questions; keep sports-nutrition questions (dosage, timing, stacking, sourced side effects) with a consult-a-doctor line; retire or 410 the creatine-kinase lab-test articles and redirect to the creatina guide.
findings.affected_scope: At least 8 'creatine-kinase'/'creatine side effects' articles; pattern in 311 FAQ sections
findings.falsifiability: No FAQ question contains 'distrofia', 'analize', 'niveluri normale' without a cited clinical source and medical reviewer
findings.leading_indicator: FAQ questions outside sports-nutrition scope (target 0)

findings.title: AI-generation footprint with no 'How' disclosure: BlogGenAI markers, 194 'Powered by BlogGenAuto' links, 'Scaled by KEMO'
findings.evidence: 347/355 bodies contain a 'BlogGenAI' HTML comment; 194 carry a visible dofollow 'Powered by BlogGenAuto' link; 351 use inline styles; bursts up to 10 articles/day (127 in 2026-05); footer '© 2026, Prime Supplements. Scaled by KEMO' on every page; no editorial/review statement anywhere. Google's helpful-content guidance asks for 'How' disclosure; spam policy covers scaled content abuse.
findings.recommendation: Bulk-remove the BlogGenAuto links and HTML markers from body_html; add a one-line editorial policy on the author page and blog index ('Articolele sunt redactate cu asistență AI și verificate de Marius Chera, nutriționist sportiv; ultima verificare: <date>') bound to updated_at.
findings.falsifiability: grep -l BlogGenAuto over article bodies returns 0; blog index shows an editorial policy link
findings.leading_indicator: Articles with a visible reviewer + date (target 354)

findings.title: 'primesupplements1' leaks as a brand alias into AI corpora (vendor on 64 products, author on 17 articles, 2,582 myshopify links)
findings.evidence: Vendor 'primesupplements1' on 64/185 products, string present 19-31 times per rendered page (31 in product-creatina-creapure.html, 23 in collection-creatina.html, 19 on home); author 'primesupplements1' on 17 articles; 2,582 in-body links to primesupplements1.myshopify.com in 349 articles (1,602 product, 534 /cart/, 446 collection).
findings.recommendation: Bulk-set vendor to 'Prime Supplements' (supplements) or 'MNX' (apparel); set author to 'Marius Chera'; rewrite myshopify links to primary-domain URLs via Admin API body_html replace and drop /cart/ add links.
findings.falsifiability: grep -c primesupplements1 on any rendered page = 0
findings.leading_indicator: Pages containing 'primesupplements1' (target 0)

findings.title: The /ro-hu/ mirror doubles every citable URL and splits citation signals
findings.evidence: 575 URLs duplicated under /ro-hu/ (1,151 sitemap URLs), identical Romanian text and RON prices, each self-canonical with hreflang ro / ro-HU / x-default (verified for the homepage pair in parsed/pages_homepage-ro-hu.json). AI retrieval treats /ro-hu/products/creatina-creapure as a separate document competing with the root URL.
findings.recommendation: Owned by TECH: disable the Hungary subfolder or canonicalise /ro-hu/ to root until hu is published; GEO side: never link /ro-hu/ URLs from articles, keep Organization url and sameAs on the root.
findings.falsifiability: AI answers and Perplexity citations only show root URLs
findings.leading_indicator: /ro-hu/ URLs in sitemap (target 0 while hu unpublished)

findings.title: Bot-protection challenge (HTTP 429 'Verifying your connection...') can hit user-triggered AI fetchers at answer time
findings.evidence: Recon notes: store answers 429 with a 'Verifying your connection...' page after request bursts; Bytespider 429 by default. User-triggered fetchers (ChatGPT-User, Perplexity-User, Claude-User, Google-Agent) fetch at question time; a challenge page drops the citation. Search crawlers verified fine on single throttled requests (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot 200).
findings.recommendation: Ensure Shopify/Cloudflare bot settings exempt verified bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Google-Agent) from JS challenges; monitor 429 counts by UA in Shopify's bot-traffic report.
findings.falsifiability: 20 consecutive fetches with UA 'Perplexity-User' 2 s apart never return 429
findings.leading_indicator: Weekly 429 count for AI user agents (target ~0)

findings.title: Topic cannibalisation: 47 keyword groups / 164 articles and 42 regenerated '-2..-5' handles give AI retrieval many weak passages instead of one strong answer
findings.evidence: catalog-analysis.md: 'de ce strategia' 9 articles, 'cum sa stii' 8, 'protocolul complet de' 8, '6 semne ca' 8, 'dozajul optim de' 7; four 'glutamina-si-sanatatea-stomacului-*' articles; 42 handles end in -2/-3/-4/-5; 719 title pairs with similarity > 0.6; creatina timing split across 'cand-sa-iei-creatina-dimineata', 'momentul optim pentru', 'morning-vs-evening' variants.
findings.recommendation: For the top 15 commercial questions keep one canonical guide, 301 regenerated duplicates to it, and link the guide from the matching collection description (GEO-03).
findings.falsifiability: Per question, only one primesupplements.ro URL appears in AI Mode/Perplexity citations
findings.leading_indicator: Number of -2..-5 handles still live (target 0)

findings.title: llms.txt, llms-full.txt and agents.md are Shopify's generic agent-instructions file, not a content index (Google ignores llms.txt)
findings.evidence: $R/llms.txt 4,414 B, $R/agents.md 4,371 B, $R/pages/llms-full.txt 4,419 B: same 'Agent Instructions — Prime Supplements' markdown (shop.app/SKILL.md promotion, UCP endpoints, generic /products/{handle}.json routes, two policy links, 'openclaw-like manner'); zero product/category/article entries; live headers 200 text/markdown. Google's AI optimization guide (2026-06-15 note): llms.txt neither helps nor hurts Google Search; no major answer engine confirmed consumption.
findings.recommendation: No citation value to chase; if Shopify's agent settings allow customising the instructions, add a short 'Key facts' section (brand, legal name, Sibiu, founder, 3 category URLs, author page, editorial policy) for non-Google agents; do not hand-build an llms.txt.
findings.falsifiability: n/a (presence-only)
findings.leading_indicator: none; presence reported only

findings.title: No machine-readable licensing/usage signals (no RSL, no Content-Signal, no License Link header)
findings.evidence: /rsl.xml -> 404; homepage headers contain Link rel=preconnect/preload/ucp only; no License/Content-Signal headers; robots.txt has no AI-bot directives (User-agent: * Allow: /).
findings.recommendation: Optional licensing choice, not a visibility lever: to allow search citation but not training, disallow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.liquid while keeping OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot allowed; publish RSL 1.0 if a stance is adopted. Changes nothing for Google Search/AI Overviews.
findings.falsifiability: robots.txt lines per bot match the chosen policy
findings.leading_indicator: n/a

findings.title: Platform readiness (Google AIO/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Bing Copilot) not measured; qualitative assessment only
findings.evidence: Google: eligibility floor met (indexable, snippets allowed, Googlebot 200); Search Console 'Search generative AI' control unverifiable (no GSC). AIO is ranking-correlated so empty collections/cannibalisation/split entity cap it; AI Mode weights freshness/entity (GEO-02/05/06). YMYL supplement queries get AIOs with health disclaimers favouring medical sources, so a shop is cited for product facts and expert-reviewed dosage, not clinical claims. ChatGPT: OAI-SearchBot 200 verified; no Wikipedia/Wikidata entity; Reddit unverifiable (403). Perplexity: PerplexityBot 200; /ro-hu/ and myshopify links risk odd citations. Bing: index/IndexNow unverifiable.
findings.recommendation: After fixes, run a monthly 30-query Romanian panel ('cea mai bună creatină', 'creatina creapure pareri', 'cand se ia creatina', 'prime supplements pareri', ...) in AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot, logging citation and URL.
findings.falsifiability: Panel results over 3 months
findings.leading_indicator: Citation share on the panel

limitations: No live SERP/AI-answer measurement (no WebSearch or DataForSEO AI-visibility tools in this agent); platform readiness is qualitative

Wikimedia (Wikidata/en.wikipedia) brand lookups returned 429 on the shared proxy; ro.wikipedia 'Marius Chera' 404 confirmed; Reddit 403, Trustpilot 403 challenge; Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn handle validity could not be verified, so the correct social handle set must be confirmed by the owner
content_quality.py is tuned to English AI-phrasing patterns; its 81-83 scores on Romanian text are not meaningful and were not used
Live store requests limited to 5 (2 UA tests, homepage HEAD, /rsl.xml, /llms.txt HEAD); all else from the 2026-10-12 local evidence set
GEO-14 (429 challenge) is inferred from recon notes, not reproduced against AI user agents

results.score_rationale: In 11 Romanian commercial SERPs observed on 2026-10-12 (pudra proteica, proteine din zer, suplimente pre workout, batoane proteice, arzator de grasimi, cea mai buna creatina, suplimente culturism, creatina creapure, prime whey, pre workout fara cofeina, bcaa vs eaa) primesupplements.ro never appeared; restricted to Romanian stores it surfaces only with 2026 blog posts for creatina/creatina monohidrata while gymbeam.ro, bodyline.ro and decathlon.ro rank with category and product pages. The brand name is not owned in search (Hagen Prime, Blackstone Prime Nutrition, QNT/Prozis Prime Whey), legacy WooCommerce URLs and the B2B store are still indexed, and the home/collection/product/article templates fail the skeptical and price-comparing personas (P3 scores 28/28/48/29). SXO Gap Scores: /collections/creatina 38, /collections/pudra-proteica 40, BCAA article 35, creatina-creapure product 58.
what_works: Main store is indexed with Romanian keyword-led titles on key collections (site: results: 'Pudra proteica pentru masa musculară', 'Suplimente Pre Workout pentru energie maximă', 'Vitamine și minerale esențiale', 'Despre noi - Prime Supplements', EAA and Frutilu product pages).

The domain can rank: /blogs/news/creatina-monohidrata-nitrox-no-stim-combining-supplements, /blogs/news/monohydrate-creatine-cum-sa-stii-daca-creatina and /blogs/news/creatina-si-volumizarea-musculara-cum-sa-stii-daca-creatina appeared next to gymbeam.ro/decathlon.ro/bodyline.ro in the store-restricted creatina checks.

Product buy box is complete for decision-stage buyers: 'Preț redus 180,00 lei', 'În stoc', 'Produs în Uniunea Europeană', 2 variants, '17 recenzii', 'Adaugă în coș' + 'Cumpără acum', site-wide 'Livrare gratuită la comenzile de peste 300 RON', payment methods listed in the FAQ.

Collections already expose filters (Doar în stoc, Preț, Cantitate) and 8 sort options; the Impact theme main-collection section can host description/rich-text blocks, so the fix is content not development.
Blog corpus is long-form (median 1529 words, 348/355 with tables, 338 citing studies, median 10 product links per article): raw material for consolidation into category hubs.
limitations: WebSearch is a US-indexed engine, not google.ro: no PAA, ads, AI Overview, shopping units or related searches were observable; bare Romanian queries (creatina, creatina monohidrata pret, glutamina, pre workout, bcaa vs eaa diferente, creatina creapure) returned Spanish/Portuguese/French/Italian pages and were complemented with qualified or store-restricted variants. 'Absent' means absent from this engine's top results on 2026-10-12, strong but not conclusive for google.ro.
The site: operator was only partially honoured (site:primesupplements.ro/ro-hu returned unrelated domains), so index coverage counts are indicative.
No Search Console, GA4, CrUX or rank-tracking data; personas and user stories were derived from SERP result composition rather than PAA/ad copy.

Only one collection (/collections/pudra-proteica), one product (/products/creatina-creapure) and one article (BCAA vs EAA) were scored in depth; systemic patterns were verified across parsed files but per-page scores for other URLs may differ.
Pages were assessed from static HTML copies, not a rendered viewport; above-the-fold order is inferred from section order in the HTML (plugin render/fetch scripts fail in this sandbox).

findings.title: Blog posts, not the creatine collection or products, are the pages Google associates with the creatine money terms
findings.evidence: Store-restricted SERP 'creatina monohidrata' (2026-10-12): primesupplements.ro appears only with /blogs/news/creatina-monohidrata-nitrox-no-stim-combining-supplements and /blogs/news/monohydrate-creatine-cum-sa-stii-daca-creatina; competitors rank with gymbeam.ro/creatina-monohidrat?product_list_order=reviews_count (category), gymbeam product pages (Mammut, GymBeam, Redcon1) and 4 decathlon.ro product pages. 'creatina': site surfaces with /blogs/news/creatina-si-volumizarea-musculara-cum-sa-stii-daca-creatina vs gymbeam.ro/creatina-creapure (product) and bodyline.ro/cresterea-masei-musculare/creatina-monohidrata/ (category, title '...Doar 89 Lei'). /collections/creatina has 3 products, 560 words incl. chrome, empty description; /products/creatina-creapure never surfaced even for 'creatina creapure'. 68/355 article titles contain 'creatin' (80 handles), 19 handles contain 'creapure', 42 handles end in -2..-5 ($R/shopify/articles-all.json).
findings.affected_scope: Creatine cluster: 1 collection, 4 creatine products, 68 articles; same pattern for protein (29 titles), fat burners (28), BCAA (13), pre-workout (13), glutamine (12).
findings.recommendation: Make /collections/creatina the hub: 500-700 words of buying-guide copy in collection.description (monohidrat vs Creapure, 3-5 g/zi, când se ia, preț/porție), a comparison table of the store's creatine SKUs and the Judge.me aggregate, rendered in a rich-text/custom-liquid block under the grid in sections/main-collection.liquid. Consolidate the 68 creatine articles into max 8 pillar guides and 301 the rest (Admin > URL redirects CSV). In each remaining article add a first-screen link to /collections/creatina and a product card via article.metafields.custom.featured_product in sections/main-article.liquid. Remove duplicate primesupplements1.myshopify.com links.
findings.falsifiability: After 8-12 weeks GSC Pages filtered on queries containing 'creatin' should show /collections/creatina and the creatine products as top URLs; if blog URLs still take >70% of creatine impressions the consolidation failed.
findings.leading_indicator: Share of GSC clicks for 'creatin' queries landing on /collections/ or /products/ URLs (observed today: 0%).

findings.title: Collection pages are 'filters + 3-5 cards' while the Romanian SERP rewards rich category pages and guides
findings.evidence: /collections/pudra-proteica: 5 products, word_count 591 ($R/parsed/pages_collection.json), collection.description empty (22 of 23 collections), CollectionPage JSON-LD "description": "", main content opens with 'Filtre Sortează după ... Doar în stoc Preț Lei Cantitate 2000g 3000g', H2s only 'Alte categorii' and 'Ghiduri și sfaturi utile'. Indexed (site: title 'Pudra proteica pentru masa musculară') but absent from the open 'pudra proteica' SERP (medlife.ro guide, biogena.com guide x2, drmax.ro products, bzi.ro advertorials for Bodyline, puterea.ro) and from the store-restricted one (decathlon.ro category x3, drmax.ro category, emag.ro filtered category). /collections/creatina has 3 products/560 words; /collections/suplimente-pre-workout absent from 'suplimente pre workout' where bulk.com/ro and drmax.ro categories rank. 'Cantitate' filter exposes only 2000g/3000g although 1 kg and 30 g items are sold.
findings.affected_scope: 23 collections (category entry points for all 185 products).
findings.recommendation: For the 12 category collections write 300-700 words of Romanian category copy answering P1/P3 questions (ce este, concentrat/izolat/vegetal, cum alegi, cât/când, siguranță, certificări TUV/IFS/HALAL) + 3-5 FAQs, a SKU comparison table (proteină/porție, preț/porție), collection-level review count and links to 2-3 best articles; 60-90-word intro above the grid (main-collection description setting) and the long block below (rich-text section). Fix the Cantitate filter in Search & Discovery mapping all variant weights.
findings.falsifiability: If after the copy is live the collection still does not reach the top 20 for its exact-match title query (GSC average position), the page is held back by authority, not content.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC impressions for the collection URL on 'pudra proteica', 'pudre proteice', 'proteine'; scroll depth on the new block (Clarity).

findings.title: The brand name is not owned in search: 'prime supplements', 'primesupplements', 'prime whey' return other companies
findings.evidence: 'prime supplements': hari.ca (Hagen Prime bird vitamin), Prime Nutrition by Blackstone Labs x2, Prime Brands, hellopharmacist 'Prime', 1800dtc 'Prime Sports Nutrition' x2, eBay, NIH label; 0 Romanian results. 'primesupplements': same plus Wikipedia 'Prime Supermarket', Alpha Prime Supps trademark, Prime Biome spam. 'prime supplements romania suplimente': only market news (forbes.ro x4, economica.net x2, stirileprotv.ro). 'prime whey proteina': QNT Prime Whey (paris.cl x2, decathlon.de), Body Action '100% Whey Prime' x4, Prozis x2; the only Romanian hit is the aggregator shopping.truda.io/product/proteina-din-zer-prime-supplements-prime-whey-1000g-bourbon-vanilla, not the store. On-site: homepage title 'Prime Supplements - Hardcore Sports Nutrition', Organization schema foundingDate '2020' vs /pages/despre-noi 'founded 2022 by Marius Chera', no telephone/address in schema, vendor 'primesupplements1' on 64 products, no brand suffix in title template.

findings.recommendation: Title template '{{ page_title }} | Prime Supplements' in layout/theme.liquid; homepage title 'Prime Supplements România - Suplimente sportive produse în UE'; one Organization/OnlineStore schema with legalName PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL, founder Marius Chera, foundingDate 2022, Cisnădie address, telephone +40775286584, sameAs incl. LinkedIn and Google Business Profile; create GBP and Merchant Center; product titles carrying the brand ('Prime Whey 2 kg - proteină din zer Prime Supplements'); vendor 'Prime Supplements' on all 185 products; 5-10 Romanian press/creator mentions with the exact string 'Prime Supplements România'.
findings.falsifiability: Monthly manual check of 'prime supplements' on google.ro; failure = the store is not #1 with sitelinks within 3 months of the changes.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC branded-query impressions and CTR; Knowledge Panel appearance.

findings.title: Legacy WooCommerce URLs (categorie-produs, ?v= cache-buster, www host) are still what Google shows for the site
findings.evidence: site:primesupplements.ro returned 10 results of which 4 are pre-migration or parameter URLs: https://www.primesupplements.ro/categorie-produs/suplimente/, https://primesupplements.ro/categorie-produs/suplimente/?v=1eb2628f4187, https://primesupplements.ro/categorie-produs/suplimente/vitamine-si-minerale, https://primesupplements.ro/collections/suplimente-pre-workout?v=1eb2628f4187 (one result noted 'about 626 days' old). Live curl 2026-10-12: www URL -> 301 non-www -> 301 /collections/suplimente -> 301 /collections/suplimente-sala (3 hops); ?v= is carried through the 301 (/collections/suplimente?v=1eb2628f4187); /collections/suplimente-pre-workout?v=1eb2628f4187 serves HTTP 200 with canonical to the clean URL.
findings.affected_scope: All former WooCommerce /categorie-produs/ and /produs/ URLs (at least 3 observed) and any URL carrying ?v=.
findings.recommendation: Load a complete one-hop redirect map in Shopify Admin > URL redirects pointing to final URLs (/categorie-produs/suplimente/ -> /collections/suplimente-sala, /categorie-produs/suplimente/vitamine-si-minerale -> /collections/vitamine-si-minerale), add redirects for the observed ?v= variants to clean URLs, submit the sitemap in GSC and use Removals > Outdated content for the www/legacy results; verify the www property too.
findings.falsifiability: site:primesupplements.ro categorie-produs returns 0 results after 60 days; if legacy URLs persist the redirects are not 301 or removal was not requested.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Pages report 'Page with redirect' count; crawl stats for categorie-produs.

findings.title: The wholesale store b2b.primesupplements.ro is indexed and surfaces product pages with B2B prices to consumers
findings.evidence: site:b2b.primesupplements.ro returned https://b2b.primesupplements.ro/products/combat-pro 'Combat PRO 500g/22 serv' showing 140 RON vs 170 RON, flavours, 'pickup unavailable', seller PRIME SPORT SUPPLEMENTS SRL. Live HTTP 200, no noindex, no canonical to the main store; the B2B sitemap lists 58 product URLs with the same handles as the main store ($R/pages/b2b-products-sitemap.xml).
findings.affected_scope: 58 B2B product URLs duplicating 58 retail products (31% of the catalogue).
findings.recommendation: Put the B2B store behind login (Shopify B2B 'require customers to log in' / storefront password), add <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> in its layout/theme.liquid, remove it from sitemap submission; if it must stay public add <link rel="canonical" href="https://primesupplements.ro/products/{{ product.handle }}"> on its product template. Keep /pages/inregistrare-b2b on the main domain as the only indexable B2B entry.
findings.falsifiability: site:b2b.primesupplements.ro returns 0 results within 4-8 weeks; otherwise the noindex is not served on the fetched pages.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC coverage of the b2b property; B2B order source mix.

findings.title: Commercial head-term SERPs are dominated by pharmacies, medical publishers and marketplaces; the store competes with zero authority and no advertorial/PR footprint
findings.evidence: Recurrent ranking domains across 11 commercial queries: drmax.ro (8), bulk.com/ro (5), medlife.ro (4), decathlon.ro (3), gymbeam.ro (2), catena.ro, biogena.com, emag.ro, worldclass.ro, bzi.ro advertorials for Bodyline x2 ('Prima pagină » Magazin » Bodyline. Ce este pudra proteică?'), prosport.ro 'ADVERTORIAL. Beneficiile ... batoanelor proteice', infocons.ro consumer tests (sugar 2-36 g/100 g, salt 0-1.3 g/100 g), newsweek.ro 'De ce sunt periculoase batoanele proteice'. primesupplements.ro: 0 of 11. Domain absent from the Common Crawl web graph; no referring-domain data.
findings.recommendation: 4-6 Romanian advertorials/interviews per year (bzi.ro, prosport.ro, worldclass.ro style) linking to collection hubs, authored by Marius Chera as nutriționist certificat; a lab-transparency page /pages/analize-de-laborator with per-batch certificates linked from every product page; a Comparison-type page 'Cea mai bună creatină în 2026: monohidrat vs Creapure vs HCL' (that SERP has only guides, a forum and product pages); register on price aggregators (shopping.truda.io already indexes the store; compari.ro, price.ro).
findings.falsifiability: No new referring domains in 6 months and no movement on the 11 queries shows the authority gap was not addressed.
findings.leading_indicator: Referring domains count; GSC impressions on non-brand category queries.

findings.title: The homepage opens with an English slogan and a row of sold-out apparel, failing every supplement-buyer persona above the fold
findings.evidence: $R/home.html main order: hero 'PRIME SUPPLEMENTS Hardcore sports nutrition Vezi produse' -> category tiles -> 'NOU - Haine MNX' with 'Stoc epuizat MNX Shaker 600 ml No reviews Preț redus 30,00 lei', 'MNX Ribbed shorts Hammer 3.0, white ... Stoc epuizat', 'MNX Ribbed shorts Hammer, grey No reviews ... Stoc epuizat'; supplement rows only after that; H2 'Reduceri' links to /collections/reduceri (0 products). Trust strings limited to 'Livrare gratuită la comenzile de peste 300 RON' and 'Tehnologii de ultimã generație şi ingrediente de cea mai înaltă calitate'; TUV/IFS/HALAL only on /pages/despre-noi. Mixed language: 'No reviews', '14 reviews' next to '44 recenzii', 'Let customers speak for us', title 'Hardcore Sports Nutrition'. Persona scores: P3 28/100, P1 44/100, P2 51, P4 56.
findings.affected_scope: Homepage (landing page for all navigational traffic).
findings.recommendation: Reorder Impact sections: hero with Romanian value proposition + 3 USPs (Produs în UE, Livrare gratuită peste 300 lei, real Judge.me aggregate) and CTA 'Vezi cele mai vândute' to a manual in-stock collection; 'De ce Prime' trust strip with TUV/IFS/HALAL badges linking to lab certificates; best-selling supplements row (in-stock only); move 'Haine MNX' below supplements and hide sold-out items; remove the 'Reduceri' section until populated; translate Judge.me strings (Judge.me > Settings > Translations).
findings.falsifiability: Clarity recordings still show scroll past the MNX row before any click, and homepage -> collection click-through does not rise after the reorder.
findings.leading_indicator: Clarity dead clicks/scroll depth on the hero; Shopify sessions converted with landing page = homepage.

findings.title: Product pages hide the educational content and price logic the decision-stage SERP expects, and distract with a B2B CTA
findings.evidence: /products/creatina-creapure: H1 'Creatine (Creapure®)' in English vs title 'Creatina Creapure - Supliment pentru Performanță Fizică'; 'Preț redus 180,00 lei' with no price per serving (1,80 lei/porție) and no comparison with the store's 100-lei creatina-monohidrat-micronized-300g-fara-aroma; 'Reprezinți o companie? Înregistrează-te în platforma B2B' directly under 'Adaugă în coș'; 'Customer Reviews' heading in English; education H2s ('Ce Este Creatina Creapure?', 'Beneficiile...', 'Cum Funcționează...', 'Recomandări de Utilizare') render after 'S-ar putea să-ți placã', reviews, 'Cele mai vândute', 'Categorii populare'; breadcrumb 'All Products'; Product JSON-LD invalid on multi-line descriptions and AggregateOffer '190,00' so no price/rating rich result unlike decathlon/gymbeam results; the page never surfaced for 'creatina creapure'.
findings.affected_scope: 85 supplement product pages (sections/main-product.liquid); 100 MNX pages share the template with 0-word descriptions.
findings.recommendation: Romanian H1s ('Creatină Creapure® 500 g / 300 g'); 'Preț per porție' line in snippets/product-info.liquid from variant price / servings metafield; move the B2B link to footer or a collapsible 'Ești profesionist?' row; move description/education above recommendations and reviews (templates/product.json order); add a 'Care creatină ți se potrivește?' 3-column comparison linking the creatine SKUs; trust row (Produs în UE, lot testat + certificat, retur 14 zile, livrare 24-48 h); fix Product schema (Offer per variant, numeric price, priceValidUntil, hasMerchantReturnPolicy, shippingDetails, aggregateRating from Judge.me).
