findings.title: 355 machine-generated articles cannibalise each other and target transactional topics with informational pages
findings.evidence: $R/shopify/articles-all.json: titles containing creatin 68, protein/whey/izolat 29, fat-burner/slăbit 28, BCAA 13, pre-workout 13, glutamină 12; 46 titles contain 'semne', 49 start with 'Cum', 33 use 'N semne/motive/greșeli' listicles, 279 contain 2025/2026; 47 keyword groups cover 164 articles; 719 title pairs > 0.6 similarity; 42 handles end in -2..-5. 'pre-workout fără cofeină' = 3 articles (ce-este-un-pre-workout-fara-cofeina 2025-05-26, citicolina-ghid-pre-workout-fara-cafeina 2026-03-15, apa-de-cocos-nitrox-no-stim-antrenamente-seara 2026-10-11) + product Nitrox NO-STIM, while that SERP is 6 product pages (bulk.com 'Dope pre-workout fără cofeină' 129 RON, kespro, muziker) + 3 guides; 'efecte secundare glutamina' = 2 near-identical handles vs a medical SERP (apollohospitals, ncbi x2, cochrane); 'bcaa vs eaa' = 517-word 2025 article with 0 links vs 1500+ word brand blogs (nakednutrition x7, openfarma.it, fitadium). 17 titles / 49 handles contain product names; 191 handles contain English fragments incl. a competitor brand (gymbeam-creatine-creatina-monohidrat-micronized-300g-fara-5). None of the 355 articles appeared in the 3 article-topic SERPs.
findings.affected_scope: 355 articles (majority of the 1151 indexable URLs) and the collections/products they outrank internally.
findings.recommendation: Content inventory in three buckets: KEEP & MERGE (one pillar per keyword group, ~40 pillars, 301 the rest), REDIRECT (product-name posts -> product page; 'fără cofeină' posts -> one guide linking Nitrox NO-STIM, whose title becomes 'Nitrox NO-STIM - Pre-workout fără cofeină 660 g'), DELETE/NOINDEX (73-word L-carnitine post, English drafts, -2..-5 regenerations). Pause the BlogGenAuto schedule until done; rename handles containing competitor brands; add blog tags = collection names so pillars sit in tag hubs linked from collections.
findings.falsifiability: GSC query report still shows >1 article receiving impressions for the same query 8 weeks after consolidation; blog share of clicks does not fall while collection/product clicks rise.
findings.leading_indicator: Indexed /blogs/news/ URL count (GSC Pages) trending from 354 to ~60-80.

findings.title: Articles are dead ends for every decision-stage persona: no product path, weak author trust, stale dates
findings.evidence: BCAA vs EAA article: 0 internal links, 0 product links, 0 external links, only 'Te-ar putea interesa' H2, '29 mai 2025 De Marius Chera' with no credential link, 517 words; Action scores 3-4/25 for all personas. Blog-wide: 112 articles with 0 collection links, 6 with 0 product links, 194 with a dofollow 'Powered by BlogGenAuto' link, every product link duplicated to primesupplements1.myshopify.com (2582 links), author bio boilerplate with contradictory facts ('8' vs '10 NPC PRO Cards', '15 ani' vs '18 ani'), invalid Article JSON-LD, 352 bodies starting with English 'Published: May 15, 2026'. Blog index title 'Ultimele articole', 11 per page, 33 pages, no tag hubs.
findings.recommendation: In sections/main-article.liquid add an author box rendering /pages/marius-chera (credentials, LinkedIn, photo), a 'Produse recomandate' block (2-3 product cards from an article metafield) after the second H2 and at the end, a 'Vezi categoria' link in the first 100 words, and visible 'Actualizat la {{ article.updated_at }}'. Bulk-rewrite bodies via Admin API articleUpdate to strip the 'Published:' line, BlogGenAuto links and myshopify links. Blog index: title 'Blog Prime Supplements - ghiduri de suplimente', 24 per page, tag hubs per category.
findings.falsifiability: Article -> product click-through (GA4 or Shopify landing-page -> added-to-cart) stays flat after the blocks are added.
findings.leading_indicator: Assisted conversions from /blogs/ landing sessions; clicks on the 'Produse recomandate' block (Clarity).

findings.title: The MNX apparel line (54% of the catalogue) has no searchable identity and is given homepage priority over supplements
findings.evidence: 'MNX haine sala tricou' returns only MNX1 antibody vendors (biossusa, lsbio, biorbyt, abbexa) and a Schneider Electric 'MNx' breaker. 100 MNX products, 93 with English titles ('MNX Hoodie Industrial, dusty rose'), description median 0 words, 89 without SEO title/description, 82 without GTIN, 22 out of stock everywhere, colour variants published as separate products (19 near-duplicate groups / 45 products); homepage first product row 'NOU - Haine MNX' shows sold-out items.
findings.recommendation: Decide MNX's role: if a brand, build one brand landing (/collections/haine-mnx 'MNX - haine de sală by Prime Supplements', 300 words, size guide, fabric, model photos) targeting 'haine sala barbati', 'tricouri sala', 'pantaloni scurti sala', 'hanorac sala'; merge colour variants into one product with colour options; hide sold-out products from the homepage and draft/noindex items at 0 stock for >60 days; if secondary, remove MNX from the hero area.
findings.falsifiability: GSC impressions for 'mnx' + apparel queries remain 0 after 3 months of the brand page being live.
findings.leading_indicator: Impressions on 'haine sala'/'tricou sala' queries; MNX share of homepage clicks (Clarity).

findings.title: The /ro-hu/ market serves Hungarian searchers Romanian content in RON and is invisible anyway
findings.evidence: site:primesupplements.ro/ro-hu returned no site URL (termene.ro, bulksupplements.com/ro-hu, iherb noise) although 575 /ro-hu/ URLs are in the sitemap with hreflang ro-HU; no Hungarian locale published, no HUF pricing; $R/pages/homepage-ro-hu.html is identical Romanian content. A Hungarian-intent searcher gets Romanian copy and lei while every URL is crawled twice.
findings.recommendation: Disable the Ungaria web presence subfolder until Hungarian translations (Translate & Adapt) and HUF are ready, or publish the HU locale with translated collections/products first and keep articles ro-only; do not keep an untranslated market live.
findings.falsifiability: After disabling, /ro-hu/* should 301 to /*; GSC still reporting /ro-hu/ URLs indexed after 8 weeks means redirects did not deploy.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical' count.

findings.title: Mixed-language UI and catalogue strings break clarity for Romanian personas on every template
findings.evidence: 'No reviews', '14 reviews' vs '44 recenzii' on adjacent cards, 'Let customers speak for us', 'Customer Reviews'; product H1 'Creatine (Creapure®)'; collection H1 'All Products'; breadcrumb 'All Products'; title 'Hardcore Sports Nutrition'; 96 English product titles; 352 article bodies start with English 'Published: May 15, 2026'; announcement bar 'Tehnologii de ultimã generație' uses ã instead of ă; homepage meta description has no diacritics.
findings.recommendation: Judge.me > Settings > Translations (ro); locales/ro.json 'All Products' -> 'Toate produsele' and rename the all collection; fix the announcement bar text; Romanian product titles with the English name secondary ('Creatină Creapure® (Creatine)').
findings.falsifiability: A grep of the rendered homepage for 'reviews|Customer Reviews|Let customers' still returns matches.
findings.leading_indicator: The grep above.

findings.title: Deal-seeking persona is routed to an empty 'Reduceri' collection although 144 products have a strike-through price
findings.evidence: Homepage H2 'Reduceri' links to /collections/reduceri (0 products, HTTP 200, indexable, title 'Reduceri'; $R/pages/collection-reduceri.html); 144/185 products carry compareAtPrice; cards show 'Preț redus ... Economisește 20,00 lei'. Price intent is strong in the observed SERPs (bodyline 'Doar 89 Lei', gymbeam reviews_count sort, price aggregators for 'pret').
findings.recommendation: Make 'Reduceri' an automated collection (Compare-at price > price), SEO title 'Reduceri suplimente - oferte Prime Supplements', 80-word intro, sort by discount; remove the homepage section until populated; enable 'Economisești X %' badges in the Impact theme.
findings.falsifiability: /collections/reduceri still returns 0 products or the homepage section still links to it.
findings.leading_indicator: Clicks on the homepage 'Reduceri' section (Clarity); collection conversion rate.

findings.title: Three identical 185-product listings plus '11% TVA' and 'Prime Health' compete for the generic 'suplimente' entry point with no intent match
findings.evidence: All 185 products sit in all, cele-mai-vandute and lansate-recent; /collections/prime-health appeared in site: results with the bare title 'Prime Health'; /collections/11-tva is an internal tax grouping (15 products) that is indexable; the legacy /categorie-produs/suplimente/ redirect chain ends at /collections/suplimente-sala ('Suplimente sală pentru performanță'), another generic listing.
findings.recommendation: Keep one generic hub (/collections/suplimente-sala as 'Suplimente sportive - toate produsele Prime Supplements' with category tiles and 300 words); make cele-mai-vandute a real best-seller collection; rename 'Prime Health' to 'Vitamine, minerale și sănătate (Prime Health)'; noindex 11-tva and lansate-recent via theme.liquid ({% if collection.handle == '11-tva' %}<meta name="robots" content="noindex">{% endif %}) and remove them from navigation.
findings.falsifiability: GSC shows the three generic listings still receiving impressions for the same queries after 8 weeks.
findings.leading_indicator: Impressions split for 'suplimente'-type queries across the 5 URLs.

findings.title: FAQPage markup on the homepage and creatine products has no SERP effect; keep it only as content
findings.evidence: Homepage FAQPage ('Articolul comandat nu este in stoc. De ce apare pe site?' ...) and faq-schema-creatina.liquid on 3 products; Google removed FAQ rich results for commercial sites. The homepage FAQ answers logistics questions (stoc, retur, plată) useful for P2/P3 but sits at the bottom of a 630 KB page.
findings.recommendation: Keep the visible FAQ, move the logistics answers into the product-page trust row; no schema work needed.
findings.falsifiability: n/a (informational).
findings.leading_indicator: n/a.

results.score_rationale: Weighted per the seo-ecommerce skill (schema 25% -> 10, title/meta 15% -> 35, images 20% -> 30, content 20% -> 35, internal linking 10% -> 30, technical 10% -> 55). The store cannot earn product rich results or a clean Merchant Center feed today: Product JSON-LD is invalid on multi-line descriptions and uses AggregateOffer with comma prices on all 185 products, productType is empty on 185/185, vendor is the myshopify handle on 64, 27 published GTINs fail the check digit, 79 products have no meta description at all, and the indexable /ro-hu duplicates show prices without 21% VAT. Foundations are sound (canonicalised facets, server-rendered Judge.me reviews, policy pages, valid UCP profile), so most fixes are data entry plus two Liquid snippets.
what_works: Filtered and sorted collection URLs canonicalise to the clean collection URL (live: ?filter.v.availability=1 and ?sort_by=price-ascending both canonical to /collections/all); pagination uses ?page=N with rel=next.
Out-of-stock product pages emit schema.org/OutOfStock and show 'Stoc epuizat'; in-stock pages show 'În stoc' / low-stock notice (threshold 5).
Judge.me reviews are server-rendered in product HTML (4 on baton-proteic-capsuni, 5 on creatina-creapure); store-wide 431 reviews at 4.87.
Every supplement sits in at least one real category collection; 69/85 supplement titles carry the pack size.
Featured images are large (none under 1024 px; 81 at 1500x1875, 43 at 4000x4000) and served as AVIF with descriptive filenames.
Shipping, return and payment policy pages exist with concrete values (free over 300 RON, 20 RON, Cargus 1-3 days; 14-day withdrawal; Netopia/transfer/ramburs).
UCP profile /.well-known/ucp is valid and current (2026-08-25; checkout, cart, order, fulfillment, discount, catalog search/lookup, permalink /buy, Google Pay and Shop Pay handlers).
19 category collections are linked from the mega-menu on every page; related, complementary, bestseller and category blocks exist on every product page.
limitations: No Merchant Center, Google Shopping, GSC or marketplace data (no DataForSEO, no WebSearch for this agent); Shopping readiness inferred from the dataset and Google's documented requirements.
Judge.me review counts known only for 5 sampled products and the homepage badge; per-product distribution across 185 products unknown.
Product export lacks options, standard category, variant weights and Google-channel metafields; option names come from sampled HTML only (MNX exposes a single 'Size' option).
Live checks limited to 5 throttled requests (bot protection); all other evidence from local copies dated 2026-10-12.
Collection sort order and Search & Discovery settings (complementary products, hide-OOS) not readable from the export.

findings.title: Product JSON-LD ineligible for merchant listings on every product (invalid JSON on multi-line descriptions, AggregateOffer with comma prices, no price/shipping/returns/rating)
findings.evidence: $R/jsonld/product-baton-1.jsonld fails json.load ('Invalid control character at line 7 col 38') because snippets__schema-product-enhanced.liquid uses `| escape` on a multi-line description; 7/13 sampled Product blocks invalid (all supplements). On valid blocks schema_ecommerce_validate.py product-mnx-blue-1.jsonld returns ok:false: High merchant-listing-offer-type (AggregateOffer), Medium missing price, missing-return-policy, missing-shipping-details, missing description; block has "lowPrice": "145,00", "category": "", "gtin": "10028802" (invalid), brand hard-coded 'Prime Supplements' on an MNX garment. "aggregateRating" absent from product.html, product-creatina-creapure.html, home.html. Native {% render 'microdata-schema' %} commented out in theme.liquid.
findings.recommendation: Replace the hand-built snippet with `json`-filtered output (never `escape`), one Offer per variant with numeric price (`v.price | divided_by: 100.0`), priceCurrency, priceValidUntil, availability, gtin13 only when barcode.size == 13, brand from product.vendor, category from product.type, aggregateRating from product.metafields.reviews.rating/rating_count, plus OfferShippingDetails (0 RON over 300, else 20 RON, RO, handling 0-1 d, transit 1-3 d) and MerchantReturnPolicy (14 days, customer pays return, link to /pages/politica-de-retur). Full Liquid snippet is in the findings file. Alternative: re-enable Shopify's microdata-schema and add only the shipping/return/rating extension.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test on /products/baton-proteic-capsuni shows a parsable Product eligible for Merchant listings; json.load succeeds on all 185 blocks; GSC Merchant listings report has 0 invalid items.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Enhancements > Merchant listings / Product snippets valid-item count 2-4 weeks after deploy.

findings.title: /ro-hu duplicate market shows prices without 21% VAT in RON (82,64 lei vs 100,00 lei) on indexable pages and in JSON-LD
findings.evidence: Live /ro-hu/products/baton-proteic-capsuni: 200, self-canonical, hreflang ro-HU, renders 82,64 / 128,10 / 8,26 lei vs 100,00 / 155,00 / 8,50 lei on the primary URL (100/1.21 = 82.64); JSON-LD "price":"82.64", "lowPrice": "7,02", "priceCurrency": "RON". Homepage duplicate: 206,61 / 165,29 / 396,69 / 16,53 lei vs 250,00 / 200,00 / 480,00 / 20,00 lei. Root cause: 'Ungaria' market (subfolder /ro-hu, no HU locale, no HUF) sold tax-excluded while content and currency stay Romanian; 575 URLs duplicated in the sitemap.
findings.affected_scope: 575 /ro-hu URLs (185 products, 23 collections, 354 articles, pages); Merchant Center price-mismatch risk on every product
findings.recommendation: Settings > Markets: remove the Ungaria web presence so /ro-hu/ 301s to primary URLs (or, if Hungary is real, publish hu locale, HUF, tax-inclusive pricing). Until removed: noindex when localization.country.iso_code == 'HU' and canonical to the primary URL; submit only primary-domain URLs to Merchant Center.
findings.falsifiability: curl -I /ro-hu/products/baton-proteic-capsuni returns 301 (or noindex + canonical to primary); sitemap drops the 575 /ro-hu entries.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC duplicate/alternate counts for /ro-hu/ at 0; Merchant Center price-mismatch diagnostics at 0.

findings.title: productType empty on 185/185 products: no category in schema, feeds, filters or type pages
findings.evidence: products-all.json productType '(empty)'=185; schema outputs "category": ""; collection facets expose only filter.v.price, filter.v.availability, filter.p.m.custom.cantitate, filter.p.m.custom.aroma (collection-all.html), no type/brand facet; Google & YouTube channel maps product_type from this field. 97 tags carry the taxonomy instead (Îmbrăcăminte 99, Suplimente 52, bauturi 19, case duplicate Pre-Workout/pre-workout).
findings.recommendation: Bulk-fill Type and standard Product category (CSV/Matrixify). Taxonomy: Pudră proteică, Creatină, Aminoacizi, Pre-workout, Intra-workout, Shot energizant, Arzător de grăsimi, Vitamine și minerale, Supliment pentru sănătate -> Vitamins & Supplements (5702); Baton proteic -> Snack Foods; Cremă de orez/oat cream -> Grains, Rice & Cereal; Unt de arahide/migdale/caju -> Nut butters; Băutură instant Frutilu -> Powdered Beverage Mixes; Tricou/Maiou stringer/Hanorac/Pantaloni/Pantaloni scurți/Jersey -> Apparel categories; Shaker/Prosop/Centură/Șapcă -> fitness accessories/hats. Then enable Type and Brand facets and switch schema category to product.type.
findings.falsifiability: /products.json shows non-empty product_type on all 185; /collections/types?q=Creatină returns products; Merchant Center shows product_type.
findings.leading_indicator: Admin count of products with empty Type = 0; 'Tip produs' facet visible on /collections/all.

findings.title: Vendor/brand data wrong: myshopify handle 'primesupplements1' is the vendor of 64 products; MNX garments and Frutilu drinks branded 'Prime Supplements'
findings.evidence: Vendor split: primesupplements1 on 57 supplements + 7 MNX; 'Prime Supplements' on 93 MNX + 28 supplements. Live /collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1: 200, <title>primesupplements1, H1 primesupplements1, '64 produse', self-canonical, indexable. 'primesupplements1' appears 25-31 times in each product HTML. Vendor block disabled in templates__product.json; snippets__vendor.liquid links via url_for_vendor; schema brand hard-coded for all 185 incl. 100 MNX and 19 Frutilu.
findings.affected_scope: 64 products with wrong vendor; 119 with wrong brand in schema/feed; 1 indexable vendor page
findings.recommendation: Set Vendor = 'Prime Supplements' (own supplements + 13 Prime-branded garments), 'MNX' (100 garments), 'Frutilu' (19 drinks); make schema brand read product.vendor; create manual brand collections /collections/mnx and /collections/frutilu so the vendor snippet links to them; afterwards Disallow /collections/vendors and /collections/types in robots.txt.liquid.
findings.falsifiability: /collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1 shows 0 produse; dataset vendor distribution has no primesupplements1.
findings.leading_indicator: Admin filter Vendor = primesupplements1 returns 0.

findings.title: GTIN coverage and validity: 207/395 variants without barcode, 27 of 188 barcodes fail the GS1 check digit, invalid codes published as gtin; SKU = EAN on 164 variants
findings.evidence: No barcode on 207 variants / 86 products (81 fully, 5 partially; 82 MNX + prosop-negru, prime-whey-go 7/14, prime-shaker-customised, pachet-mix-frutilu). Lengths: 13-digit 157, 8-digit 28, 12-digit 3. Check-digit failures 27: e.g. mnx-classic-t-shirt-golden-era-blue 10028802/10028804, mnx-hardcore-mesh-shorts-grey 60053002-04 (internal article numbers), unt-de-caju 6427616427536, shaker-premium 400082644617, prime-whey-go 642176606347 (truncated EAN-13). sku == barcode on 164 variants, 56 non-numeric SKUs, SKU 40111001 duplicated, 7 variants without SKU. Schema prints "gtin": "10028802".
findings.affected_scope: 86 products without GTIN; ~27 variants with invalid GTIN; 164 variants with SKU = EAN
findings.recommendation: Leave Barcode empty for custom MNX/Prime apparel and set identifier_exists=false + mpn in the Google channel; correct the 12-digit codes and unt-de-caju against supplier GS1 records; obtain GS1 Romania GTINs for own supplements lacking them; use internal codes as SKU; emit gtin13 in Liquid only when barcode.size == 13.
findings.falsifiability: GS1 check-digit script over /products.json returns 0 invalid; Merchant Center shows no 'Invalid value [gtin]' / 'Missing value [gtin]'.
findings.leading_indicator: Count of 8/12-digit barcodes = 0.

findings.title: SEO title/description coverage: 105 products without SEO title, 79 with an empty meta description, 12 with dosage text as meta, 47/80 SEO titles over 60 chars
findings.evidence: Missing SEO title 105/185 (89 MNX); missing SEO description 104. 79 products (78 MNX) have no seo_description AND 0 description words -> no <meta name="description"> at all (mnx-classic-t-shirt-golden-era-blue.html parsed meta_description None). 12 supplements fall back to 'Mod de administrare După cum este necesar...' (baton-proteic-capsuni, turmeric-extract-80-caps, nac-80-caps, zinc-citrate-80-caps, etc.). Of 80 SEO titles set, 47 > 60 chars (39 > 70, max 92); 35/81 SEO descriptions > 160 chars (max 221). Title template is bare {{ page_title }}.
findings.affected_scope: 185 products (104 without usable meta, 47 truncated titles)
findings.recommendation: Bulk-fill with templates: supplements '{{Produs}} {{Gramaj}} - {{Beneficiu}} | Prime Supplements' + meta with dose/serviri, 2 benefits, 'Produs în UE, livrare 24-72h, gratuită peste 300 lei'; MNX '{{Articol RO}} MNX {{Model}} {{Culoare RO}} - Îmbrăcăminte de sală | Prime Supplements'; Frutilu 'Băutură instant Frutilu {{Aromă}} 10 g fără zahăr | Prime Supplements'. Change theme.liquid title to append ' | {{ shop.name }}' unless already present.
findings.falsifiability: Rebuilt dataset: seo_title/seo_description non-empty on 185/185, 0 titles > 60 chars; every product page has a meta description.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC CTR on product URLs; blank SEO fields in Admin bulk editor = 0.

findings.title: Product content model broken: description holds dosage/ingredients never displayed, 4 metafield tabs mostly empty, 102 products under 50 words, no nutrition tables
findings.evidence: templates__product.json disables the description block and the 'Descriere' collapsible; tabs bound to custom.beneficii_cheie/despre_produs/ingrediente/detalii_produs and rich text to custom.seo_produs. 'Mod de administrare' absent from the visible text of product.html (only in meta/og/JSON-LD). Tab word counts: baton 0/0/103/0, turmeric 0/0/20/0, MNX Golden Era blue 0/40/0/0, Frutilu cola 0/53/0/0, creapure 211/0/4/4; empty tabs still render. Description < 50 words on 102 products (89 MNX), < 150 on 119, < 300 on 140; MNX median 0, supplements median 303. No nutrition-facts table, allergen line or dose table on sampled pages; FAQ only on 3 creatina products.
findings.affected_scope: 185 products; 100 MNX with 0-60 words; ~13 supplements under 150 words
findings.recommendation: Content model per type (CSV import): supplements = Despre produs 120-200 unique words, Beneficii, Ingrediente, valori_nutritionale HTML table, Mod de administrare (move current description), Alergeni, FAQ; MNX = material/croială, ghid mărimi table, îngrijire; Frutilu = preparare, ingrediente, valori. Wrap each tab in {% if block.settings.content != blank %}; re-enable the description block (or a 'Mod de administrare' tab) so the text feeding meta/JSON-LD is visible.
findings.falsifiability: Metafield word counts > 150 on all supplements and > 60 on all MNX; no empty tab bodies in product HTML.
findings.leading_indicator: Share of products with all 4 tabs filled; median visible word count.

findings.title: 45 products are colour/flavour duplicates published as separate products instead of variants (19 groups)
findings.evidence: catalog-analysis groups: mnx extra t shirt basic (black/grey/white), mnx workout top hammer 3.0 (3), mnx ribbed shorts hammer (3), mnx cotton t shirt basix (3), mnx shorts golden era 2.0 (3), mnx stringer golden era 2.0 (3), Frutilu flavour sets (chocolate/cola/mango; green-apple/orange; ice-tea peach/lemon; watermelon/strawberry) etc. MNX pages expose only a 'Size:' option; 58 'Default Title' variants; Frutilu pages single-variant at 2,50 lei with 96-122-char titles differing only by flavour. Validator also flags no-product-group.
findings.recommendation: Merge MNX colour families into one product with Colour x Size options, create URL redirects from each old handle to the parent ?variant= URL, add ProductGroup/hasVariant schema; keep Frutilu flavours separate only if each has its own EAN and search demand, shorten titles and add a flavour switcher metafield; keep baton flavours separate.
findings.falsifiability: Near-duplicate title groups < 8 in the rebuilt dataset; 301s exist for every merged handle.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC impressions consolidate per MNX family; 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical' count.

findings.title: Titles/H1s: 17 titles over 60 chars (max 122), 96 English titles on a Romanian store, 19 without diacritics, H1 differs from SEO title and duplicates on key products
findings.evidence: 17 supplement titles > 60 chars, 14 Frutilu (122 chars: 'Bautura Instant cu Gust de Ceai cu Piersici Frutilu Ice Tea Peach, 10g (pentru 1.5L) – Fara Zahar, cu Stevia si Vitamina C'); 96 English titles (93 MNX: 'MNX Extra T-shirt basic, black'); 19 ASCII 'Bautura/Fara/Pudra'. H1 = product.title (product-info.liquid), so /products/creatina-creapure H1 'Creatine (Creapure®)' vs SEO title 'Creatina Creapure - Supliment...'; creatina-monohidrat page has 2 H1s ('CREATINE MONOHYDRATE 300g/60serv' + rich-text H1). 16 supplements lack size in the title while variants carry it ('Cutie 12 buc x 55g').
findings.affected_scope: 185 titles; 17 over-length, 96 English, 19 ASCII, >= 1 page with 2 H1s
findings.recommendation: Title pattern '[Produs RO] [Brand/Linie] [Gramaj/Caps/Serviri]' (e.g. 'Creatină Creapure 300 g / 500 g', 'Tricou MNX Extra Basic negru', 'Frutilu Cola 10 g'); keep marketing phrases for SEO title/meta; demote the first heading in seo_produs rich text to H2.
findings.falsifiability: No title > 60 chars in /products.json; parse_html.py shows exactly 1 H1 per product page.
findings.leading_indicator: Share of titles with diacritics and Romanian nouns.

findings.title: 30 products out of stock on every variant remain indexable, in the sitemap and linked from the blog, with no back-in-stock capture
findings.evidence: available_any=false on 30 products: 8 supplements (vitamina-d3-k2, zinc-citrate-80-caps, sapca-prime, baton-proteic-ciocolata-fructe-de-padure, water-out-500-ml, shaker-premium-accesorizat-500-ml, instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv, enzima-nattokinaza-80-caps) + 22 MNX. Live /products/mnx-workout-top-hammer-3-0-white: 200, self-canonical, 'Stoc epuizat' x3, OutOfStock schema, no notify form. 96/395 variants unavailable; 57 available products hold <= 5 units. instant-oat-cream is linked from 23 articles while OOS; all 30 stay in cele-mai-vandute and lansate-recent.
findings.recommendation: Per product: returning stock -> keep indexable, add 'Anunță-mă' back-in-stock block and similar-products module; discontinued colours (Hammer 3.0 whites, Ribbed Shorts Hammer v1) -> unpublish and 301 to the successor; restock instant-oat-cream or replace its 23 blog links.
findings.falsifiability: available_any=false < 10 in a rebuilt dataset; every OOS page shows a notify form; 0 blog links to OOS products.
findings.leading_indicator: Admin '0 available' product count; GSC clicks landing on OOS URLs.

findings.title: Compare-at 'discounts' on 144/185 products (120 permanently struck through) and an empty 'Reduceri' collection: Omnibus and Merchant Center sale-price risk
findings.evidence: compareAtPrice on 144 products (77 MNX, 67 supplements); 120 products with ALL variants compareAt > price; 269 discounted variants: median 10%, p75 20%, max 74% (10-19%: 169, 20-29%: 34, 50-59%: 16); 65 variants with compareAt == price. Example baton-proteic-capsuni cutie 100,00 vs 155,00 lei (-35%). /collections/reduceri: in sitemap, 200, title 'Reduceri', 0 products. Disabled 'SUPER Black Friday -50%' Liquid block still in templates__product.json.
findings.recommendation: OUG 58/2022 (Omnibus): reference price must be the lowest of the prior 30 days; remove compare-at from the 120 permanent-sale products (keep for time-boxed promos, store 30-day-low in a metafield), clear the 65 equal values; make reduceri an automated collection (compare-at not empty + price below compare-at) with SEO fields, or delete and 301 to /collections/all; in Merchant Center use sale_price + sale_price_effective_date only for real promotions.
findings.falsifiability: /collections/reduceri lists products or redirects; permanent compare-at limited to active promotions; no variant with compareAt == price.
findings.leading_indicator: Merchant Center Misrepresentation/sale-price warnings = 0.

findings.title: Collection architecture: 23 flat collections, 5 utility collections indexable, two overlapping apparel categories (99 vs 87, 86 shared), no goal/brand/garment-type sub-categories, all descriptions empty
findings.evidence: Sitemap: all (185, 'All Products'), cele-mai-vandute (185), lansate-recent (185), frontpage (1), reduceri (0), 11-tva (15, internal VAT grouping). echipament-sala 99 (nav 'Îmbrăcăminte') vs haine-mnx 87 with 86 shared; accesorii-sala 6. suplimente-sala 52 generic bucket; prime-health 13 vs vitamine-si-minerale 13 (same intent); creatina 3, pudra-proteica 5, batoane 4, aminoacizi 4, shot 2, alimente 2. No goal, brand (MNX/Frutilu) or garment-type collections for 100 MNX items. All descriptions empty; 8 without SEO title/desc; banner featured_product baton-proteic-ciocolata-portocale is not active; collection seo_text rich-text section disabled; mega-menu lists 17 collections flat.
findings.recommendation: Hubs: /collections/suplimente (rename suplimente-sala), /collections/imbracaminte (rename echipament-sala; haine-mnx -> /collections/mnx brand hub), /collections/alimente. Sub-categories by Type: Proteine, Creatină, Aminoacizi, Pre/Intra-workout, Arzătoare, Vitamine și minerale, Sănătate (merge prime-health), Băuturi instant; apparel: Tricouri, Maiouri & stringere, Hanorace, Pantaloni, Pantaloni scurți, Accesorii; brands MNX, Frutilu. Goal pages: Masă musculară, Slăbire, Energie și focus, Recuperare, Sănătate. Noindex cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, frontpage; rename/noindex 11-tva; fix or delete reduceri; enable seo_text section with 150-300 words per collection; fix banner product.
findings.falsifiability: Collection sitemap lists only categories with >= 2 products and a description; /collections/cele-mai-vandute noindex; GSC impressions on new goal/brand pages.
findings.leading_indicator: Indexable collections with non-empty description = 100%.

findings.title: Faceted navigation thin (price, availability, 2 custom metafields) and crawlable; vendor/type query pages indexable
findings.evidence: collection-all.html facet form exposes filter.v.price.gte/lte, filter.v.availability, filter.p.m.custom.aroma (6), filter.p.m.custom.cantitate (6); pudra-proteica only cantitate + price + availability; no brand/type/goal/size facets. Live: filtered and sorted URLs 200 with canonical to clean URL. /collections/vendors?q=primesupplements1 200, self-canonical, indexable. robots.txt Shopify default (no filter/sort_by rules).
findings.recommendation: After Type/Vendor are filled, enable Type, Brand, Size (filter.v.option.size) and Goal facets in Search & Discovery; keep Shopify canonicals; add to robots.txt.liquid: Disallow /collections/vendors, /collections/types, /*?*filter., /*sort_by=.
findings.falsifiability: Facet form lists Tip produs / Brand / Mărime; vendor query URLs blocked by robots.txt.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC crawl stats share of ?filter. URLs.

findings.title: No visible breadcrumb on product or collection pages; BreadcrumbList JSON-LD points every product to 'All Products'
findings.evidence: grep -i breadcrumb product.html finds nothing outside JSON-LD; $R/jsonld/product-baton-2.jsonld = Pagina principala > All Products (/collections/all) > Baton proteic căpșuni because schema-breadcrumb-enhanced.liquid uses product.collections.first and all 185 products are in 'all'. Collection pages have no breadcrumb; main-product.liquid renders only the schema snippet.
findings.recommendation: Add snippets/breadcrumbs.liquid (Acasă > category > product) rendered in main-product and main-collection, choosing the first collection not in all/cele-mai-vandute/lansate-recent/frontpage/11-tva/reduceri (or a custom.categorie_principala metafield), and build the BreadcrumbList from the same crumb. Liquid snippet in the findings file.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test shows Home > Creatină > Creatina Creapure; visible breadcrumb in raw HTML.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC breadcrumb valid items = 185.

findings.title: Cross-sell is client-side only: 6-7 product links in raw HTML, complementary block has no data, section titles with typos and English
findings.evidence: Distinct /products/ hrefs in raw HTML: 6 (baton, creapure), 7 (MNX, turmeric, Frutilu), all from the server-rendered 'Cele mai vândute' carousel; <product-recommendations intent="complementary" limit="3"> and intent="related" are JS-filled; 'Merge perfect cu' never appears in HTML (0/5 pages) so no complementary products are configured. Headings 'S-ar putea să-ți placã' (ã), 'Customer Reviews' (English), 'Arzătoare de grãsimi'; 'Categorii populare' shows the same 3 collections on every product and collection page.
findings.recommendation: Add a server-rendered 'Din aceeași categorie' grid (8 products from the breadcrumb collection); configure complementary products per line in Search & Discovery; fix typos in section settings; rename the Judge.me widget title to 'Recenzii clienți'; make 'Categorii populare' contextual.
findings.falsifiability: Raw product HTML contains >= 14 distinct /products/ links; 'Merge perfect cu' renders 3 products.
findings.leading_indicator: Internal inlinks per product URL in a crawl (target >= 15).

findings.title: Reviews exist (431 store-wide) but are invisible to search: no aggregateRating/review markup, rating block disabled, English widget text, empty widget on 0-review products
findings.evidence: Homepage jdgm-all-reviews-rating 4.87 stars, '431 reviews'; product badges: baton-proteic-capsuni 4 reviews/4.00, creatina-creapure 17/5.00, turmeric-extract-80-caps 44/4.75, MNX Golden Era blue 0, Frutilu cola 0. Theme rating block disabled in templates__product.json; aggregateRating absent from all sampled HTML; review widget settings review_data 'sample_data', empty_state 'empty_widget'.
findings.affected_scope: 185 products; ~119 (100 MNX + 19 Frutilu) show an empty widget
findings.recommendation: Add aggregateRating from product.metafields.reviews.rating / rating_count (Judge.me-synced) into the single Product block; keep Judge.me's own JSON-LD off to avoid duplicate Product entities; translate the widget; hide the empty state or show 'Fii primul care lasă o recenzie'; run post-purchase review requests for MNX and Frutilu.
findings.falsifiability: Rich Results Test shows a review snippet on /products/turmeric-extract-80-caps (44 reviews, 4.75).
findings.leading_indicator: GSC Review snippets valid items; share of products with >= 1 review.

findings.title: Product images: 0/493 images have alt text and 57 products have a single image (53 supplements)
findings.evidence: images_without_alt = 493/493 on all 185 products; image_count == 1 on 57 products (53 supplements: citrus-bergamot, ashwagandha-ksm-66, vitamina-d3-k2, omega-3, all 80-caps items); product HTML has 24-39 with 6 empty alt each. Sizes fine (min 1024 px; 81 at 1500x1875, 43 at 4000x4000, AVIF), filenames descriptive.
findings.recommendation: Bulk alt via CSV 'Image Alt Text' with '{{Titlu produs}} - {{față/etichetă/valori nutriționale/spate}} - Prime Supplements'; add a label/nutrition-facts photo and a lifestyle image to the 53 single-image supplements for Shopping's multi-image treatment.
findings.falsifiability: images_without_alt = 0; products with image_count >= 3 >= 150.
findings.leading_indicator: Merchant Center additional_image_link coverage; Google Images impressions.

findings.title: Google Merchant Center readiness: policy facts exist on pages but not in product data; 8 feed-blocking attribute families missing or wrong
findings.evidence: politica-de-livrare (163 words: free > 300 RON, 20 RON, Cargus, 24-72 h), politica-de-retur (1122 words: 14-day withdrawal, customer pays return), politica-de-plata (Netopia, transfer, ramburs, RON incl. VAT) exist; no shippingDetails/hasMerchantReturnPolicy in any Product block (validator Medium x2). Feed gaps: product_type empty 185; brand wrong 64 + 119; gtin missing 207 variants / invalid 27; description empty on 78 MNX; 96 English titles; 30 OOS; /ro-hu price mismatch; google_product_category absent from export. Names like 'Testo Revive', 'Fat Burning Booster Shot', 'Water Out', 'Thermo Core' need claims-safe copy under Google's healthcare/supplements policy (account not verifiable).
findings.affected_scope: All 185 products for the Shopping feed
findings.recommendation: (1) Fix Product schema and add shipping/return blocks with the page values; also configure shipping and returns in Merchant Center or Search Console settings. (2) Fill Type/Category/Vendor/GTIN/alt/descriptions. (3) In the Google & YouTube channel map description to the 'Despre produs' metafield for MNX, set identifier_exists=false for custom apparel, exclude only discontinued OOS products. (4) Rewrite the 4 stimulant/weight-loss descriptions without disease/treatment claims. (5) Feed primary-domain URLs only.
findings.falsifiability: Merchant Center diagnostics: 0 disapproved items, 0 'Missing value [description]', 0 'Invalid value [gtin]'; shipping and returns shown in listings.
findings.leading_indicator: Merchant Center Active items = 185 within 2 weeks of feed submission.

findings.title: Blog-to-product linking misrouted: 2582 links to primesupplements1.myshopify.com, 534 add-to-cart links, 130/185 products never linked, 16 links to dead products
findings.evidence: articles-all.json: 3201 product links in 355 articles (median 10/article, max 15, 6 with 0); myshopify_links 2582 in 349 articles (each product link emitted twice: primary + myshopify domain, the latter through a 301); cart_links 534 in 349 articles. Distinct products linked 55/185; never linked 130 (99/100 MNX; 31 supplements incl. all 19 Frutilu, 3 crema-de-orez, complete-collagen, magnesium-citrate-80-caps, turmeric-extract-80-caps, centura-hardcore). Dead targets: 15-reducere-pachet-thermo-core-water-out-1-14-august (12 links), liver-protect-500-ml (4). Top: creatina-monohidrat 25 articles, creatina-creapure 23, fiber-blood-orange 23, creatine-ready-to-go 23, instant-oat-cream (OOS) 23.
findings.affected_scope: 349 articles; 130 products with zero editorial links; 16 dead links
findings.recommendation: Bulk-edit article bodies (Matrixify/Admin API): replace https://primesupplements1.myshopify.com/ with https://primesupplements.ro/, de-duplicate identical hrefs, drop /cart/add links, redirect or replace the 2 dead targets; then a link map giving every supplement >= 3 links from topically related articles and MNX families links from training/lifestyle posts; add 2-3 collection links per article.
findings.falsifiability: Rebuilt articles-all.json: myshopify_links = 0, cart_links = 0, distinct linked products >= 150, 0 links to inactive handles.
findings.leading_indicator: Crawl inlinks per product URL from /blogs/ (target >= 3 for supplements).

findings.title: Tags and handles inconsistent: 97 tags with case/plural duplicates, underscore handle, three handle patterns in the Frutilu range
findings.evidence: 97 distinct tags; Pre-Workout/pre-workout duplicate; the same 4 bars carry 'Batoane Proteice', 'baton', 'baton proteic'; Îmbrăcăminte 99 vs Haine MNX 5; handles emperor-mass_3000g (underscore), frutilu-instant-drink-strawberry-10-g vs instant-drink-frutilu-mango-10g vs instant-drink-frutilu-lemon; creatine-ready-to-go-plicuri-prime-supplements.
findings.recommendation: Controlled tag vocabulary for automated collections and facets (obiectiv:*, forma:*, brand:*); do not rename handles now except emperor-mass_3000g and the Frutilu set when titles are rewritten, with 'Create URL redirect' ticked.
findings.falsifiability: Tag count <= 40 with no case duplicates.
findings.leading_indicator: Tag-driven automated collections populate correctly.

findings.title: Variant naming inconsistent and leaks into cart, feeds and UCP (Cutie 12 buc x 55g / Baton 55g / 55g; product name repeated in variant titles; two size scales)
findings.evidence: Top variant titles: L/XL 64, Default Title 58, S/M 55, XXL/3XL 29, M 22, XL 22, L 20, S 16; same line uses 'Cutie 12 buc x 55g' + 'Baton 55g' (căpșuni, cocos) but '55g' (caramel sărat); creatina-creapure variants 'Creatine (Creapure®) 500g/100serv'; MNX uses S/M-L/XL-XXL/3XL on some and S..2XL on others (a Size facet would show 9 values).
findings.recommendation: Option 'Cantitate' with 'Baton 55 g' / 'Cutie 12 x 55 g'; 'Gramaj' with '300 g (60 serviri)'; one size scale per garment type; variant_title feeds the Shopping size attribute.
findings.falsifiability: All variant titles follow the pattern in /products.json.

Plugin fetch scripts cannot run in this sandbox; analysis used local copies plus 12 throttled curl requests to external hosts

what_works: Responsive layout with no horizontal scrolling at 390 px; text is legible (14 px minimum) and tap targets are large.

Collection pages render the H1 and the new collection description inside the banner (`/collections/creatina` shows "Creatina" + the first paragraph of the new copy), so the keyword-bearing text is visible without scrolling on desktop.
Product page: title, rating stars, price, "Produs în Uniunea Europeană" badge and stock status are visible under the gallery; variant selector is clear.
Announcement bar communicates free shipping ≥ 300 RON (matches the new shippingDetails markup).
limitations: Screenshots were taken without consent interaction; the layout after "Accept" was not captured.
No real-device or Lighthouse measurement; the findings are structural, not metric-based.

findings.title: Cookie banner is a full-screen modal on mobile and hides the hero on desktop
findings.evidence: `visual/home-mobile.png`, `visual/product-creapure-mobile.png`, `visual/collection-creatina-mobile.png`, `visual/home-desktop.png`: the Pandectes consent dialog ("Acest site web folosește cookie-uri…", Accept / Preferințe) covers 100% of the 390x844 viewport and the centre 30% of the desktop hero. No content is readable until the visitor acts.
findings.affected_scope: every page, every first visit (mobile ≈ 70% of traffic for this vertical).
findings.recommendation: switch the Pandectes banner to a bottom sheet / compact bar (Pandectes → Banner → Layout "Bar" or "Box bottom-left"), keep "Accept"/"Reject" equal, and defer non-essential scripts until consent. Keep the H1 and hero CTA unobstructed.
findings.falsifiability: a mobile screenshot of `/` on first visit shows the H1 and "Vezi produse" CTA without dismissing the banner.
findings.leading_indicator: mobile bounce rate on landing pages, LCP element in CrUX.

findings.title: Mobile product page has no add-to-cart CTA above the fold
findings.evidence: DOM probe on `/products/creatina-creapure` at 390x844: `ctaAboveFold = []` (desktop shows "Adaugă în coș"). The gallery takes the first 530 px, then rating, price, badges, variant selector; the button appears only after scrolling.
findings.recommendation: enable the Impact theme's sticky add-to-cart bar (Theme settings → Product page → "Show sticky add-to-cart"), reduce gallery height on mobile (aspect ratio "short"), or move the price + button block above the badges.
findings.falsifiability: mobile screenshot shows the add-to-cart button inside the first viewport.
findings.leading_indicator: mobile add-to-cart rate.

findings.title: Homepage H1 is the brand name only; headline keyword is an image-styled heading
findings.evidence: probe `h1 = ["Prime Supplements"]`; the visible headline "HARDCORE SPORTS NUTRITION" is a non-H1 element inside the hero. The homepage has no Romanian keyword in its H1.
findings.recommendation: make the hero heading an H1 that reads "Suplimente nutritive pentru sport: creatină, proteine, pre-workout" (brand stays in the logo and title tag), demote "Prime Supplements" to a kicker.
findings.falsifiability: `document.querySelector('h1').innerText` contains "Suplimente".

findings.title: 24 images on the homepage render without alt text (theme/section images)
findings.evidence: probe `imgsNoAlt = 24 of 127` on `/` after the product-image alt fix was applied (product images now carry alt). The remainder are hero/banner/section images and logo variants configured in theme sections.
findings.recommendation: in Theme editor, set the alt text on each image picker (hero, category tiles, "Despre noi" banner, payment icons are decorative → empty alt is fine, but the logo must read "Prime Supplements").

findings.title: Floating WhatsApp widget overlaps product cards on mobile
findings.evidence: `home-mobile.png`, `collection-creatina-mobile.png`: the green bubble covers the lower-right product card and the "Filtrează și sortează" control area.
findings.recommendation: reduce the bubble size on mobile or add a bottom offset above the sticky filter bar; hide it on the cart/checkout pages.

what_works: Primary domain with HTTPS, www → apex 301, Shopify's current robots.txt, valid sitemap index.
Products use clean hyphenated handles; variants carry prices and SKUs; Judge.me supplies reviews.
The theme exposes the SEO title/description fields of products, collections and articles (Shopify `global.title_tag` / `description_tag` metafields), which is what the fixes rely on.
limitations: App inventory, checkout, Search & Discovery and sales channel settings are outside the granted API scopes; the Pandectes banner and Judge.me were inferred from the rendered HTML.

findings.title: Hungary market web presence duplicates the entire site under /ro-hu/
findings.evidence: `recon/sitemaps/all-urls.txt` lists 575 `/ro-hu/...` URLs (50% of the sitemap); `recon/pages/homepage-ro-hu.html` is the Romanian homepage with the same content, `hreflang` pairs point to identical Romanian copies; web presence id `gid://shopify/MarketWebPresence/73400189303` (market "Hungary", default locale ro).
findings.affected_scope: every indexable URL (products, collections, pages, blog).
findings.recommendation: delete the Hungary web presence (Settings → Markets → Hungary → Domains and languages → remove the `/ro-hu` subfolder) or, if the market must stay, give it a Hungarian locale and translated content; until then it is pure duplication. The mutation `webPresenceDelete(id: "gid://shopify/MarketWebPresence/73400189303")` was validated but deliberately NOT executed: it changes selling settings, so it is the owner's call.
findings.falsifiability: `/sitemap.xml` children no longer contain `/ro-hu/`; `curl -I https://primesupplements.ro/ro-hu/` returns 404 or 301.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC "Duplicate, Google chose different canonical" count drops.

findings.title: B2B storefront republishes 58 product URLs on a second domain
findings.evidence: `recon/pages/b2b.html`, `recon/pages/b2b-products-sitemap.xml`: 58 product pages with the same titles/descriptions, no canonical back to primesupplements.ro, no password.
findings.recommendation: enable password protection on the B2B store (Online Store → Preferences → Restrict access) or add `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">` in its theme.liquid and remove it from its sitemap; B2B buyers log in anyway.
findings.falsifiability: `curl -I <b2b>/products/<handle>` returns 302 to `/password` or the HTML carries noindex.

findings.title: Vendor "primesupplements1", empty product types and taxonomy (FIXED)
findings.evidence: 64 products with vendor `primesupplements1` (the myshopify handle), 0/185 with a product type, 121 without a standard taxonomy category; Product JSON-LD printed the vendor as brand.
findings.recommendation: all 195 products now carry vendor "Prime Supplements" or "MNX", a Romanian product type (Proteine, Creatină, Aminoacizi, Pre-workout & intra-workout, Arzătoare de grăsimi, Vitamine, Minerale, Suplimente din plante, Batoane proteice, Cremă de orez și ovăz, Băuturi instant, Tricouri, Hanorace, Pantaloni scurți, Maiouri, Shakere, Accesorii sală, Pachete, …) and a Shopify Standard Product Taxonomy category (e.g. `hb-1-9-6-3` Creatine, `hb-1-9-6-8` Protein Supplements, `fb-2-11-9` Rice).
findings.falsifiability: `products(query:"vendor:primesupplements1")` returns 0; `products(query:"product_type:''")` returns 0.

findings.title: Missing SEO titles/descriptions on products, collections and articles (FIXED)
findings.evidence: 105/185 products without SEO title, 23 collections without descriptions, 20 articles without title_tag, generic/keyword-stuffed metas elsewhere.
findings.recommendation: 195 product SEO titles + descriptions (45–60 / 120–158 chars, brand suffix, EU health-claim compliant), 23 collection SEO titles + descriptions and 17 new collection body descriptions, 354 article `global.title_tag` + `description_tag` metafields rewritten, 17 articles re-attributed from the store account to the author.
findings.falsifiability: `articles(first:5, query:"...").metafield(namespace:"global", key:"title_tag")` returns the new values; product `seo.title` is non-null for all products.

findings.title: Product images had no alt text (FIXED)
findings.evidence: 493/493 product media without alt.
findings.recommendation: 493 descriptive Romanian alt texts written from the actual images (front/back/label/worn/colour variant) via `fileUpdate`.

findings.title: Utility and automated collections are indexable and in the sitemap
findings.evidence: `/collections/all`, `/collections/cele-mai-vandute`, `/collections/lansate-recent`, `/collections/11-tva`, `/collections/frontpage`, `/collections/reduceri`, `/collections/vendors?q=`, `/collections/types?q=`, `/pages/thank-you` return 200 with no robots meta.
findings.recommendation: publish the staging theme after previewing.

findings.title: Blog bodies generated by BlogGenAuto embed scripts, invalid JSON-LD and myshopify links
findings.evidence: 347/355 articles contain `<script type="application/ld+json">` blocks (1,379 in total) plus 347 inline scripts, 3,117 absolute links to `primesupplements1.myshopify.com`, 194 "Powered by BlogGenAuto" followed links, 534 hard-coded prices.
findings.recommendation: render-time neutralisation in `sections/main-article.liquid` on the staging theme (links rewritten to the primary domain, embedded scripts rendered inert, generator link nofollow/sponsored). Cleaned bodies for all 355 articles are prepared (`blog-cleanup/cleaned/*.html`, `bulk-articles-cleanup.jsonl`) but the bulk import could not be executed from this environment (bulk mutations are blocked by the integration policy); a Matrixify/CSV import or a short Admin API script by the owner applies them in one go.

findings.title: Draft/unlisted products share collections with live products
findings.evidence: 7 DRAFT and 3 UNLISTED products sit in automated collections ("cele-mai-vandute", "lansate-recent"); the unlisted ones are reachable by URL and indexable.
findings.recommendation: decide per product: publish (bundles Nitrox3D+Creapure, Fiber+Creapure are good SEO targets) or archive; keep the unlisted ones out of the sitemap by setting them to draft when not sold.

what_works: `<link rel="canonical">` is self-referencing on all 24 parsed pages and on the two live paginated pages (`/collections/all?page=2` → canonical `.../collections/all?page=2`, `rel=prev/next` present).
0 exact-duplicate `<title>` among the 185 products and 0 among the 354 article SEO titles; 0 duplicate article meta descriptions.
335/354 articles have a hand-set SEO title and 336/354 a hand-set meta description (median 157 chars, min 101); only 18 fall back.
One H1 on 22 of 24 parsed pages (exceptions: 2 H1s on creatina-monohidrat, 0 H1 on the three section-built pages).
hreflang (`x-default`, `ro`, `ro-HU`) and OG/Twitter tags are emitted on every template (`snippets__social-meta-tags.liquid`).
Product pages link to 36 products from the homepage and carry "Cele mai vândute" + "Categorii populare" blocks; 20 of 23 collections are reachable from the header/footer.
Article-to-article linking exists (1474 links, median 3 outbound per article), and article anchors are descriptive titles (0 generic "click aici" anchors).
`<html lang="ro">` is correct on all pages; paginated titles get a "– Pagina N" suffix so they are not exact duplicates.
limitations: Collection SEO fields were taken from the shared context (9 listed as missing) and verified on 4 local pages; no collection export exists in $R.

Article SEO fields came from the Admin metafields `global.title_tag/description_tag`; the 70-char truncation of the fallback title was observed on 1 of the 19 affected pages (citicolina) and inferred for the rest.
Heading hierarchy was checked on the 24 parsed pages plus body-HTML regexes over all 355 articles; JS-injected headings (Judge.me, Koala upsell) are counted only where present in static HTML.
`metadata_template.py` is a string heuristic; its "none" verdicts do not mean the metas are good.
No GSC data: CTR impact is inferred, not measured.

findings.title: 105/185 products have no SEO title, so `<title>` is the raw product name
findings.evidence: `$R/shopify/products-all.json`: `seo_title == ""` on 105 rows (16 supplements/accessories, 89 MNX apparel). Rendered examples (`$R/parsed/pages_product.json`, `pages_products_turmeric-extract-80-caps.json`, `pages_products_mnx-classic-t-shirt-golden-era-blue.json`): `<title>Baton proteic căpșuni</title>` (21 chars), `<title>Turmeric extract 80 caps</title>` (24), `<title>MNX classic T-shirt Golden Era, blue</title>` (36). Template `$R/theme/layout__theme.liquid` line 20: `<title>{% if page_title == blank %}{{ shop.name }}{% else %}{{ page_title }}…</title>` adds nothing.
findings.affected_scope: 105 product URLs (×2 with `/ro-hu/`). 16 effective titles are under 25 chars.
findings.recommendation: Bulk-write `SEO title` in Admin (CSV/Matrixify or `productUpdate` with `seo.title`) using: supplements `"{Produs} {gramaj/porții} – {beneficiu principal}"` (brand appended by the template, see ONPAGE-03), e.g. `Baton proteic căpșuni 55g – 20g proteină, fără zahăr adăugat`; apparel `"{Tip articol} MNX {model} {culoare} – {material}"`, e.g. `Tricou MNX Golden Era albastru – tricou de sală din bumbac`. Keep ≤ 55 chars before the suffix.
findings.falsifiability: After the fix, `products-all.json` rebuilt from Admin shows `seo_title` non-empty on 185/185 and no `<title>` under 30 chars in a crawl.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC → Pages report: impressions and CTR for the 105 URLs within 4-6 weeks; `site:primesupplements.ro "MNX"` SERP snippets show the new titles.

findings.title: 104/185 products have no meta description; 79 ship with no `<meta name="description">` at all and 12 use dosage text
findings.evidence: `seo_description == ""` on 104 products (16 supplements, 88 MNX). Shopify's `page_description` then falls back to the product description (`theme.liquid` line 22-24 only prints it `if page_description`). 79 of the 104 have an empty description (`desc_words == 0`, 78 MNX + 1) → no meta tag (confirmed: `pages_products_mnx-classic-t-shirt-golden-era-blue.json` META(0), `og:description` absent). 12 fall back to dosage/ingredient copy: `pages_product.json` META(320): "Mod de administrare După cum este necesar în ceea ce privește compoziția dietei… Ingrediente Matrice proteică (concentrat proteic din zer…"; `pages_products_turmeric-extract-80-caps.json` META(320): "Mod de administrare Se administrează 1 capsulă pe zi…". 13 more fall back to other body text (emperor-mass_3000g, unt-de-caju, sapca-prime + 10 MNX).
findings.affected_scope: 104 products (56% of catalog); the same strings feed `og:description` and `twitter:description`.
findings.recommendation: (1) Write meta descriptions 140-155 chars with the pattern `"{Produs}: {beneficiu}. {porții/dozare}. Livrare rapidă în România, {preț} lei."`. (2) Add a theme-level safety net so no product can ship without a meta tag (Liquid in ONPAGE-03). (3) Move "Mod de administrare / Ingrediente" below a marketing paragraph in the 12 descriptions so even the fallback reads as a pitch.
findings.falsifiability: Crawl shows a `<meta name="description">` of 70-160 chars on 185/185 products and none starting with "Mod de administrare".
findings.leading_indicator: GSC CTR on product URLs; Bing/Google snippets no longer show ingredient lists.

findings.title: The title template adds no brand suffix and the 80 hand-written titles use three different brand spellings
findings.evidence: `layout__theme.liquid` line 20 renders `{{ page_title }}` only. Only 33/185 effective product titles contain the brand (18%). Among the 80 set SEO titles: `| PRIME Supplements` ×16, `| PrimeSupplements` ×15 (Frutilu range), `| Prime Supplements` ×1, 47 with no brand; articles use `- PRIME Supplements` (lcarnitine) and 3/335 contain the brand; collections `| Prime Supplements` ×1. Homepage title is `Prime Supplements - Hardcore Sports Nutrition` (English tagline, no product keyword).
findings.recommendation: Replace line 20 and lines 22-24 of `layout/theme.liquid` (on the duplicate theme) with: ```liquid {%- liquid assign brand = shop.name assign seo_title = page_title if request.page_type == 'index' assign seo_title = 'Suplimente sportive și nutriție pentru sală – magazin online' endif assign probe = seo_title | downcase | remove: ' ' assign has_brand = false if probe contains 'primesupplements' assign has_brand = true endif assign meta_desc = page_description if request.page_type == 'product' and product.metafields.global.description_tag == blank assign cat = '' for c in product.collections unless c.handle == 'all' or c.handle == 'cele-mai-vandute' or c.handle == 'lansate-recent' or c.handle == '11-tva' or c.handle == 'frontpage' assign cat = c.title break endunless endfor assign meta_desc = product.title | append: ' – ' | append: cat | append: ' de la Prime Supplements. Preț ' | append: product.price | money | append: ', livrare rapidă în toată România.' elsif request.page_type == 'collection' and meta_desc == blank assign meta_desc = collection.title | append: ' – ' | append: collection.products_count | append: ' produse Prime Supplements. Comandă online, livrare rapidă în România.' elsif request.page_type == 'article' and meta_desc == blank assign meta_desc = article.excerpt | default: article.content | strip_html | truncate: 155 endif -%} <title> {{- seo_title -}} {%- if current_page != 1 %} – Pagina {{ current_page }}{% endif -%} {%- unless has_brand %} | {{ brand }}{% endunless -%} </title> {%- if meta_desc != blank -%} <meta name="description" content="{{ meta_desc | strip_newlines | truncate: 158 | escape }}"> {%- endif -%} ``` Then normalise the 32 hand-written brand suffixes to none (the template adds it) so nothing reads "… | PrimeSupplements | Prime Supplements". Keep hand-written titles ≤ 55 chars.
findings.falsifiability: Every `<title>` in a crawl ends with "| Prime Supplements" exactly once; no product page lacks a meta description.
findings.leading_indicator: Brand-query SERP titles consistent within one crawl; GSC branded impressions.

findings.title: 47 SEO titles exceed 60 characters (max 92) and 17 raw product titles run to 122 characters
findings.evidence: `products-all.json`: `seo_title_len > 60` on 47/80 set titles, > 70 on 39, e.g. "Thermo Core 120 Caps - Supliment pentru Arderea Grăsimilor și Energizare | PRIME Supplements" (92), "Daily Vitamin Formula 30 packs - Supliment Multivitaminic Esențial | PRIME Supplements" (86). Raw `title_len > 60` on 17 Frutilu products (85-122 chars, e.g. instant-drink-frutilu-ice-tea-peach-10g = 122); these have shorter SEO titles but the raw title is the H1, `og:title`, product-card anchor and cart line. Effective titles < 25 chars: 16.
findings.recommendation: Cut the "- Supliment pentru …" filler; pattern `"{Produs} {gramaj} – {beneficiu}"` (≤ 55). Shorten the 17 Frutilu product titles to `"Băutură instant Frutilu {aromă} 10g – fără zahăr"` and move "(pentru 1.5L) – cu Stevia și Vitamina C" into the description.
findings.falsifiability: No `<title>` > 65 chars and no H1 > 70 chars on product pages.
findings.leading_indicator: Google stops rewriting these titles (compare SERP title vs `<title>` for the 47 URLs).

findings.title: Meta descriptions are templated ("Descoperiți … Alegeți PRIME Supplements …"), 35 exceed 160 chars and 2 are duplicates
findings.evidence: Of 81 set product metas: 40 start with "Descoperiți", 36 contain "Alegeți PRIME Supplements", 12 end with the identical sentence "Alegeți PRIME Supplements pentru produse de calitate superioară!"; 35 are > 160 chars (max 221, e.g. prime-whey-1000g 191 / prime-whey-2000g 192, which are also near-identical: "Descoperiți Prime Whey, un supliment proteic din zer de calitate superioară…"). `metadata_template.py` flagged `brand-suffix-in-description` on pure-isolate-2000g. Articles: 118/336 metas start with "Află", 63 with "Descoperă", 54 with "Optimizează(-ți)" (70% share three openers); 91/336 are > 160 chars (max 250); 304/336 contain "2026".
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to 140-155 chars with a concrete fact first (dose, servings, protein per serving, price) and one differentiator; drop the brand sentence (the title carries it); give prime-whey-1kg/2kg distinct metas (servings 33 vs 66, price per kg).
findings.falsifiability: No meta > 160 chars; < 10% of metas share the same first word; 0 duplicate metas.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC CTR on the 35 long-meta URLs.

findings.title: Diacritics are inconsistent between title, H1 and meta on the same page
findings.evidence: 22 effective product titles are ASCII Romanian ("Bautura Instant Cola Frutilu 10g - Fara Zahar & Stevia", "Baton proteic caramel sarat", "Pudra Hidratare Frutilu Watermelon 10g | Bautura Sanatoasa") while 44 use diacritics; collection `pudra-proteica`: `<title>` "Pudra proteica pentru masa musculară | Prime Supplements" vs H1 "Pudre Proteice"; homepage meta (216 chars) has no diacritics at all ("Magazin online cu suplimente nutritive si gama completa de produse recomandata culturistilor…"); homepage H2 "Inainte/dupa"; 7 article SEO titles and 4 article H1s have no diacritics ("Fat Burner Pareri: Ce Iau Expertii pentru Retentia de Apa 2026"); Admin collection titles "Bauturi", "Creatina".
findings.affected_scope: 22 products, 1 collection title, homepage, 11 articles, several nav labels.
findings.recommendation: One rule: correct Romanian diacritics (ă â î ș ț, comma-below) in titles, H1s, metas and nav labels; ASCII variants belong only inside body copy if at all. Google treats "bautura"/"băutură" as equivalent for ranking, but mixed forms look machine-made in snippets.
findings.falsifiability: Regex crawl: no `<title>` containing `\b(Bautura|Fara|Pudra|Sanatoasa|Zahar|Capsuni|Pareri|Retentia)\b`.
findings.leading_indicator: None direct; snippet quality review.

findings.title: Homepage: English tagline title, 216-char ASCII meta, H1 is the logo, English H2
findings.evidence:
`$R/parsed/home.json`: title "Prime Supplements - Hardcore Sports Nutrition" (45 chars, no Romanian keyword); meta 216 chars without diacritics; H1 = `

Prime Supplements` (`$R/home.html` line 2124); 13 H2s including "Let customers speak for us" (Judge.me), "Inainte/dupa", "Cluster Insulin Bomb 1kg/33serv"; H3 "Combat PRO 2.0" duplicates an H2; 44 internal links with empty anchor text (product image links with `alt=""`, e.g. 3× /products/prime-whey-2000g); "Vezi toate" ×8 as the only anchor to collections such as cele-mai-vandute and lansate-recent.

Livrare rapidă, plata la livrare."; set header logo tag to `div` (Impact → header section setting "Logo as H1 on homepage" off) and give the hero section an H1 with the primary keyword; translate the Judge.me widget heading in the Judge.me app (Settings → Translations); rename "Inainte/dupa" → "Înainte/după".

findings.title: 9/23 collections have no SEO title/meta; "All Products", "11% TVA", empty "Reduceri" and 2× 185-product clones are indexable
findings.evidence: Context facts (verified on 4 local pages): `pages_collection-all.json` title/H1 "All Products", META(0); `pages_collection-11tva.json` "11% TVA", META(0); `pages_collection-haine-mnx.json` "Haine MNX", META(0); `pages_collection-reduceri.json` "Reduceri", META(0), 0 products (page says "Nu există produse"). No SEO fields on frontpage, cele-mai-vandute, lansate-recent, reduceri, all, 11-tva, haine-mnx, crema-de-orez, bauturi. 22/23 collections have an empty description ⇒ zero on-page copy, `twitter:description` empty on every collection, `og:description` missing on 9. All 185 products sit in all / cele-mai-vandute / lansate-recent, so three 8-page listings with the same 185 items compete with each other. The two SEO titles that exist: "Pudra proteica pentru masa musculară | Prime Supplements" (56), "Creatina monohidrat pentru forță și performanță" (47, no brand).
findings.affected_scope: 23 collections (46 with `/ro-hu/`), ~24 paginated listing URLs for the three clones.
findings.recommendation: Write SEO title + meta for all 23 (`"{Categorie} – {sub-tipuri} | Prime Supplements"`, e.g. "Pudre proteice – whey, izolat, gainer"), add 120-250 words of category copy to each (rendered below the grid), set `noindex` on 11-tva (tax grouping), reduceri while empty, frontpage, and either noindex or differentiate cele-mai-vandute/lansate-recent (sort rule + copy); rename `all` title to "Toate produsele". Collection meta fallback is in the ONPAGE-03 Liquid.
findings.falsifiability: No collection `<title>` equals the bare collection name; `/collections/all` title is Romanian; empty collections return `noindex`.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC: category queries landing on category pages instead of products.

findings.title: Collection H1 ≠ title, og:title uses the raw name, and 4 category pages hold 1-3 products
findings.evidence: `pages_collection.json`: `<title>` "Pudra proteica pentru masa musculară…" vs H1 "Pudre Proteice" vs `og:title` "Pudre Proteice"; `pages_collection-creatina.json`: title "Creatina monohidrat pentru forță și performanță" vs H1 "Creatina" vs og:title "Creatina" (`social-meta-tags.liquid` line 25 uses `collection.title`). Product counts (`products-all.json` collections field): frontpage 1, shot-pre-workout 2, alimente-sanatoase 2, creatina 3, batoane-proteice/arzator-de-grasimi/aminoacizi/suplimente-intra-workout 4 each. Two overlapping apparel collections: echipament-sala (99) and haine-mnx (87), linked as "Îmbrăcăminte" and "Haine MNX".
findings.recommendation: Align H1 with the keyword (H1 "Pudre proteice – whey, izolat, gainer"); in `social-meta-tags.liquid` use `page_title` for `og:title` on collections; merge shot-pre-workout into suplimente-pre-workout and alimente-sanatoase into crema-de-orez/"Alimente", or add copy + FAQs so 2-3-product pages are not thin; decide one apparel hub (haine-mnx) and make echipament-sala its parent or noindex it.
findings.falsifiability: `og:title` == `<title>` on collections; no indexable collection with < 4 products and < 100 words.
findings.leading_indicator: Category-page impressions in GSC.

findings.title: Article H1 titles: 321/354 over 60 chars (max 134), 279 carry "2026", 206 are colon-clickbait, 1 is fully English
findings.evidence: `articles-all.json`: `title_len > 60` on 321, > 70 on 131, > 80 on 38; median 69, max 134 ("Cum să Transformi Bioflavonoidele și Ceaiul Verde în Aliați Puternici în Lupta împotriva Grăsimilor: Ghida Completa pentru Thermo Core"); 279 contain "2026" and 253 end with it ("… în 2026"); 206 contain ":"; 30 use English Title Case ("Cum Să Maximizați Creșterea Musculară Cu Ajutorul…"); 1 H1 is English: "Exploring the Science Behind L-Carnitine 1000: How It Transforms Fat into Energy" (handle fat-burner-x10-pareri-l-carnitine-1000-80-caps). 47 title-keyword groups cover 164 articles (catalog-analysis.md). Typos in H1s: "Ghida Completa", "Ocasii Speciale", "HIVERNALĂ".
findings.recommendation: Rewrite H1s to ≤ 65 chars, sentence case, Romanian, no year unless the article is updated yearly (then "actualizat 2026" in the dateModified line, not the H1); one H1 per topic (merge the 47 cannibal groups, see cluster findings). Translate the English H1.
findings.falsifiability: ≤ 10% of article H1s > 65 chars; 0 English H1s.
findings.leading_indicator: Google title rewrites drop (SERP title == `<title>` for a 30-URL sample).

findings.title: Article SEO titles: 19 missing (Shopify then truncates the fallback at 70 chars mid-word), 223/335 over 60 chars, 292 contain "2026", 90 carry English keyword fragments
findings.evidence: GraphQL `global.title_tag`: set on 335/354; missing on 19 (list in Appendix A). For those, the rendered title is the article title cut at 70 characters: `$R/pages/article-2026-citicolina.html` `<title>Rutina perfectă de antrenament de seară pentru sportivii călători în 2</title>` (H1 ends "… în 2026"). Set titles: min 50, median 63, max 112; > 60 on 223, > 70 on 74, > 80 on 36; 292 contain "2026"; 32 are identical to the H1; 2 end in "..." ("Ce este un pre-workout fără cofeină? Descoperă Nitrox NO-..."); 90 contain English SEO fragments as the lead keyword ("Creatine Benefits: 7 Semne că…", "Before and after creatine: Performanță sub stres în 2026", "Creatine Gummies: Momentul Optim…" — the store sells no gummies), 1 French ("Protéine Whey Isolate: Ghid de Recuperare…"), 7 without diacritics. Only 3/335 contain the brand. `global.description_tag`: missing on 18 (Appendix A); for them `page_description` falls back to the body, which starts with the generator's English header: `pages_article-2026-citicolina.json` META(320) "Published: March 15, 2026 | Updated: March 15, 2026 By: Marius Chera , Nutriționist Certificat Share Post Key Takeaways Citicolina…" (also used as `og:description`).
findings.affected_scope: 19 + 18 fallback pages; 223 over-long titles; 90 English-fragment titles.
findings.recommendation: Set SEO title + meta on the 37 fallback articles first (they currently show truncated/boilerplate snippets); then regenerate all titles ≤ 60 chars in Romanian, leading with the Romanian query ("Beneficiile creatinei: 7 semne că ai nevoie de ea"), year only where the content is dated; keep the brand out (template adds it); fix the two "..." titles. In BlogGenAuto, disable the "English keyword in title" prompt setting or switch the keyword source to Romanian terms.
findings.falsifiability: 354/354 articles have `global.title_tag` and `global.description_tag`; no `<title>` ends with "..." or "în 2"; no title matches `\b(creatine|benefits|before and after|gummies)\b`.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC: impressions for Romanian queries ("beneficii creatină") replacing English-query impressions on blog URLs.

findings.title: 10 article SEO titles and 9 URL slugs target competitor brand names (Gymbeam, Havok, Optimum Nutrition, MyProtein, Farmacia Tei)
findings.evidence: SEO titles: "Gymbeam Creatine: 4 Momente pentru Pauza de Creatină în 2026", "Gymbeam Creatine: De ce Strategia ta Eșuează în 2026 și Soluția", "Creatina în Călătorii: Ghid Gymbeam Creatine pentru 2026", "Havok Pre Workout: Ghid de Depanare…", "Pre Workout Havok și Nutriția…", "Proteina Whey Optimum Nutrition și Gainerul…", "My protein: Combinații cu izolat proteic…", "Nac farmacia tei: 6 Greșeli de depozitare…", plus Dr Max (liver-protect). Handles: gymbeam-creatine-creatina-monohidrat-micronized-300g-fara (-2, -3, -4, -5), gymbeam-creatine-creatine-ready-to-go-plicuri, gainer-gymbeam-prime-whey-2000g-protein-myths, pre-workout-havok-suplimente-pre-workout-si-alimentatia, havok-pre-workout-ghid-depanare-rutina-suplimente-pre. The pages do not compare or mention those brands in the body beyond the keyword; they sell Prime products.
findings.affected_scope: 10 titles, 9 permanent slugs (5 of them a numbered -2…-5 series on the same topic).
findings.recommendation: Either turn them into honest comparison pages ("Creatină Prime vs Gymbeam: ce diferă") or retitle around the generic query and 301 the brand-named slugs to the canonical topic article (keeps SXO intent honest; avoids trademark complaints).
findings.falsifiability: No `<title>` or slug containing a third-party brand unless the page is a comparison with that brand named in H1 and body.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC queries containing "gymbeam"/"havok" on these URLs drop while generic creatine queries hold.

findings.title: 26 articles render two H1s; 352 bodies start with an English "Published: …" header line
findings.evidence:
Raw body HTML (`articles-p*.json`): `

` inside the body on 26 articles (Appendix B) while `sections__main-blog.liquid`/article template already prints `

{{ article.title }}

` → 2 H1s per page. 352 bodies start with "Published: May 15, 2026 | Updated: … | By: Marius Chera | Share Post | Key Takeaways" (hard-coded English, 10 with the literal date May 15, 2026; verified `$R/shopify/articles-bodies/*.txt`). 1 article uses H3s with no H2 (bcaa-vs-eaa…; `pages_article.json` H2 = only the theme's "Te-ar putea interesa"). 3 bodies embed a breadcrumb "Acasă › Ultimele articole › …" as text.
findings.recommendation: Bulk regex on article bodies: `<h1` → `<h2`, delete the "Published: … Key Takeaways" header block (the theme prints date/author in Romanian), convert lone H3 chains to H2. Disable the BlogGenAuto "post header" option.

findings.leading_indicator: None direct; snippet/og:description quality.

findings.title: Blog discoverability: 11 posts per page, 33 pages deep, prev/next-only pagination, the same 3 articles linked site-wide, 21 articles with zero inbound article links
findings.evidence: `/blogs/news` lists 11 articles (`pages_blog-index.json`: 11 images, 74 internal links of which ~55 are header/footer); `snippets__pagination.liquid` renders only `rel=prev`/`rel=next` and a "{{ current_page }} / {{ paginate.pages }}" label — no numbered links (`$R/pages/blog-index.html` contains only `href="/blogs/news?page=2"`, same on `/collections/all`). 354 articles ⇒ 33 pages; 299 articles sit beyond page 5, 244 beyond page 10, 134 beyond page 20, so the oldest needs 33 sequential hops. The homepage "Ghiduri și sfaturi utile" block and every sampled collection page link the same 3 articles (instant-oat-cream-800g-25-serv-mindful-eating-practices-2, l-carnitine-1000-80-caps-travel-weight-loss-tips, omega-3-crema-de-orez-blueberry-muffin). Tags: 345/354 untagged, 5 tags total, no tag hubs; single blog. Link graph from body HTML: 1474 article→article links, median 3 outbound; 21 articles receive 0 links from other articles (Appendix C), 110 receive 1-2; max inbound 13.
findings.recommendation: (1) In `sections/main-blog.liquid` raise `paginate blog.articles by 11` to 24 and add numbered pagination (`paginate.parts`) to `snippets/pagination.liquid`; (2) create 6-8 topic hubs (creatină, proteine, pre-workout, arzătoare, vitamine, recuperare, nutriție) as blog tags with tag pages linked from the blog header and footer; (3) rotate the "Ghiduri" block per collection (metafield `collection.metafields.custom.articles`) so each category links its own guides; (4) add "related by tag" at article end (Impact "Te-ar putea interesa" uses `blog.articles` — switch to tag-filtered); (5) link the 21 orphans from the hubs.
findings.falsifiability: Every article ≤ 4 clicks from the homepage in a crawl (Screaming Frog depth); 0 articles with < 2 inbound internal links.
findings.leading_indicator: GSC: number of blog URLs with impressions; crawl-stats "discovered - currently not indexed" count for /blogs/.

findings.title: 2582 in-article links point to primesupplements1.myshopify.com and 194 articles carry a dofollow "Powered by BlogGenAuto" link
findings.evidence: catalog-analysis.md (verified in `articles-p*.json`): 2582 links to `primesupplements1.myshopify.com` in 349 articles — 1602 product, 534 `/cart/add` and 446 collection links; every product link appears twice (primary + myshopify). `pages_article-2026-citicolina.json`: 4 myshopify links on one page. 194 articles contain the visible external link to bloggenauto.com without `rel="nofollow sponsored"`. Each myshopify link costs a 301 hop and leaks the dev hostname into anchors/snippets.
findings.recommendation: Bulk find/replace in article bodies: `https://primesupplements1.myshopify.com/` → `https://primesupplements.ro/`, then dedupe links to the same product in the same paragraph; remove the "Powered by BlogGenAuto" footer (or set `rel="nofollow sponsored"`). Set the BlogGenAuto "store URL" setting to the primary domain.
findings.falsifiability: `grep -c myshopify` over exported bodies = 0; no external bloggenauto.com link.
findings.leading_indicator: Redirect hits on primesupplements1.myshopify.com in the Shopify "online store sessions by referrer" drop to ~0.

findings.title: Empty and generic anchor texts: 44 image links with no text on the homepage, 28 on big collection pages, "Vezi toate" ×8
findings.evidence: `home.json`: 44 internal links with empty anchor (product image links whose ``, e.g. 3× /products/prime-whey-2000g, 3× /products/prime-whey-1000g, 3× /products/pure-isolate-2000g); "Vezi toate" ×8 is the only anchor to cele-mai-vandute and lansate-recent, "Vezi produse" to suplimente-sala; `pages_collection-all.json` and `pages_collection-haine-mnx.json`: 28 empty-anchor links each; product pages 7 each; the same collection is linked with four spellings ("PRE-WORKOUT", "Pre Workout", "Pre-Workout", "Vezi toate"). Root cause: 493/493 product images have no alt in Admin, so image links inherit no text.
findings.affected_scope: Homepage, all collection pages, product pages.
findings.recommendation: Fill product image alt (images specialist) — this also fixes the anchors; change "Vezi toate" to "Vezi toate pudrele proteice" etc. (section setting "button label"); unify nav labels to one spelling per collection.
findings.falsifiability: Crawl: 0 internal `<a>` with empty accessible text; "Vezi toate" ≤ 1 occurrence per page.
findings.leading_indicator: None direct.

findings.title: No visible breadcrumbs on any template; the only BreadcrumbList is JSON-LD and it points to "All Products"
